headline: iraqi insurgency
text: car bombings in baghdad kill at least 17 people and injure dozens of others.

headline: syrian civil war
text: an airstrike on a petrol station outside the capital damascus kills and injures dozens of people.
the united nations says the death toll from the conflict could be more than 60,000 people.

headline: kachin conflict
text: military aircraft in burma target rebel held areas in kachin state; the government later confirms the operation.

headline: belfast city hall flag protests
text: police clash with demonstrators in belfast over when the union flag is to be flown over their city hall.

headline: mexican drug war
text: mexican troops kill 12 alleged drug traffickers who opened fire at a checkpoint in la estación, zacatecas.

headline: 2012–2013 central african republic rebellion
text: south africa announces it will send 400 more soldiers to the central african republic in an effort to assist the current regime, which faces a potential attack by the seleka rebel coalition on the capital.

headline: iraqi insurgency
text: a suicide bomber kills a sunni mp and six others in fallujah, two days after finance minister rafi al-issawi survived an assassination attempt in the same city. the parliamentarian, ifan saadoun al-issawi, was an important member of the sahwa[disambiguation needed] committee in fallujah and part of the opposition to prime minister nouri al-maliki.

headline: m23 rebellion
text: the march 23 movement in the democratic republic of congo announces that peace talks will only commence if president joseph kabila's government signs a ceasefire.

headline: 2013 tasmanian bushfires
text: thousands of people are stranded by four major fires burning out of control in the australian state of tasmania.

headline: syrian civil war
text: fierce clashes erupt near the aleppo international airport in the battle of aleppo in syria, with unconfirmed reports it has been temporarily closed.

headline: northern mali conflict
text: a french pilot is killed in a helicopter raid in northern mali, according to french minister of defence jean-yves le drian.

headline: israeli–palestinian conflict
text: hundreds of thousands of people rally in gaza in a show of unity between the governing hamas, elected in 2006, and fatah, in opposition since then.

headline: iraqi insurgency
text: a suicide bombing in mussayab kills 27 shiite pilgrims and injures 60 others.

headline: nigerian sharia conflict
text: nigeria's military kill 13 members of the islamist militant group boko haram and lose one soldier in a gun battle in maiduguri.

headline: belfast city hall flag protests
text: violent protests occur in northern ireland over flying the union jack at belfast city hall, twenty-nine police officers are injured.

headline: kachin conflict
text: president of burma thein sein defends the army’s response to the ethnic kachin rebellion, despite a recent escalation of violence that has further dimmed peace prospects.

headline: in aménas hostage crisis
text: algeria confirms that 37 foreign hostages were killed in the hostage crisis, and names the nationalities of the militants.

headline: syrian civil war
text: the government of jordan says that more than 12,000 syrians have fled to jordan in the past six days.
the russian government organizes an evacuation for some of its citizens by transporting them to lebanon and then flying them to russia.

headline: 2012–2013 egyptian protests
text: massive protests against mohamed morsi develop all over egypt on the second anniversary of the 2011 revolution, including in tahrir square, where thousands of protesters gathered. at least 6 civilians and 1 police officer are shot dead in the egyptian city of suez, while 456 others are injured nationwide.

headline: 2013 brisbane train crash
text: a train overshoots the end of the tracks and crashes into a railway station's ladies bathroom in brisbane, australia, leaving 14 people injured.

headline: syrian civil war
text: clashes between government forces continue around damascus and homs, with heavy aerial bombardment by the syrian air force being reported.
president of syria bashar al-assad reshuffles his cabinet, appointing seven new ministers in a move analysts describe as an attempt to stabilize the country's economy.
information minister omran al-zoubi makes an official statement, extending an invitation to the opposition for dialogue aimed at achieving a political solution to the conflict.

headline: syrian civil war
text: rebels clash with the syrian military at an army base protecting aleppo's international airport. the opposition claims that 40 syrian soldiers were killed in the fighting, as large parts of the base are overrun.

headline: syrian civil war
text: at least 61 people are killed and more than 200 injured following a car bombing near syria's baath party headquarters in damascus. three other bombings kill 22 people and injure 50 others in the suburb of barzeh, most of them government soldiers. these are the deadliest attacks in the syrian capital since the outbreak of the civil war.

headline: syrian civil war
text: french freelance photographer olivier voisin, who was wounded near idlib in january 2013, dies in antakya, turkey, after surgery.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: two guards and an afghan police officer are killed in coordinated suicide bombing attacks in jalalabad and logar province in eastern afghanistan, while a third such attack on the national directorate of security in kabul is foiled.
president of afghanistan hamid karzai orders the united states to leave wardak province amid allegations of torture associated with us special forces.

headline: mexican drug war
text: the mexican police find 9 mutilated bodies inside a suv with texas license plates in the northern state of tamaulipas, mexico.

headline: iraqi insurgency
text: at least 11 people are killed and more than 30 are wounded in bomb attacks at sunni mosques in baghdad and in the province of diyala.

headline: war on terror
text: a car bomb detonates outside the french embassy in the libyan capital tripoli, resulting in injury to two guards and extensive damage to the embassy.

headline: iraqi insurgency
text: at least 10 people are killed and 26 others injured in attacks across iraq.

headline: war in north-west pakistan
text: two bombs explode near two separate mosques in the malakand district of pakistan, killing 15 people and wounding at least 100 others.

headline: war in north-west pakistan
text: a suicide bombing in the pakistani city of peshawar kills at least three people and leaves several injured.

headline: nigerian sharia conflict
text: suspected islamist insurgents kill 13 people in maiduguri, nigeria after hiding their weapons in a coffin.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: a bomb explodes in the afghan capital of kabul killing three people and wounding six.
four united states troops are killed near bagram airfield.

headline: 2013 north india floods
text: nearly 14,000 people are believed to be missing in uttarakhand state, with another 60,000 stranded and 150 killed.

headline: syrian civil war spillover in lebanon
text: clashes between the lebanese army and supporters of the salafist cleric ahmed al-assir continue for a second day around the ain el-hilweh camp near sidon. the government reports at least 15 soldiers killed and 38 others injured in the violence, as it promises crackdown on ethnic strife across the country.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: taliban forces attack near the presidential palace in kabul.

headline: syrian civil war
text: three german gruenhelme e.v. aid workers have been missing since may 19 in the town of harem in northern syria and are believed to have been kidnapped.
syrian government troops launch a major offensive on rebel-held areas in the city of homs, following the regime’s success in seizing the city of qusayr with hezbollah backing.

headline: syrian civil war
text: the syrian opposition calls for immediate humanitarian aid to homs after the syrian army and hezbollah step up their siege of the city with increased artillery shelling and incendiary bombs.

headline: syrian civil war
text: syrians in aleppo stage a protest against a rebel siege of government-held areas in the city.

headline: iraqi insurgency
text: a suicide bombing inside a sunni mosque in the eastern iraqi province of diyala kills at least twenty people.

headline: santiago de compostela derailment
text: mariano rajoy, the prime minister of spain, declares three days of national mourning for the 78 people killed in the derailment, spain's worst train accident since 1944.
the driver of the alvia high-speed train involved in the accident is arrested, as investigations show that the train was travelling at more than double the local speed limit at the time of the crash.

headline: aftermath of the 2013 egyptian coup d'état
text: over 100 people are killed and around 1,500 injured in a violent crackdown against protesters in the egyptian capital of cairo.

headline: iraqi insurgency
text: 26 people are killed and 55 wounded by a suicide bomber in a park in northern baghdad

headline: syrian civil war
text: the russian foreign ministry warned that an attack on the syrian government could be "catastrophic" and told western countries to show "prudence" over the crisis happening there.

syrian foreign minister walid muallem said he rejects "utterly and completely" that syrian government forces used chemical weapons, while the u.s. and its allies prepare their forces for an alleged imminent attack, which is said to be "well defined in time and space", limited to targeting command and control, airfields and artillery.
french president françois hollande says france is "ready to punish" those responsible for the chemical attacks.
the syrian government is believed to be behind the recent tripoli bombings in lebanon after a suspect confesses to lebanese police.
british prime minister david cameron recalls the uk parliament from its summer recess to discuss the uk's response to the chemical weapons attack.
russia has begun to evacuate its citizens from syria.

headline: islamic insurgency in the philippines
text: the moro national liberation front attacks the philippines town of lamitan with five people missing and two injured.

headline: syrian civil war
text: the united states and russia reach a deal on syrian chemical weapons.

headline: syrian civil war
text: jihadis belonging to the al-qaida offshoot known as the isil overrun the town of azaz, after driving out the free syrian army.

headline: islamist protests in egypt
text: four people are killed after supporters of ousted president mohammed morsi clashed with opponents and security forces. ,

headline: iraqi insurgency
text: a bomb detonates outside a sunni mosque in kirkuk, iraq, killing 12 worshipers and injuring another 24.

headline: israeli-palestinian conflict
text: the israeli army finds a second tunnel laden with explosives dug from the gaza strip into israel and proceeds to destroy it.

headline: islamist protests in egypt
text: three egyptian policemen are killed by masked men in an attack at a checkpoint in the nile delta city of mansoura.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: australia declares its war in afghanistan over while the prime minister, tony abbott, visits afghanistan.

headline: typhoon haiyan
text: philippine president benigno aquino iii is criticized by survivors, aid agencies, and international and local media for his inadequate response to the tragedy.

headline: post-civil war violence in libya
text: second day of fighting in tripoli as death toll from violence at anti-militia protest topped 40.

headline: colombian conflict
text: in colombia, farc rebels dynamite two southern oil pipelines and planted a bomb on the top coal exporter's northern railway after the end of a rebel ceasefire.

headline: 2013 united states embassy bombing in ankara
text: a suicide bombing outside the u.s. embassy in the turkish capital, ankara, kills at least two people.

headline: south thailand insurgency
text: 16 muslim insurgents are killed during an attack on a military base in the  thai province of narathiwat.

headline: bahraini uprising
text: a 16-year-old child is shot dead at close range in al-daih, a village west of manama, bahrain.
a police officer is also killed after rioters threw firebombs at his patrol in sehla, a village west of manama, bahrain.
amnesty international calls on the bahraini regime to release prisoners of conscience it is holding in captivity.

headline: 2013 hyderabad blasts
text: at least 20 people are dead and 54 injured following several bombings in the indian city of hyderabad.

headline: northern mali conflict
text: one of islamist organization al-qaeda's most feared commanders in africa, abdelhamid abou zeid, is killed by chadian forces in northern mali.

headline: 2013 bangladesh protests
text: the death toll in bangladesh rises to at least 50 as protests continue following the sentencing of delwar hossain sayeedi.

headline: akashat ambush
text: the insurgent group islamic state of iraq claims responsibility for ambushing a convoy of syrian army soldiers on march 4.

headline: taliban insurgency
text: a suicide bomber kills 10 spectators, including the district police chief, during a local gaming event in kunduz province of northern afghanistan.

headline: al-qaeda insurgency in yemen
text: three members of ansar al-sharia and two pro-government militia fighters are killed in an attack in abyan governorate.

headline: m23 rebellion
text: the united nations security council authorizes a new intervention force in the democratic republic of the congo in attempt to end rebel attacks and bring peace to the region.

headline: syrian civil war
text: a car bomb explodes in the center of the capital, damascus, killing at least 15 people and wounding 53 others.

headline: war in north-west pakistan
text: a bomb explodes on a bus in the pakistani city of peshawar, killing at least eight people.

headline: 2013 sistan and baluchestan earthquake
text: at least 37 people are dead after a 7.8 magnitude earthquake strikes with its epicenter below khash county, sistan and baluchestan province, iran, near the border with pakistan. tremors are felt throughout the middle east, pakistan and north india, and hundreds of deaths are expected by the iran government.

headline: arab–israeli conflict
text: two rockets fired from egypt's sinai peninsula hit the israeli resort of eilat, but land in open areas, causing no damage. three more rockets hit open areas in neighboring jordan.

headline: war in north-west pakistan
text: pakistani police defuse a car bomb near a fortified farmhouse, where the former pakistan president pervez musharraf is under house arrest.

headline: 2013 ricin attacks
text: it is revealed that everett dutschke was, earlier this month, charged with two child molestations involving three girls younger than 16.

headline: syrian civil war
text: four filipino un peacekeepers are kidnapped by armed men while patrolling the demilitarized area between syria and the israeli-annexed golan heights. ,

headline: war in somalia
text: nineteen people are killed in the somali capital, mogadishu, in suicide bombings and firefights between al-shabaab  militants and government forces.

headline: syrian civil war
text: rebel fighters launch a massive assault on a prison in syria's northern city of aleppo.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: three corpses are dug up near a former u.s. military base in narkh bringing the number of corpses whose deaths locals blame on the presence of united states personnel to 10; people flood the streets of maidan shar calling for the u.s. to leave.
two british soldiers are court martialed for "sexually and racially abusing civilians" during their time in afghanistan.

headline: nigerian sharia conflict
text: at least 21 people are killed in maiduguri, nigeria, as the government continues its crack down on boko haram militants.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: a bomb detonates near the afghan supreme court killing 8 people and wounding dozens.

headline: syrian civil war
text: the united states offers unspecified military equipment to the rebels after determining that the syrian regime used chemical weapons against the opposition.

headline: nigerian sharia conflict
text: boko haram gunmen kill nine children in an attack on a school in maiduguri.

headline: 2013 protests in turkey
text: police use water cannon, tear gas and rubber bullets on thousands of civilians gathered in istanbul's taksim square for a memorial to the 4 protestors killed in previous days.

headline: 2013 north india floods
text: the death toll from the disaster soars to more than 6,500, as units of the indian army struggle to reach thousands of people stranded in country's northwest.

headline: mexican drug war
text: clashes between the knights templar cartel and the mexican federal police leave 22 dead in the state of michoacán. according to government press reports, two of the dead were law enforcement officials, while the rest were cartel gunmen.

headline: syrian civil war
text: an ammunition depot explodes in homs, syria, killing at least 40 people and critically injuring many more.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: a bomb explodes at a cemetery in the afghan province of nangarhar, killing at least 14 people.

headline: iraqi insurgency
text: a wave of bomb attacks kill 41 people in iraq.

headline: syrian civil war
text: human rights watch issues a report concluding that syrian government forces were most likely to be responsible for chemical weapons attacks on two suburbs in damascus on august 21.
france announces that it will propose a united nations security council resolution proposing that syria hand over its chemical weapons to international control.

barack obama, the president of the united states, gives a televised address to the nation, saying that he has asked the united states congress to postpone a vote on the use of force while he pursues a diplomatic solution.

headline: bahraini uprising
text: tens of thousands march in bahrain in the largest anti-government protest in months.

headline: syrian civil war
text: a team from the organisation for the prohibition of chemical weapons enters syria to begin work on dismantling the assad regime's stockpile of chemical weapons.

headline: syrian civil war
text: a suicide bomber kills 16 syrian army soldiers at a checkpoint near damascus.

headline: war in somalia
text: a suspected u.s. drone strike kills at least two islamist al-shabaab insurgents and commander driving in a car south of the somali capital mogadishu.

headline: islamist protests in egypt
text: lawyers in the uk accuse egypt's military of committing crimes against humanity after july's ouster of president mohamed morsi.

headline: 2013 riga maxima superstore collapse
text: the death toll rises to at least 48, with others feared trapped and rescue efforts continuing.

headline: syrian civil war
text: 9 people are killed by a car bomb at a petrol station in the syrian capital of damascus. the bomb reportedly hit the barzeh al-balad district, as large numbers of people were queuing for fuel.

headline: kachin conflict
text: kachin rebels claim the government has fired shells at the rebel de facto headquarters of laiza.

headline: northern mali conflict
text: the malian army used artillery on islamist rebels in gnimignama in the first skirmish between the two belligerents since april 2012, when islamist and tuareg rebels first assumed control of the region.

headline: in aménas hostage crisis
text: suspected islamic militants take over a bp facility in in aménas, algeria, killing at least 2 workers and taking up to 40 others hostage, including 13 norwegians, a number of americans, as well as nationals from ireland, japan, france and the united kingdom. a previously unknown group allied to al-qaeda's regional branch says the attack is in revenge for algeria's support of the french operation against islamic rebels in mali.

headline: january 2013 great britain and ireland snowfall
text: heavy snowfall across the british isles enters its second day.
another 100 flights are cancelled at europe's busiest airport, heathrow, with some passengers forced to spend the night sleeping on the terminal floor.

four climbers are killed by an avalanche in glen coe in the scottish highlands while descending the south side of bidean nam bian. a fifth member of the party is airlifted to hospital with serious injuries, while a sixth escapes unharmed.

headline: 2013 uribana prison riot
text: a prison riot in barquisimeto, venezuela, kills at least 50 people and injures about 90 people.

headline: iraqi insurgency
text: a suicide bomber attacks a government building in taji, 15 kilometres north of the capital baghdad, killing 22 and injuring 44 others. nineteen of the dead are members of the sahwa militia opposed to al-qaeda in iraq, who were waiting for their monthly salaries.

headline: syrian civil war
text: an explosion in a vehicle at the cilvegözü border gate kills 14 civilians , and injures more than 25 others in reyhanlı district of hatay province, turkey. the gate is on the turkish–syrian border.

headline: m23 rebellion
text: eleven african nations including all the members of the african great lakes region sign a united nations brokered peace deal for the eastern region of the democratic republic of the congo.

headline: israeli–palestinian conflict
text: a rocket is fired from the gaza strip into israel, marking the first such attack since a ceasefire was signed in november 2012.

headline: mexican drug war
text: gunmen break into a prison in the mexican border city of ciudad miguel alemán, tamaulipas, and liberate 12 inmates.

headline: northern mali conflict
text: french officials announce that a soldier was killed in action during contact with islamic militants over the weekend. it is france's third casualty since operations began in operation serval.
france claims that it is "probable" that al-qaeda in the islamic maghreb chief abdelhamid abou zeid was killed in mali in late february.

headline: 2012–2013 egyptian protests
text: five people die in clashes between protestors and egyptian police.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: at least 19 people are killed by two suicide bombings in the afghan capital, kabul, and in khost province, as chuck hagel, the united states secretary of defense, visits the city.

headline: nigerian sharia conflict
text: men on motorbikes storm a primary school in nigeria and open fire wounding four teachers.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: australia announces that it will be closing its base in tarinkot in urozgan province, with the majority of troops returning home by the end of this year.
a suicide attack on a police station in jalalabad, afghanistan, kills five police officers while seven attackers die.
one british soldier is killed and nine are wounded by taliban insurgents in an attack on a patrol base with a truck bomb and small arms fire in helmand province, nad ali district, afghanistan.

headline: iraqi insurgency
text: coordinated car bombings against five shiite mosques in baghdad and kirkuk kill 23 worshipers.

headline: boston marathon bombings
text: the boston police department chases two carjacking suspects in the mit shooting death of a campus policeman to the nearby suburb of watertown where, after a gunfight that included explosives, an mbta officer is injured, one suspect is dead, and the other flees but is later captured.

the suspects are brothers. the at-large suspect is identified as a kyrgyzstan-born cambridge resident, 19-year-old dzhokhar tsarnaev. the deceased brother is identified as 26-year-old tamerlan tsarnaev. a number of youtube videos, posted by the suspects, surface that seek muslim takeover of chechnya.
boston and its suburbs are on lockdown as a result of the manhunt. people were not allowed to go out until the lockdown was lifted, and businesses were also closed.

shortly after officials announce that they have lost track of the suspect and lifted the lockdown, a tip leads police to the back yard of a home in the boston suburb of watertown, massachusetts, where the second suspect is captured after an exchange of gunfire and a brief standoff.

dzhokhar tsarnaev is captured and taken in serious condition to beth israel deaconess medical center. u.s. president barack obama gives a news conference, where he praises the collaboration between government law enforcement agencies. with the suspect's capture and presumed interrogation , the lockdown and emergency state will likely be lifted.

headline: south thailand insurgency
text: insurgents kill six people, including a two-year-old boy, in a deadly shooting in pattani, thailand.

headline: iraqi insurgency
text: gunmen using silenced weapons attack at least nine alcohol stores in western baghdad, killing twelve people.
thirty-five people, including three police officers, are killed in bomb attacks in shi'ite sections of baghdad and parts of northern iraq.

headline: 2013 european floods
text: flooding across europe kills seven people and leaves others unaccounted for.
the czech republic experiences its worst flooding of the decade with huge volumes of water surging towards prague.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: in afghanistan, a man wearing an afghan military uniform attacks and kills three american soldiers, in what appears to be an insider attack on u.s. international security assistance force soldiers, based in east afghanistan's paktika province.
in a separate unrelated incident, an italian soldier is killed and three are wounded when a child throws a grenade at a nato convoy in west afghanistan's farah province.

headline: syrian civil war
text: the syrian military captures the town of al-buwaydah al-sharqiyah.

headline: war in north-west pakistan
text: a bomb attack on a security convoy in northwest pakistan kills at least 11 people while injuring 19.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: an afghan soldier kills a slovak soldier and wounds six others.
seventeen people are killed by a roadside bomb in western afghanistan.

headline: war in somalia
text: a car bomb explodes near an african union convoy killing three soldiers.

headline: iraqi insurgency
text: a suicide bombing in the iraqi town of tuz khormato kills at least eight policemen.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: nine children die in a suicide bombing near the indian consulate in the afghan city of jalalabad.

headline: nigerian sharia conflict
text: 35 people - mostly boko haram militants - are killed in separate attacks on security forces in borno state.

headline: iraqi insurgency
text: fourteen people are killed by a suicide bomber in a military headquarters in western iraq.

headline: political violence in egypt
text: protests in cairo and other cities, led by supporters of deposed president morsi, follow friday prayers.

headline: syrian civil war
text: the un accuses both the syrian government and, to a lesser extent, the rebels of war crimes. out of 9 massacres they investigated, 8 were attributed to the syrian army. the remaining massacre was attributed to insurgents.
russia gives the alleged proof of chemical weapons use by militants in syria to united nations security council.
fighters from an al qaeda-linked rebel group kill 12 members of the minority alawite sect in central syria after seizing their village, opposition activists say.
un investigators in syria say syrian army forces continue to bomb hospitals and massacre civilians.
france drafts a resolution forcing the syrian government to hand over its stockpiles of chemical weapons in 15 days

headline: iraqi insurgency
text: fourteen car bombs targeting shi'ite neighborhoods in baghdad leave 54 people dead.

headline: islamist insurgency in nigeria
text: air force fighter jets bomb camps belonging to suspected islamist militants in northeast nigeria in response to a massacre of students at an agricultural college.

headline: islamist protests in egypt
text: at least 53 people are killed during clashes between supporters and opponents of former president mohamed morsi on the 40th anniversary of egypt's crossing of the suez canal in 1973.

headline: islamist protests in egypt
text: six egyptian soldiers are killed in an ambush west of ismaïlia, close to the suez canal. in the south sinai, a suicide bomber kills 3 and injures 55 others after an attack against security buildings in the provincial capital el-tor.

headline: post-civil war violence in libya
text: the prime minister of libya ali zeidan is kidnapped from a hotel in tripoli but later released.

headline: iraqi insurgency
text: a suicide bomber detonates a bomb in an oil tanker truck, killing 15 people in baghdad, iraq.

headline: syrian civil war
text: turkey seizes a truck loaded with 1,200 rocket warheads and other weapons near the border with syria and detain nine people.

headline: iraqi insurgency
text: bombs across iraq detonate, killing 18 people.

headline: drone attacks in pakistan
text: pakistani officials claim that an american drone strike on an islamic seminary has killed six people, including two afghan taliban leaders and a leader of the haqqani network.

headline: 2013 riga maxima superstore collapse
text: at least six people are killed and 35 injured as a maxima superstore collapses in the latvian capital riga.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: suicide bombers kill four in an attack in spin boldak, afghanistan.

headline: northern mali conflict
text: france commits troops to aid government forces in the northern mali conflict.

headline: northern mali conflict
text: african troops are to be deployed in mali to fight alongside french and malian soldiers within a week.

headline: kashmir conflict
text: pakistan claims another of its soldiers is killed from gunfire by indian troops near the line of control. this is the fifth such fatality reported in the past two weeks from either of the neighboring countries who each claim the disputed territory.

headline: history of eritrea
text: dissident soldiers seize the ministry of information in asmara, eritrea, forcing state media to call for the release of political prisoners. other buildings are also surrounded while television and radio later went off air. the apparent coup attempt against president isaias afewerki reportedly fails.

headline: northern mali conflict
text: french and malian troops retake diabaly and douentza as islamist forces retreat.

headline: iraqi insurgency
text: a suicide bombing at a mosque in the iraqi town of tuz khormato kills at least 23 people.

headline: war in north-west pakistan
text: a suicide bomber in a market kills at least 21 people and wounds more than 30 in hangu, pakistan.

headline: 2013 united states embassy bombing in ankara
text: the turkish radical leftist group revolutionary people's liberation party–front claims responsibility for the bombing in ankara.

headline: senkaku islands dispute
text: japanese defense minister itsunori onodera states that the country has lodged a protest with china after a people's liberation army navy frigate directed weapon-targeting radar at a japanese maritime self-defense force destroyer near the disputed senkaku islands.

headline: iraqi insurgency
text: a rocket kills six people and injures over 50 others at camp liberty, an iraqi facility near baghdad that shelters members of people's mujahedin of iran.

headline: terrorism in greece
text: a bomb explodes outside the residence of a greek shipowner near acropolis in central athens; no one is injured.

headline: 2013 mayflower oil spill
text: an exxon mobil crude oil pipeline ruptures near the town of mayflower in the u.s. state of arkansas, spilling thousands of barrels from the tar sands.

headline: 2013 argentina floods
text: more than 50 people are killed in major floods in buenos aires and la plata, argentina, due to heavy rain.

headline: syrian civil war
text: an air strike on aleppo by the syrian air force kills 15 people, including nine children.
syrian armed forces fire otr-21 tochka missiles at baraza region of damascus.

headline: 15 april 2013 iraq attacks
text: at least 33 people are killed and more than 160 others are wounded during a wave of bombings in kirkuk, baqubah, tikrit, fallujah, nassiriyah, mussayab and baghdad.

headline: syrian civil war

headline: sinai insurgency

headline: syrian civil war

text: a suicide truck bomber attack by the al-qaeda-linked al-nusra front on a government checkpoint outside hama, syria, kills at least 30 people, including a number of soldiers.

headline: islamist insurgency in nigeria
text: nigerian troops kill  37 boko haram islamist militants in air and ground strikes in their bases in the northeast.

headline: syrian civil war

headline: post-civil war violence in libya

headline: kachin conflict

headline: 2012–2013 egyptian protests
text: the egyptian army is dispatched to the town of suez following the death of at least nine people in clashes between anti-government protesters and supporters of president mohamed morsi.
at least 30 people die in violence that erupted in port said, egypt, following the death sentences of 21 people for their roles in the port said stadium disaster.

headline: northern mali conflict
text: french forces enter the city of kidal in northern mali after seizing its airport overnight.

headline: 2013 solomon islands earthquake
text: a tsunami warning is issued for a wide range of islands in the south pacific after a magnitude 8.0 earthquake occurs off the coast of the solomon islands.
there are reports of significant damage to villages in the solomon islands west and south of the town of lata.
at least five people have been reported dead in the solomons' santa cruz islands.

headline: 2013 bangladesh protests
text: the death toll in bangladesh rises to 44 as protests continue following the sentencing of delwar hossain sayeedi.

headline: northern mali conflict
text: chadian soldiers kill mokhtar belmokhtar, an al-qaeda commander in africa responsible for a mass hostage-taking at an algerian gas plant.

headline: south thailand insurgency
text: suspected insurgents detonate a motorcycle bomb in southern thailand killing 2 thai military rangers and wounding 11 people.

headline: 2013 bangladesh protests
text: at least 16 people die in clashes in bangladesh as a strike organized by jamaat-e-islami begins.

headline: terrorism in pakistan
text: a car bombing at the jalozai refugee camp near the pakistani city of peshawar kills at least 12 people and wounds up to 30 others.

headline: israeli–palestinian conflict
text: a palestinian, naji balbisi, dies from injuries he suffered during a clashes with israeli forces in the west bank city of tulkarem, a day after his cousin, amer al-najjar, died in the clashes after they tried to firebomb a checkpoint.

headline: 2013 thane building collapse
text: at least 46 people are killed when an illegally constructed building collapses in mumbra, a suburb of thane, india.

headline: conflict in the niger delta
text: 12 nigerian policemen are missing and presumed dead after their boat was ambushed by militants in the niger delta region.

headline: south thailand insurgency
text: two soldiers are killed and six security officers are wounded as insurgents mount dozens of coordinated bombing, shooting and arson attacks in the pattani region of thailand.

headline: boston marathon bombings
text: u.s. president barack obama visits the city of boston in the wake of the recent marathon bombings.
the federal bureau of investigation posts photos of two suspects in the boston marathon bombings.
a campus police officer is shot dead in his vehicle at the massachusetts institute of technology in the u.s. city of cambridge, massachusetts.

headline: syrian civil war
text: an israeli military intelligence analyst states that syria has used chemical weapons repeatedly over the past month. he also criticizes the international community for not responding to the use of the weapons.
two orthodox christian bishops kidnapped by gunmen in a rebel-held area in northern syria are released.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: six police officers are poisoned and fatally shot in kunduz province, afghanistan while another one is missing.

headline: 2013 savar building collapse
text: the death toll in bangladesh rises to 401.

headline: 2012 northern mali conflict
text: a sixth french soldier is killed in mali when his vehicle struck a roadside bomb, seriously injuring two more.

headline: syrian civil war
text: up to 100 people are killed in a raid of al-bayda, baniyas by the syrian army.

headline: war in north-west pakistan
text: a bomb explodes near the awami national party offices in karachi killing 11 people.

headline: syrian civil war
text: israel and syria exchange gunfire on the golan heights.
elite hezbollah reinforcements are sent from lebanon across the border to al-qusayr, syria. activists report that much of the city has been destroyed.

headline: syrian civil war
text: the european union lifts its ban against arming syrian rebels as full consensus among its 27 member states to extend the current embargo could not be reached.

headline: drone attacks in pakistan
text: a u.s. drone attack kills at least seven people in pakistan.

headline: syrian civil war
text: the friends of syria group agrees to give urgent assistance to the rebels.

headline: 2013 north india floods
text: north india braces for more rain in what is believed to be the worst monsoon season in 50 years.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: militants attack nato headquarters in the north of kabul resulting in at least two deaths. ,

headline: syrian civil war
text: ban ki-moon, the secretary-general of the united nations, calls for a ceasefire during ramadan.
a car bomb targeting the office of the shia militant group hezbollah located in the lebanese capital beirut injures 53 people.

headline: 2013 assam floods
text: floods in indian state of assam force nearly 250,000 people to leave their homes.

headline: political violence in egypt
text: egyptian security forces clear a cairo mosque after a long stand-off with the muslim brotherhood. ,
egyptian prime minister hazem al beblawi proposes the legal dissolution of the muslim brotherhood.

headline: syrian civil war
text: syrian rebels attack a militia checkpoint in homs, killing 5 from the ndf militia but 6 civilians nearby as well.
a syrian government warplane attack in aleppo leaves at least 15 civilians dead.

headline: syrian civil war
text: syrian activists claim that chemical weapon attacks have killed over 600 people in the outskirts of damascus.

headline: war in north-west pakistan
text: 5 taliban militants are killed in bomb attack in south waziristan.

headline: syrian civil war
text: the syrian government allows un inspectors to visit the site of suspect chemical weapons attack outside the outskirt of damascus.

headline: sinai insurgency
text: two suicide bombers ram a car with explosives. egyptian military says one hit the local branch of military intelligence, while the other struck an army checkpoint in rafah killing nine soldiers and wounding 17 others.

headline: sudanese protests
text: sudanese security forces fire live ammunition on a march that followed the funeral of a demonstrator killed the day before.

headline: iraqi insurgency
text: a series of car bombings around the iraqi capital, baghdad, kills at least 38 people.

headline: st jude storm
text: at least 13 people are confirmed dead after the storm hits northern europe.

headline: 2013 tiananmen square attack
text: china's top security official blames the east turkestan islamic movement for a suicide attack that killed five people at the tiananmen gate in beijing on monday.

headline: syria civil war
text: colonel abdul jabbar akaidi, top rebel leader and chief recipient of u.s. aid, quits his position blaming recent losses on rebel infighting.

text: syrian army retakes strategically important damascus suburb of hujaira from the rebels.
four palestinians are killed in a bombing attack at the yarmouk refugee camp.
syrian kurds announce transitional autonomous authority amidst fighting with rebels.

headline: typhoon haiyan
text: the official death toll in the philippines is actually reported that 2,500 people were killed.
the total international aid for the typhoon victims reaches over $140 million.

headline: typhoon haiyan
text: the united nations tallies the death toll to around 4,400. the red cross estimates that around 20,000 are still missing, many of whom are feared dead. this is contrary to a previous estimate by benigno aquino iii, who put the death toll to a low 2,000.
the official death toll is now at 3,631.

headline: typhoon haiyan
text: david cameron commits an additional £30 million to the victims.

headline: in aménas hostage crisis
text: an algerian official reports that a group of hostages has escaped from the natural gas complex that was taken over by islamist militants. it is reported as many as 20 escaped, including americans.

the algerian army assaults the complex with helicopter gunships, reportedly killing 15 kidnappers and as many as 34 hostages. according to local sources, at least 7 hostages remain alive and in captivity.
algerian news agency anp reports that during the algerian army assault 600 hostages were freed. terrorists claim that they killed 35 hostages during the battle and that 15 terrorists were killed.

headline: syrian civil war
text: 106 people are massacred in the basatin al-hasawiya district of homs, syria, including children. people were shot, stabbed, and burned to death by forces loyal to bashar al-assad known as the shabiha.

headline: in aménas hostage crisis
text: about 60 foreign hostages are unaccounted for in the standoff with islamist militants now entering its third day.
the terrorists demand that the united states government release omar abdel-rahman and aafia siddiqui in exchange for releasing american hostages.

headline: northern mali conflict
text: the malian army says it is investigating allegations that soldiers have carried out summary executions in the islamist-controlled north of mali.

text: two car bombs explode in the syrian controlled part of golan heights killing 8 people.

text: israeli forces attack an arms convoy on the lebanon–syria border overnight destined from syria to hezbollah.
syrian sources claim that the true objective of the raid was a weapon research center northwest of damascus and that two people were killed in the action.

headline: iraqi insurgency
text: at least 33 people are killed in kirkuk, iraq, when a suicide bomber detonates a truck packed with explosives outside a police headquarters and gunmen disguised as officers tried to storm the compound.

text: pakistani police arrest 170 suspected militants following the february 2013 quetta bombing that killed 84 people and injured another 190.

headline: northern mali conflict
text: 13 chadian soldiers and 65 islamist insurgents are killed in heavy fighting in a remote part of northern mali.

headline: south yemen insurgency
text: three people are killed and 14 injured in clashes between civilians and government security forces in aden and mukalla, as thousands turn up for a day of planned protests. in a separate attack, a senior yemeni security chief and two of his bodyguards are injured in a shooting.

headline: nigerian sharia conflict
text: gunmen kill seven guards guarding a marketplace in yobe state, nigeria.

headline: south thailand insurgency
text: thailand agrees to peace talks with muslim rebels for the first time after 20 years of conflict.

headline: 2013 lahad datu standoff
text: fighting erupts in sabah, malaysia, leaving seven dead, including five policemen. four people are taken hostage. in response, the malaysian military doubles their troop presence in the area.

headline: drone attacks in pakistan
text: pakistan officials say that a us drone strike has killed 4 suspected insurgents in a car in datta khel in north waziristan.

text: a large landslide buries 83 gold miners in china's tibetan autonomous region near lhasa.

headline: nigerian sharia conflict
text: 11 people are killed in a gun and machete attack in a village of midlu in northern nigeria.

headline: northern mali conflict
text: 2013 kidal suicide attack: two suicide bombers kill three chadian soldiers and injure dozens of civilians at a market in kidal, mali.

headline: boston marathon bombings
text: organisers and security officials reassess security plans for sunday's 2013 london marathon. this follows yesterday's incident at the 2013 boston marathon which killed three people.
the 2012–13 nba season game between the indiana pacers and the boston celtics, which was originally scheduled for april 16, is cancelled after blasts in boston.

headline: war in north-west pakistan
text: a united states drone attack kills at least five people in the pakistani city of wana, located in the south waziristan agency.

headline: war in somalia
text: a somali journalist is shot and killed in an attack by unknown gunmen.

text: the royal canadian mounted police arrest and charge two men with plotting to disrupt a toronto area train service in a plot claimed to be backed by al-qaeda elements.

text: a bomb detonates in a busy shopping center in makhachkala, dagestan, russia, killing 3 and injuring 2 others.

headline: nigerian sharia conflict
text: an attack in nigeria, suspected to be perpetrated by islamic sect boko haram, kills 55 people.

headline: syrian civil war
text: heavy fighting is reported in qusair, syria, as the syrian army launches a major counter-offensive against rebel forces.

text: afghan security forces battle taliban insurgents in central kabul.   an afghan policeman, a nepalese soldier, and numerous insurgents are killed.

text: six people are killed in an attack by somali militants in police posts over the kenyan border.

text: twin suicide bombings in marjeh square in damascus kill at least 14 people and injure 31.

text: united nations peacekeepers from austria start withdrawing from the golan heights.

text: a major fire breaks out at the riga castle, the latvian presidential palace.

text: a bomb in a market street kills 4 people and wounds 47 others in eastern pakistan.

text: syrian officers reports that syrian army kills senior saudi arabian al-qaeda commander abu malik al-shahri, who is known as 'bin laden of syria', in outskirt of latakia.

text: 10 people are killed in a camp by insurgents in western afghanistan.

text: mahmoud badr, the founder of the tamarod grassroots movement that helped spark the july 2013 egyptian protests, reportedly survives an assassination attempt.

headline: iraqi insurgency
text: bomb attacks targeting both shi'ite muslims and sunnis kill at least 16 people in iraq.

text: explosions and gunfire are reported from the westgate shopping mall in nairobi where al-shabaab gunmen are still holed up.
the kenyan interior minister says that three gunmen were killed and that his troops are in control of all five floors of the building.

text: syrian rebels claim taking control of a military post on the edge of the city of deraa on syria's southern border with jordan after four days of heavy fighting with the syrian armed forces.

text: an explosion on the jaffar express, travelling between the pakistani cities of rawalpindi and quetta, kills 7 people and injures at least another 10.

text: two suicide car bombs explode south of damascus, syria, near a mosque killing many people.

french journalist yves debay is killed by a syrian sniper while he was covering clashed between syrian forces and rebels. in a separate incident, al jazeera reporter mohamed al-horani is killed by a syrian sniper while covering clashes in busra al-harir.

headline: in aménas hostage crisis
text: the algerian army stages a final assault on a gas facility near the town of in aménas, where militants took an unknown number of foreign workers hostage on january 16. totally at least 23 hostages and 32 terrorists were killed for the four days of crisis.

text: russian authorities announce a plan to evacuate 100 russian citizens from syria by sending in two passenger planes to beirut.

five people are hacked to death in maiduguri, nigeria, by members of the islamist sect boko haram.

headline: 2012–2013 egyptian protests
text: seven more people are killed and 630 injured during the funerals for 33 people killed the day before in port said.
in a televised statement, president of egypt mohamed morsi declares a 30-day state of emergency and a curfew from 9:00 pm to 6:00 am in the cities of port said, suez and ismaïlia.

headline: nigerian sharia conflict
text: suspected boko haram militants kill three doctors in the northeastern nigerian region of yobe. their nationality is disputed, with reports suggesting they are south korean, north korean or chinese.

text: president of afghanistan hamid karzai alleges that the u.s. armed forces are collaborating in some way with the afghan taliban in an effort to ensure that some troops remain after the scheduled 2014 pullout.

text: a car bombing in the center of the somali capital, mogadishu, kills at least 10 people and injures 20 others.

text: a roadside bombing kills the head of a local town council and a member of a provincial council in tuz khormato, saladin province, iraq.

text: at least one person is killed and 19 others are injured when a 6.0-magnitude earthquake strikes near taipei, taiwan, causing a fire and shaking buildings.

text: a battle for an airstrip in pibor county kills 143 rebels and 20 government troops. the rebels reportedly belong to a group led by david yau yau.

headline: war in afghanistan

text: a 6.1–magnitude earthquake rocks the iranian towns of khvormuj, bandar deyr and kangan, killing 37 people and injuring over 850, and was felt as far as bahrain.

text: mail to the us senate is suspended after letter sent to u.s. senator roger wicker  tests positive for the poisonous substance ricin at an offsite congressional mail facility. the letter is being sent to the fbi laboratory in quantico, virginia, for further testing.

headline: boston marathon bombings
text: michael bloomberg, the mayor of new york city, claims that the us federal bureau of investigation briefed him that suspect dzhokhar tsarnaev said that the bombers intended to attack new york city next.

headline: war in somalia
text: eight people are dead after a suicide bomber rams an explosive-laden car into a convoy carrying qatari officials through the center of somalia's capital mogadishu. al-shabaab claims responsibility for the attack.

headline: nigerian sharia conflict
text: 10 people are killed in an attack on a church and a local market in njilan, adamawa state, nigeria.

text: an afghan border police guard is killed and two pakistani troops are injured in border violence.

headline: insurgency in the north caucasus
text: a female suicide bomber injures at least 11 police officers and civilians, including two children, in makhachkala in the southern russian republic of dagestan.

text: an israeli official says the israeli government is looking into reports that syria received a shipment of s-300 missiles.
doctors in the besieged city of qusayr request urgent medical aid as they run out of supplies to treat eight-hundred wounded.
syrian state television reports that forces loyal to president bashar al-assad have killed three westerners including an american woman and a british man fighting for the opposition.

headline: 2013 european floods
text: austria, germany, switzerland and the czech republic are hit by floods after days of heavy rain.
the prime minister of the czech republic, petr necas, declares a state of emergency after two people die and the swollen vltava river threatens the centre of the capital prague.

headline: northern mali conflict
text: the government of mali opens talks with tuareg separatists in  the hopes of reaching a ceasefire agreement.

headline: 2013 protests in turkey
text: turkish police carry off dozens of lawyers, with reports that some have been kicked in the head and subjected to other assaults.
police move past the barricades in istanbul's taksim square, occupied by protesters.
riot police fill taksim square with tear gas, while clashes between protesters and police continue into the night.

headline: 2013 egyptian coup d'etat
text: egypt's military deposes president mohamed morsi, and installs adly mansour, the head of the supreme constitutional court, as the country's new interim leader.

the egyptian military takes control of state tv studios and places a travel ban on egyptian president mohamed morsi and other muslim brotherhood leaders as a military coup d'etat unfolds, following a week of anti-government unrest.
president morsi is reportedly placed under house arrest as troops deploy across cairo and  armored vehicles and soldiers mass at cairo university and other key sites.

headline: 2013 korean crisis
text: north korea warns against an underway joint military drill by south korea and the united states, stating that the exercise could jeopardize a recent easing of tension on the korean peninsula.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: the taliban kills four afghan national army troops in an attack on an intelligence office near kabul.

headline: nigerian sharia conflict
text: fighting between boko haram and government-backed vigilantes in borno state leaves 18 dead.

headline: syrian civil war
text: united nations inspectors are investigating three alleged instances of use of chemical weapons in the syrian civil war since the ghouta chemical attack on 21 august.

headline: islamist insurgency in nigeria
text: military officials report that 74 members of boko haram have been killed in a combined ground and aerial assault on militant camps in northeastern borno state.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: a roadside bomb in eastern afghanistan kills 18 people.

headline: israeli–palestinian conflict
text: after having rocks hurled at them, israeli troops respond and shoot dead a palestinian man in the west bank.
an ied injures 5 idf soldiers, causing clashes that leave 2 hamas militiamen dead and 2 wounded.

headline: war in north-west pakistan
text: a u.s. drone strike kills hakimullah mehsud, the leader of the pakistani taliban  and five others.

headline: typhoon haiyan
text: philippine president benigno aquino iii encamps in tacloban to oversee the rescue and relief operations after receiving criticism for his disorganized response early into the tragedy.

headline: war in north-west pakistan
text: gunmen kill five female teachers and two other people in an ambush on a van carrying workers home from their jobs at a community center in khyber pakhtunkhwa province, pakistan.

headline: northern mali conflict
text: the malian army retakes the town of hombori after driving islamist forces out.

headline: chibombo bus crash
text: at least 53 people are killed in a crash involving a bus and truck in zambia.  .

headline: nigerian sharia conflict
text: nine women are shot to death in the nigerian city of kano. according to reports, all of them were involved in a polio vaccination policy and were most probably killed by the islamist movement boko haram, which has previously threatened to target those involved in vaccinations.

headline: insurgency in the north caucasus
text: four police officers are killed and five injured after a suicide bombing in the russian republic of dagestan.

text: after intense fighting 40,000 people become displaced in the city of shadadah, hasakah, adding to the 3 million people already internally displaced in syria.
