text: the greek-owned oil tanker mt smyrni is released along with its 26 crew members for a reported ransom of $9.5 million after being held hostage for 10 months.

headline: 2013 in pakistan
text: hundreds of christian protestors clash with police across pakistan after the burning of christian houses in lahore.

headline: syrian civil war
text: at least 42 people are killed and 84 injured after a reported suicide bombing at a damascus mosque. senior pro-government sunni cleric mohammed al-buti is amongst those killed.

president of the syrian national coalition moaz al-khatib condemns the attack, while placing his suspicion on the syrian government for orchestratring it. the free syrian army denies involvement in the attack on the grounds that it doesn't target mosques.

headline: 2012–13 central african republic conflict
text: rebels in the central african republic reportedly take the presidential palace in bangui, as president françois bozizé flees to the neighbouring democratic republic of congo.

headline: nigerian sharia conflict
text: 25 people are killed in coordinated attacks by unidentified men armed with machine guns, bombs and rocket-propelled grenades in northern nigeria adamawa state.

headline: israeli–palestinian conflict
text: israeli warplanes strike targets in the gaza strip in response to rocket fire, the first air strikes launched by israel since an informal ceasefire ended eight days of cross-border fighting between israel and hamas-ruled gaza in november 2012.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: thirteen soldiers of the afghan national army are killed and one is injured in an ambush in the eastern kunar province.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: 11 people are kidnapped in afghanistan after the helicopter they were in was forced to land. the taliban takes responsibility for the abductions.

headline: 2013 hawija clashes
text: at least 28 are dead and more than 70 are injured as violence breaks out in hawija, iraq, between police forces and sunni muslim activists.
two roadside bombs detonate outside a sunni mosque killing at least 4 people and wounding 13 in dora, baghdad, iraq.

headline: iraqi insurgency
text: at least 14 members of the sons of iraq are killed in two separate attacks within fallujah.

headline: 2013 savar building collapse
text: the death toll reaches 1,126 with many people still missing; the accident is now the third worst industrial disaster in history.

headline: iraqi insurgency
text: a string of bombings, most of them in sunni areas of iraq, kill at least 90 people and injured more than 200 others.

headline: insurgency in the north caucasus
text: twin car bombs explode in makhachkala, capital of the russian republic of dagestan, killing 4 and injuring almost 50 others. hours later authorities announced they have foiled a terror attack in moscow.

headline: war in north-west pakistan
text: gunmen kill one anti-polio worker and wound three others

headline: war in afghanistan
text: taliban insurgents attack two checkpoints in the kamdesh district in eastern afghanistan killing four afghan police officers

headline: war in afghanistan
text: a suicide bombing in eastern afghanistan kills at least 20 people, including 10 children.

headline: war in north-west pakistan
text: thirty-five militants and one soldier are killed in fighting in the khyber agency tribal region of northwest pakistan in an operation.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: seven heavily armed taliban militants launch a coordinated attack near the main international airport of the afghan capital, kabul, and seize a five-story building under construction nearby.  afghan security forces retake the building, killing all seven militants and sustaining no military or civilian casualties.

headline: 2013 north india floods
text: bad weather hampers rescue efforts in uttarakhand state where nearly 150 people have died.

headline: 2013 alberta floods
text: extensive flooding begins throughout southern alberta, canada, leading to the evacuation of more than 100,000 people, notably in the city of calgary and town of high river.  it would become the costliest natural disaster in canadian history.

headline: iraqi insurgency
text: a wave of market bomb attacks mostly targeting shi'ite muslims kills 46 people

headline: war in afghanistan
text: nato forces in afghanistan launch an investigation after a us airstrike in nangarhar province kills five afghan policemen and injures another two.

headline: syrian civil war
text: the arab league discusses the ongoing crisis in syria at a closed-door meeting in cairo.
secretary of state john kerry asserts the united states now has evidence of sarin gas use in syria from hair and blood samples.

headline: sinai insurgency
text: the egyptian army launches a major operation against islamist militants in north sinai killing at least 30 people.

headline: post-civil war violence in libya
text: on the first anniversary of the 2012 benghazi attack, a powerful car bomb explodes near the libyan foreign ministry building in the city.

headline: iraqi insurgency
text: bombings in baghdad and shia provinces kill at least 21 people.

headline: iraqi insurgency
text: gunmen shoot down a military helicopter in northern iraq killing all four crew members.

headline: cyclone phailin
text: india's odisha and andhra pradesh prepare for storm.

headline: israeli–palestinian conflict
text: two rockets fired from the gaza strip at a southern israeli coastal city are shot down.

headline: typhoon haiyan
text: philippines: a philippines police official estimates that 10,000 people have died in the central province of leyte.
vietnam: 600,000 civilians have been evacuated.

headline: iraqi insurgency
text: 39 people are killed in iraq in attacks against shiites muslims.

headline: typhoon haiyan
text: the world bank offers a us$500 million loan to the philippines.

headline: colombian conflict
text: 13 farc members are killed in an airstrike by  the colombian military.

headline: january 2013 pakistan bombings
text: twin bombings at a billiard hall in the southwestern pakistani city of quetta kill at least 81 people and wound up to 120 others, hours after a bombing at a market area killed 11 people in the same city.

headline: northern mali conflict
text: islamists rebels capture the malian town of diabaly after fierce fighting with government troops, as french airplanes strike targets in gao.

headline: 2013 saltsjöbanan train crash
text: a saltsjöbanan commuter train crashes into a residential building in the upscale stockholm suburb of saltsjöbaden seriously injuring one person.

headline: northern mali conflict
text: battle of konna:
the military of mali recaptures the town of konna three days after french jets drove out islamist militants.

headline: senkaku islands dispute
text: a japan coast guard ship engages a taiwanese ship carrying activists bound for the senkaku islands.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: a suicide bombing at a market in the afghan city of kunduz kills at least ten people and wounds up to twenty others.

headline: 2013 pretoria train collision
text: two passenger trains packed with schoolchildren and rush-hour commuters collide near pretoria, south africa, injuring up to 300 people in a crash.

headline: piracy in somalia
text: the uae-owned chemical tanker mv royal grace is released along with its crew of 20 for an undisclosed ransom amount after being held hostage for over a year.

headline: 2013 berlin helicopter crash
text: two helicopters collide and crash near berlin's olympic stadium in germany, killing the pilot of one helicopter and injuring four people.

headline: 2012–13 central african republic conflict
text: seleka chief michel djotodia declares himself president of the central african republic and promises to retain power-sharing government as part of peace deal and put end to looting.
south africa's president jacob zuma says that thirteen of the country's soldiers were killed in the central african republic as rebels seized the capital, bangui.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: an explosive-laden donkey is used in an attack on a police security post in the alingar district of laghman province in eastern afghanistan, killing a policeman and wounding three civilians.

headline: sudanese nomadic conflicts
text: tribal violence in darfur, sudan, kills at least 163 people and displaces 50,000 others.

headline: mexican drug war
text: at least 14 people are killed in a series of clashes between alleged drug traffickers and police in the mexican state of michoacán. the government states that a high-profile drug lord was killed in the battle.

headline: syrian civil war
text: at least 57 people are killed by the syrian army in the towns of sanamayn and ghabaghib, daraa governorate, syria.

headline: iraqi insurgency
text: 18 april 2013 baghdad bombing: at least 27 people, including two children, are killed and 65 injured in a bomb attack on a cafe in the iraqi capital baghdad.
at least five people are killed in separate incidents in iraq including a suspected al-qaida leader in mosul.

headline: nigerian sharia conflict
text: in nigeria, a clash between the military and islamic extremists leaves at least 185 people dead.

headline: 2013 belgorod shooting
text: a man goes on a shooting rampage outside a firearm shop in belgorod, russia, killing six.

headline: syrian civil war
text: the 11th-century minaret of the umayyad great mosque at the world heritage site of aleppo is destroyed. both warring parties blame each other. ,

headline: war in afghanistan
text: the taliban announces the start of their spring offensive, signaling plans to step up attacks as the weather warms across afghanistan, making both travel and fighting easier.
a plane crashes in southern afghanistan killing four military personnel.

headline: 2013 savar building collapse
text: the death toll in bangladesh rises to 547.
bangladesh's finance minister, abul maal abdul muhith, downplays the impact of last week's factory-building collapse on his country's garment industry.
a top investigator probing the disaster says that vibrations from four huge generators placed on the roof of the building caused it to collapse. ,

headline: war in afghanistan
text: five us soldiers are killed when a bomb detonates in kandahar, afghanistan. additionally, three more are killed in separate incidents.

headline: syrian civil war
text: israeli forces, in a second attack in as many days, bomb a weapons shipment of sophisticated missiles suspected as being transported from syria to hezbollah in lebanon.
activists claim that 77 people are massacred in the syrian city of baniyas by government forces; the government claims it was fighting against "terrorist groups."

headline: syrian civil war
text: israeli aircraft hit at least six targets near damascus, targeting iranian-made fateh-110 missile shipments en route to hezbollah.
syria's foreign ministry accuses israel of helping and working with the syrian rebels to coordinate airstrikes

headline: 2013 european floods
text: the swollen elbe river breaches its banks forcing german authorities to evacuate 10 villages. so far, 21 people have died across central europe.
floodwaters subside in budapest after the danube reaches record levels.

headline: syrian civil war
text: the united nations estimates that the death toll was just under 93,000 as at the end of april.
the united states establishes and concludes that the syrian president bashar al-assad's regime has used chemical weapons.

headline: nigerian sharia conflict
text: seven students and two teachers are killed in a suspected boko haram attack on a secondary school in damaturu, nigeria.

headline: syrian civil war spillover in lebanon
text: six lebanese army soldiers are killed and several others injured in clashes at a checkpoint on the outskirts of sidon.

headline: iraqi insurgency
text: a wave of twelve car bombs targeting shiite communities in iraq kills at least 44 people.

headline: 2013 embassy closures
text: the united states department of state evacuates staff from the united states embassy in yemen due to an al-qaida threat.

headline: sinai insurgency
text: israel intercepts and destroys a grad rocket fired by mujahideen shura council al-qaeda members from egyptian territory at the red sea town of eilat.

headline: 2013 sudan floods
text: the who reports that floods in sudan have affected 320,000 people and killed almost 50 people.

headline: mexican drug war
text: mexican forces arrest alberto carrillo fuentes, the alleged leader of the juárez cartel.

headline: battle of zamboanga city
text: the armed forces of the philippines launch a helicopter strike against moro national liberation front rebels holed up in parts of the  city of zamboanga.

headline: al-qaeda insurgency in yemen
text: separate attacks on army bases in shabwa governorate kill at least 38 soldiers and 8 militants.

headline: operation linda nchi
text: a gun battle breaks out in a shopping mall in the kenyan capital nairobi with "at least 39 dead and 150 wounded". a hostage situation is evolving. al-shabaab claims responsibility.

headline: iraqi insurgency
text: suicide bombers targeting police and local officials in rawa, northwest of baghdad, kill 15 people.
at least 37 people are killed in a suicide bombing at a cafe in the shia-dominated area of baghdad.

headline: post-civil war violence in libya
text: rival militias battle each other in firefights on the streets of tripoli. no deaths are reported despite the use of rocket-propelled grenades and anti-aircraft artillery by the combatants.

headline: war in north-west pakistan
text: the pakistani taliban names maulana fazlullah as its new leader six days after hakimullah mehsud was killed in a drone attack in north waziristan.

headline: m23 rebellion
text: m23 rebel chief sultani makenga, along with hundreds of rebels, surrenders to authorities in mgahinga gorilla national park, uganda.

headline: syrian civil war
text: north korea denies giving military aid to syria.
hezbollah vows to keep fighters in syria.
albania says it will not allow the destruction of syrian chemical weapons on its soil after days of protests.

headline: syrian civil war battle of qalamoun
text: the syrian army captures the town of qarah.

headline: islamist insurgency in nigeria
text: gunmen kill 12 people in a raid on a northeastern nigerian village.

headline: syrian civil war
text: forty-eight iranians who were kidnapped by free syrian army rebels in the capital damascus in august 2012 are released in exchange for  2,130 prisoners held by the syrian government.

headline: 2013 vienna train collision
text: two trains packed with morning commuters collide in vienna suburb, austria, leaving 41 people injured, five of them seriously.

headline: war in north-west pakistan
text: at least 24 militants are killed in clashes between the tehrik-e-taliban and ansarul islam in pakistan near the border with afghanistan.

headline: northern mali conflict
text: french forces prepare an attack on timbuktu to defeat islamists, as more african troops are sent into mali.

headline: northern mali conflict
text: the uk announces it will deploy 330 military personnel to mali and other west african countries in support of french forces operating in the area.
french troops take timbuktu while tuareg forces of mnla claim they control the city of kidal in the north of mali.

headline: iraqi insurgency
text: a string of bombings kill at least 29 people and injure 69 others in central iraq, including twin blasts in baghdad's kadhimiya neighborhood, as well as the city of hilla.

headline: nigerian sharia conflict
text: seven french tourists are kidnapped by gunmen near waza national park in northern cameroon, near the border with nigeria.  president of france françois hollande states that the islamist group boko haram may be responsible.

headline: syrian civil war
text: rebels free 21 united nations peacekeepers who were held captive for four days.

headline: israeli–palestinian conflict
text: a palestinian protestor is killed by israeli forces after hurling stones and incendiary bottles in the west bank.

headline: syrian civil war
text: ahmad shihadeh, a member of the european union's delegation in syria, is killed in a rocket attack in a damascus suburb.

headline: south thailand insurgency
text: the thailand government prepares for peace talks with muslim separatist groups with the hope of ending a decade-long insurgency.

headline: central african republic conflict
text: south africa's president jacob zuma announces full withdrawal from the central african republic after criticism over death of 13 soldiers during the fall of the government there.

uganda's military orders army units hunting for joseph kony, the leader of the lord's resistance army in the central african republic to return to their bases, following political instability in the car. meanwhile the united states has offered a $5 million bounty for information  leading to his capture.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: afghanistan president hamid karzai denounces the reported death of eleven children at the hands of nato forces in kunar province and orders a government inquiry into the killings.
taliban fighters are suspected of being responsible for a bus explosion that kills at least nine people and injures more than twenty others in maidan wardak province, afghanistan.

headline: boston marathon bombings
text: two explosions in boston, united states, near the finish line of the 2013 boston marathon leave 3 people dead and 183 injured.
the pakistani taliban denies any involvement in the boston marathon bombings.

headline: boston marathon bombings
text: the u.s. fbi recovers forensic evidence suggesting the two explosive devices which exploded near the finish line of the 2013 boston marathon were pressure cooker bombs, placed inside heavy black nylon bags containing shrapnel.

an episode of the popular u.s. sitcom family guy is pulled by the fox network over its depiction of people being run over by a car at the boston marathon. the film four lions is also pulled by film4 due to the hysteria surrounding the recent boston marathon bombings in which three people died.

headline: boston marathon bombings
text: prosecutors discuss a plea deal  for the surviving boston bomber, dzhokhar tsarnaev. police have taken dna from tamerlan tsarnaev's wife and are exploring the brothers' connection to two deceased russian extremists.

headline: 2013 savar building collapse
text: the death toll in bangladesh rises to 823.

headline: boston marathon bombings
text: suspect tamerlan tsarnaev is buried in the al-barzakh cemetery in doswell, virginia, united states.

evidence mounts that the brothers may be involved in an unsolved triple murder in waltham, massachusetts, united states from september 11, 2011 - one of the victims, brendan mess, was once a roommate of tamerlan.

headline: 2013 north india floods
text: the death toll from several days of heavy rain, flooding, and landslides in uttarakhand, uttar pradesh, and himachal pradesh, hits 99.
more than 73,000 religious pilgrims and 1,700 tourists are stranded.

headline: 2012–2013 egyptian protests
text: demonstrations across egypt gather about 15 million people nationwide calling for the resignation of egyptian president mohammed morsi.
at least 16 people, including an american, have been killed, and 800 injured, in the anti-government demonstrations that began last week.

egyptian army officials issue a 48-hour ultimatum to the muslim brotherhood-linked government of president mohamed morsi to respond to the concerns of millions of protesters who have taken to the streets calling for morsi’s resignation, or it will “step in to restore order”.

headline: mexican drug war
text: the mexican army captures miguel treviño morales, the supreme leader of los zetas drug cartel.

headline: aftermath of the 2013 egyptian coup d'état
text: mass rival demonstrations are held across egypt three weeks after mohamed morsi was deposed as president in a military coup d'état. at least eight people die and hundreds are injured in violence during the rallies.

headline: syrian civil war
text: syrian rebels capture menagh military airbase in aleppo near the turkish border. ,
a car bomb kills 18 people and wounds 55 in a suburb in damascus.
a chemical attack on adra and houma in the damascus suburbs is reported.

headline: iraqi insurgency
text: two roadside bombs explode in the iraqi city of baqubah killing 14 and wounding 26 people.

headline: aftermath of 2013 egyptian coup d'état
text: the death toll from the previous day's clashes climbs to 638.
a government building is stormed and set on fire by the muslim brotherhood in cairo.
president barack obama cancels joint military exercises between the united states and egypt.

headline: political violence in egypt
text: israel to call on us, eu to support egyptian army ,
dozens of muslim brotherhood supporters are killed in prison while attempting to escape police custody. ,

headline: syrian civil war
text: american president barack obama says that he is ready to order a limited strike, but will seek approval from congress.
the un inspectors leave damascus after concluding their inspection.
several countries advise their citizens against traveling to lebanon as regional tensions grow over a possible us military strike on syria.

headline: syrian civil war
text: the united nations confirms the use of sarin gas in the ghouta attacks.

headline: westgate centre shooting
text: the death toll from the westgate centre shooting in nairobi, kenya, reaches 59 with 175 injured.
kenyan troops launch an assault on cornered somali militants holding hostages inside the shopping mall to end the deadly siege.

headline: post-civil war clashes in libya
text: gunmen attack a military checkpoint near bani walid leaving 15 soldiers dead.

headline: syrian civil war
text: at least 21 civilians are killed when their minibus hits a land mine in southern syrian town of nawa, with opposition activists blaming the syrian army. ,

headline: typhoon haiyan
text: philippines: the red cross says that 10,000 people are confirmed dead. it reported that at least 1,000 had been killed in tacloban and 200 in samar province.

vietnam: the government mobilizes over 453,000 soldiers and militia members, and thousands of means of transport to cope with typhoon haiyan that is forecast to hit central region early sunday. roughly 20,000 people are evacuated from da nang.

headline: iraqi insurgency
text: a series of attacks in baghdad and north iraq kills four policemen and wounds dozens.

headline: 2013 north indian ocean cyclone season
text: cyclone helen hits india's andhra pradesh state killing at least six people and knocking out power to thousands of villages.

headline: syrian civil war
text: rebel forces take over the strategic taftanaz airbase in northern syria.

headline: kachin conflict
text: myanmar government forces shell the rebel stronghold of laiza for the first time since the resumption of hostilities in 2011, killing 3 civilians and injuring 6 others.

headline: 2011–present libyan factional fighting
text: a police officer is wounded after a grenade attack in benghazi, as italy announces the temporary withdrawal of the country's consulate in the city after an unsuccessful attack against the consul two days earlier.

headline: syrian civil war
text: aleppo university bombings: 83 people are killed and more than 150 injured in a rocket barrage aimed at aleppo university, as government forces and rebels continue fighting in the suburbs of damascus. both sides accused each other of launching the missiles.

headline: 2011–2013 iraqi protests
text: ongoing protests by sunni muslims in iraq against the government of prime minister nouri al-maliki turn deadly, as clashes leave 7 protesters and 2 soldiers dead in fallujah. more than 60 others are injured, and at least 3 soldiers are kidnapped by unidentified gunmen.

headline: syrian civil war
text: reports claim that elite syrian military forces shell the town of darayya just southwest of damascus.

headline: northern mali conflict
text: french troops take over timbuktu airport as they enter the city without any resistance from the islamists. residents report that the french now control all access to the city.
the fleeing islamists set on fire the timbuktu library containing the timbuktu manuscripts. the extent of the damage is still unknown.

headline: syrian civil war
text: at least 20 people die in aleppo, syria, after an apartment complex is struck by a rocket belonging to the forces of bashar assad.

headline: south thailand insurgency
text: a roadside bombing in thailand's southern yala province kills 5 soldiers and injures three others.

headline: february 2013 quetta bombing
text: at least 84 people are killed and more than 190 injured after a bomb explodes at a market in hazara town on the outskirts of quetta, in pakistan. most of the victims are members of the predominantly twelver shia hazara minority that was targeted by lashkar-e-jhangvi only a month earlier. the organization later claims responsibility for the blasts.

headline: 2013 bangladesh protests
text: at least four people are dead in bangladesh following clashes between the islamists and the police.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: taliban insurgents kill 17 afghan government-affiliated militia personnel in an overnight attack in andar district of eastern ghazni province.

headline: nigerian sharia conflict
text: nigerian militant group ansaru announces that it has killed seven foreigners that were being held hostage.

headline: 2013 srinagar attack
text: five indian paramilitary soldiers are killed and three civilians injured by two militants near a school in bemina area of srinagar in indian-administered kashmir, later two militants being killed by crpf.

headline: al-qaeda insurgency in yemen
text: two al-qaeda fighters and two pro-government militiamen are killed in clashes in jaar, yemen.

headline: golan heights clashes
text: israeli soldiers fire an anti-tank missile at a syrian army post after coming under fire for the second time in 12 hours in the golan heights area.

headline: syrian civil war
text: mortar fire hits damascus university cafeteria section killing 15 students and injuring 7 others.

headline: mexican drug war
text: recent report from stratfor indicates that at least 60 people were killed in tamaulipas state in march, after the gulf cartel leaders miguel el gringo villarreal and mario ramírez treviño fought for control of the organization.

headline: 2013 bangalore blast
text: sixteen people, including eight policemen, are injured in a bomb blast at a bjp office in bangalore, india, weeks ahead of elections in the state of karnataka.

headline: 2013 ricin attacks
text: further suspicious letters are found addressed to president barack obama and to members of the united states senate.
the united states senate is evacuated following the scare.

headline: war in north-west pakistan
text: at least eight people are dead and dozens injured as a result of tehrik-i-taliban pakistan attacks on election candidates in kohat and peshawar.

headline: communist insurgency in the philippines
text: new people's army attack a mining site at sipalay, negros occidental and burn equipment. a firefight ensues leaving five soldiers dead and two wounded.

headline: syrian civil war
text: rebels shoot down a syrian military helicopter in deir ez-zor governorate killing all eight soldiers on board.

a un official on a swiss television station says the un has "concrete" suspicions that the rebels have used sarin gas. the un later released a statement in response stressing that it has not reached any official conclusions, and has yet to have acquired proof that either side used chemical weapons. ,

headline: war in north-west pakistan
text: a suicide car bombing hits a police station in the bannu district of northwest pakistan, killing at least two people and injuring twenty.

headline: iraqi insurgency
text: a wave of violence continues, with attacks across the country killing 133 and leaving 283 others injured. almost 400 people have been killed in the last six days alone, as tribal leaders warn of impending civil war.

headline: syrian civil war
text: dozens of people are killed in al-qusayr, homs, syria, as the syrian army and hezbollah bombard the rebel-held town with heavy artillery.

headline: syrian civil war
text: united states senator john mccain travels to syria to meet with rebel fighters and discuss with them america's possible involvement in the nation's civil war.
le monde reports continued use of chemical weapons by the assad regime in syria.
russia evacuates 130 people as the situation in syria continues to worsen.

headline: syrian civil war
text: a car bomb explodes near a police station in the damascus suburb of jobar, killing at least eight members of the security forces and injuring civilians.

headline: syrian civil war
text: the syrian army regains control of the strategic town of al-qusayr, as rebels pull out.
in an official statement, the iranian government congratulates the syrian army and people for capturing al-qusayr.

headline: iraqi insurgency
text: twin suicide bombings kill 31 and wound another 60 in al-qahira, baghdad.

headline: war in north-west pakistan
text: a suicide blast kills 27 and wounds over 30 others at a funeral in sher garh, mardan, khyber pakhtunkhwa, pakistan.

headline: war in somalia
text: an al-shabaab-led assault on the undp base in mogadishu leaves 22 dead, including militants, security personnel, and civilians.

headline: nigerian sharia conflict
text: islamic extremists kill 42 people, mainly students, in an attack on the government secondary school boarding school in the nigerian town of mamudo in yobe state.

headline: syrian civil war
text: the syrian army launches a large missile on the southern damascus neighborhood of yarmouk, largely inhabited by palestinian refugees.

headline: iraqi insurgency
text: eight people are killed and 25 are injured in a suicide bomb attack on a cafe in balad north of the iraqi capital baghdad.

headline: syrian civil war
text: a team of twenty un weapons inspectors arrives in the capital, damascus, to investigate the alleged use of chemical weapons in the conflict.

headline: war in north-west pakistan
text: a roadside bomb targeting a passing pakistani army convoy kills nine soldiers in north waziristan near pakistan's border with afghanistan.

headline: hurricane manuel
text: more than 2,000 tourists have been airlifted by the mexican army after floods caused by hurricane manuel isolate the resort city of acapulco with many tourists and residents stranded.
at least 58 people are missing after a mudslide caused by hurricane manuel buries approximately 70 people in the mexican town of atoyac de alvarez.

headline: political violence in egypt, 2013
text: egyptian security forces clash with militants in the town of kerdasah on the outskirts of cairo with one member of the security forces dead.

headline: islamic insurgency in the philippines
text: zamboanga city crisis: six people die in the philippines city of zamboanga as fighting continues between the army and moro national liberation front insurgents.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: a bomb in a mosque in afghanistan's logar province kills the governor arsala jamal and results in other injuries.

headline: syrian civil war
text: the al-nusra front captures the syriac orthodox village of sadad, killing at least 9 people and sparking heavy fighting with syrian army forces.
syrian rebels attack a gas pipeline close to damascus international airport, causing a country-wide power outage.

headline: sinai insurgency
text: at least 11 egyptian army soldiers are reported killed and 37 are injured following a suicide bomb attack in the city of al-arish.

headline: syrian civil war
text: the president of syria bashar al-assad delivers a rare television appearance addressing the syrian crisis and denounces the syrian rebels as "enemies of god and puppets of the west". it is his first television appearance since june 2012.

headline: belfast city hall flag protests
text: in a fifth night of protests in belfast, protestors throw rocks, "missiles", and petrol bombs at police, with law enforcement responding with water cannons and plastic bullets.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: the afghan national directorate of security headquarters in kabul are attacked by a team of suicide bombers, leaving a security guard dead and 17 others injured.

headline: northern mali conflict
text: the number of french forces in the country rises to 1,400, more than half of the planned 2,500 strong force, as its troops continue to fight insurgents in konna and diabaly. chad prepares to send the first 200 troops of a 2000-strong force to assist in the military operations as part of a regional mission. the european union votes to send 450 to 500 "non-combat" troops to mali, half of them are trainers.
the first west african troops enter mali. 100 soldiers from the togolese military enter the country with nigerian military due to enter shortly afterward.

text: chadian soldiers kill over 200 boko haram fighters in a clash near the town of garambu, close to nigeria's border with cameroon. one chad army soldier is killed and nine wounded.

suicide bombers target two crowded bus stations in potiskum and kano in northern nigeria, killing at least 27 people in nearly daily violence in the embattled region. there is no claim of responsibility for either blast, but both bore the hallmarks of militant group boko haram.

headline: yemeni crisis
text: islamic state claims responsibility for suicide bombings in shiite mosques in sanaa that kill 142 people.

headline: yemeni crisis
text: the united nations security council meets to discuss the deteriorating security situation in yemen as the united states removes all remaining personnel.
shia houthis rebels capture the strategically important city of ta'izz.

headline: iraqi insurgency
text: at least seven people are dead after a car bomb blast south of baghdad.

headline: 2015 libya migrant shipwreck
text: up to 400 people may have died as a boat capsizes in the mediterranean sea between libya and italy with up to 550 passengers on board.

headline: islamic state of iraq and the levant
text: fierce clashes in iraq's anbar province as islamic state captures three villages near the provincial capital ramadi.

headline: yemeni civil war
text: al-qaeda in the arabian peninsula captures riyan airport, seaport and oil terminal in the city of al mukalla in southern yemen.
in the past two weeks, oman has received 2,695 people of forty-eight nationalities escaping from yemen.

headline: yemeni civil war
text: an airstrike on an alleged scud missile base in sana'a causes a huge explosion.
the united states sends aircraft carrier uss theodore roosevelt and cruiser uss normandy to block an iranian convoy heading towards yemen.

headline: operation protective edge
text: the united nations security council calls for an immediate ceasefire on the gaza strip after an emergency meeting.

headline: donbass war
text: the international committee of the red cross , guardian of the geneva convention, makes a confidential legal assessment that ukraine is officially in a war, western diplomats and officials say, opening the door to possible war crimes prosecutions, including over the downing of malaysia airlines flight 17.

headline: operation protective edge
text: a 72-hour ceasefire brokered by the un and usa which began at 08:00 falls apart with each side accusing the other party of breaching the ceasefire. an israeli soldier is kidnapped and several killed during a suicide bomber attack at 09:30, according to israeli officials. 91 palestinians were killed in the city of rafah south of gaza according to the gaza officials since the israeli soldier was captured. the un and usa strongly condemn the attack. the ceasefire was cancelled.
2 palestinians are shot dead by israeli security forces during clashes in the west bank.

headline: 2014 northern iraq offensive
text: the islamic state seizes the yazidi-dominated town of sinjar.  it also seized control of the mosul dam, which is iraq's biggest dam, the ain zalah oil field, and two more towns.

headline: sinai insurgency
text: eleven egyptian army soldiers are killed in a roadside bomb attack in the sinai peninsula.

headline: islamist insurgency in nigeria
text: at least 13 people are dead and 34 injured after boko haram gunmen attack a government college in the northern nigerian city of kano.

headline: islamic state in iraq and the levant
text: tens of thousands of kurds flee into turkey ahead of an isil offensive.

headline: war in donbass
text: the ukrainian military say they have repelled a renewed assault by the pro-russian forces on the donetsk international airport. the airport has been under sustained assaults for over 2 weeks despite an official ceasefire.

headline: syrian civil war
text: 18,000 palestinians are facing life-threatening shortages of water in the yarmouk camp neighborhood of damascus.

headline: al-qaeda insurgency in yemen
text: al-qaeda launches an attack on the south yemen town of al-bayda killing at least four soldiers before being beaten back by the army.

headline: 2014 shooting of sacramento police officers
text: luis enrique monroy bracamonte, the prime suspect in the shooting deaths of two northern california sheriff's deputies, is reported to be an illegal immigrant from mexico.

headline: israel-gaza conflict
text: the israel defense forces report a rocket fired from gaza landed in israeli territory with no injuries or damage.

headline: islamic state in iraq and the levant
text: islamic state militants claim to have captured the jahar gas fields in the syrian province of homs, the second gas field they have captured in a week.

headline: military intervention against isis
text: abu bakr al-baghdadi is critically wounded during a us airstrike at al-qaim.

headline: islamist unrest in egypt
text: gunmen attack an egyptian navy ship on the mediterranean sea with eight sailors missing and four injured after the attack. thirty-two of the gunmen have been captured with four reported as dead.

headline: 2014 iguala mass kidnapping
text: forensic specialists at the university of innsbruck confirm the identity of the first of the 43 missing students in guerrero. the remains were located at a municipal dump in cocula, guerrero.

headline: islamic state of iraq and the levant
text: the kurdish region’s military forces, the peshmerga ministry, states that over 700 iraqi kurds have died fighting isil forces since june.

headline: islamic state in iraq and the levant
text: iraqi officials claim that isil have shot down a military helicopter near samarra, killing both pilots.

headline: syrian civil war
text: around one hundred syrian soldiers and eighty islamist fighters die in a two-day battle for wadi deif, with the islamic front capturing over 120 government soldiers.

headline: indonesia airasia flight 8501
text: traveling through thunderstorms over the java sea, flight 8501 loses contact with air traffic control after the plane departed from the indonesian city of surabaya en route to singapore with 162 people on board.

headline: islamic state of iraq and the levant
text: clashes with isil in anbar province kill twenty-three iraqi army soldiers and allied sunni fighters.

the combined joint task force combating isil conducts ten airstrikes in syria, eight of them targeting the contested city of kobani, with the airstrikes destroying fourteen isil fighting positions and a building.

headline: al-qaeda insurgency in yemen
text: a car bomb explodes outside a police college in the yemeni capital sana'a with at least 38 people reported dead and more than 50 wounded. , ,

headline: islamic state of iraq and the levant
text: apparent isil computer hackers attack the feeds for the united states central command for twitter and youtube.

headline: syrian civil war
text: the united states department of defense announces that it will send 400 troops to train moderate syrian rebels in the spring of 2015.

headline: sectarianism in pakistan
text: sunni militants linked to the pakistani taliban kill at least 40 people and injure 50 in a bombing at a shiite mosque in the shikarpur district of pakistan's sindh province.

headline: islamic state of iraq and the levant
text: isil claims that the  american female hostage kayla jean mueller has been killed by jordanian airstrikes at the outskirts of raqqa, syria. the white house says that they have no proof of her death.   ,

headline: yemeni civil war
text: fighters from the al-qaeda affiliated ansar al-sharia take control of an army base in southern yemen.

headline: war in donbass
text: ahead of the upcoming february 15 start of the agreed ceasefire, fighting in the past 24 hours kills eight armed forces of ukraine service personnel.

headline: boko haram insurgency
text: boko haram militants attack chad for the first time after 30 fighters crossed lake chad in four motorboats and attacked the village of ngouboua. chad recently joined nigeria, niger, and cameroon in a military coalition against boko haram.

headline: war in donbass
text: during the ceasefire, fighting kills at least five ukrainian army soldiers with 22 injured.

the minister of foreign affairs of ukraine pavlo klimkin claims that pro-russian forces have fired on ukrainian forces over 100 times in the past day. separatists accuse ukrainian troops of having violated the ceasefire. fighting continues in the encirclement of the battle of debaltseve with separatist forces entering the city.

headline: war in donbass
text: the office of the president of ukraine calls on the european union and nato to condemn the russian-backed rebels for military action in debaltseve. the self-proclaimed rebel government officials claim the town was not part of the recently established ceasefire.

headline: war in somalia
text: at least 20 people are killed, including senior officials, in an attack on the central hotel in mogadishu.

headline: military intervention against isil
text: john key, the prime minister of new zealand, announces plans to deploy up to 143 new zealand defence force personnel to iraq on a training mission to last no more than two years.
a wave of bombings in baghdad kills at least 37 people.

headline: villa castelli helicopter collision
text: two helicopters collide in mid-air in a remote area of northwestern argentina leaving at least ten dead. among the dead are a group of french sports stars participating in a reality-television show called dropped: , ,
florence arthaud - a yachtswoman
camille muffat - a 2012 summer olympics gold medal swimmer
alexis vastine - a 2008 summer olympics bronze medal boxer

headline: germanwings flight 9525
text: a search and recovery operation resumes for the remains of the germanwings flight that crashed into the french alps on march 24.
an audio recording indicates that a pilot was locked out of the cockpit at the time of the crash and was unable to reenter.

headline: air canada flight 624
text: air canada flight 624 skids off the runway at halifax stanfield international airport, after arriving from toronto shortly past midnight. all 133 passengers and 5 crews on board survive, with 23 treated for minor injuries.

headline: germanwings flight 9525
text: data from the flight data recorder reveals that the plane was deliberately accelerated before crashing into the french alps.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: gunmen mount an attack on the office of the attorney-general of afghanistan's balkh province in the city of mazar-e-sharif.

headline: australian east coast low
text: three people have died in floods in the australian town of dungog, new south wales as heavy rains and cyclonic winds hits the state of new south wales causing widespread flooding, loss of power to over 100,000 homes and disruption of transport services.

headline: april 2015 nepal earthquake
text: the death toll from the earthquakes in nepal rises to more than 3,700 with reports that tens of thousands of people are homeless. there are fears that the death toll could rise to over 5,000. ,

headline: mexican drug war
text: three mexican army soldiers die as gunfire downs a helicopter in the state of jalisco. ten soldiers and two federal police officers are injured.
a pri/pvem mayoral candidate in the city of chilapa de álvarez,  guerrero, is assassinated.

headline: australian east coast low
text: four people have died in south east queensland in flood waters triggered by heavy rain.

headline: iraqi insurgency
text: three bombs explode in baghdad killing at least fifteen people.

headline: 2014 pacific typhoon season
text: typhoon matmo  is expected to make landfall over taiwan en route to eastern china later in the week.

headline: 2014 pacific typhoon season
text: the total death toll for typhoon rammasun  reaches 151 as typhoon matmo  hits taiwan. typhoon matmo has been described as a likely cause of the crash of transasia airways flight 222.  ,

headline: 2014 pro-russian unrest in ukraine
text: the ukrainian azov battalion say that they and the 39th battalion of the dnipropetrovsk territorial defense have recaptured control of novy svit in donetsk oblast from pro-russian insurgents.

64 percent of polled russians think that the ukraine crisis was caused by western "interference" and 55 percent believe that russia should continue supporting pro-moscow separatists even if it could lead to a full-fledged civil war or even world war iii, a poll shows.
ukrainian forces recapture control of stepanivka  in luhansk oblast from pro-russian insurgents.
the australian federal police and dutch police abandon efforts to reach the crash site of malaysia airlines flight 17 due to escalating tensions.
the eu approves tougher sanctions on russia.

headline: 2014 israel–gaza conflict
text: israeli shelling of a unrwa school in jabaliya refugee camp kills at least 19 palestinian civilians and wounds scores more.

three idf soldiers are killed and fifteen injured when trying to disarm an ied rigged smuggling tunnel found at a unrwa run health clinic in khan younis. since the start of operation protective edge 56 idf soldiers and over 1200 palestinian civilians and militants have been killed.
iran's supreme leader, ayatollah ali khamenei, offers to donate weapons to the west bank to better hit israeli cities such as tel aviv.

headline: 2014 pro-russian unrest in ukraine war in donbass
text: vladimir antyufeyev, a russian citizen and veteran of the pro-russian separatist rebellion in moldova, takes over as head of donetsk people's republic rebellion after self-labeled "prime minister" alexander borodai reportedly disappeared for russia.

headline: 2014 pro-russian unrest in ukraine war in donbass
text: ukrainian forces retake control of the towns of krasnohorivka and staromykhailivka, outside the pro-russian rebels' stronghold of donetsk.

headline: nagorno-karabakh conflict 2014 armenian–azerbaijani line of contact clashes
text: five more azeri troops are killed in overnight fighting with ethnic armenians in nagorno-karabakh. the casualties bring the death toll to at least 13 in a flare-up of violence over the last few days around nagorno-karabakh. russia has said that any further escalation is unacceptable.

headline: iraqi insurgency
text: fighters from the islamic state of iraq and syria clash with iraq's kurdish minority in the north of the country.
iraq government television reports that an iraqi air force strike has killed 60 militants.
at least 51 people are killed in a series of car bombings in baghdad.

headline: war in donbass
text: dozens of people die in heavy fighting between ukrainian government forces and rebels in eastern ukraine.

headline: iraqi insurgency
text: the un calls for action to prevent what it suspects may become a massacre in the northern iraqi town of amirli, which has been besieged by is forces since june.
at least 30 people are killed in bombings in baghdad and kirkuk.

headline: syrian civil war
text: the united nations estimates that three million syrians live as refugees overseas while another 6.5 million are displaced within syria.
syrian rebels attack the united nations disengagement observer force in the golan heights and capture 42 fijian peacekeepers while surrounding a base manned by 75 filipino soldiers.

headline: syrian civil war
text: thirty-two united nations peacekeepers from the philippines were evacuated under fire from the golan heights border checkpoint between syria and israel, while others remain under fire from groups including the al-nusra front.

headline: terrorism in saudi arabia
text: saudi arabian authorities announce they have arrested 88 people on suspicions of being part of an al-qaeda cell and plotting attacks inside and outside the kingdom.

headline: syrian civil war
text: a spokesman for the white house confirms that a video showing american journalist steven sotloff being beheaded is authentic.

a spokesman for israel's ministry of foreign affairs confirms that sotloff was a dual citizen of israel and the u.s., a fact that had been concealed during his captivity, including by sotloff himself.

headline: taliban insurgency
text: a suicide bomb attack kills the police chief of a district in southern kandahar province in afghanistan.

headline: naxalite–maoist insurgency
text: three maoists are killed and two are seriously injured in a fight with security forces in the giridih district of india's jharkhand state.

headline: islamic state of iraq and the levant
text: australia sends combat aircraft and special forces to the middle east to help in the fight against islamic state.

headline: syrian civil war
text: nearly 50 people have been killed in two days of syrian government airstrikes on the town of talbiseh in homs governorate.

headline: 2014 australian terror raids
text: australia raises security for its parliament after conducting raids that arrest dozens of suspected terrorists.

headline: war in donbass
text: renewed clashes around the donetsk international airport between the pro-russian rebels and ukrainian government troops kill at least 12 people in the worst flareup of violence since the ceasefire accord earlier in september.

headline: taliban insurgency
text: taliban suicide bombers attack an afghan national army convoy in kabul, killing at least 7 people and injuring 19.

headline: kashmir conflict
text: india and pakistan trade fire across the borders resulting in five civilian deaths in india and four in pakistan.

headline: gaza-israel conflict
text: peace talks between hamas and israel have been canceled after the hamas delegation was refused entry into egypt following recent attacks against the egyptian army.

headline: islamist insurgency in nigeria
text: a suicide bomber kills at least 47 students at a school assembly in the nigerian town of potiskum in yobe state.

text: al-shabaab militants hijack a bus travelling between the town of mandera and the kenyan capital nairobi and execute 28 non-muslim passengers.

text: the dutch safety board reports that it has finished work on recovery of the wreckage of malaysia airlines flight mh17.

headline: war in somalia
text: the red cross says that at least 36 people may be dead following an attack in mandera county in northeastern kenya. al-shabaab militants are believed to be responsible. ,

text: the israeli air force bombs two syrian armed forces bases near damascus and the town of dimas, according to russian and syrian sources.

headline: israeli–palestinian conflict
text: israel launches an airstrike against an alleged hamas base near khan yunis in retaliation for a rocket attack.

headline: iraqi insurgency
text: a suicide bombing in madaen among a group of pro-government sunni militiamen kills at least 33 people and leaves 55 others wounded.

headline: libyan civil war
text: five gunmen at the libyan corinthia hotel in tripoli attack with at least ten dead. the hotel was previously the location in 2013 where a former prime minister was abducted.

headline: 2014–15 north american winter
text: ten people die in cook county, illinois while shoveling snow.

headline: war in somalia
text: islamists from al-shabab kill a member of the parliament abdullahi qayad barre in the capital city of mogadishu, somalia.

headline: internal conflict in burma
text: several days of clashes with kokang rebels in the north of the country kills forty-seven myanmar army soldiers with dozens wounded.

headline: islamic state of iraq and the levant
text: isis burns more than 8,000 rare books and manuscripts in mosul, iraq.

headline: boko haram
text: forces from niger and chad launch a ground and air offensive against boko haram islamist militants in northeastern nigeria.

headline: yemeni crisis
text: the united states military evacuates the remaining 100 special operations forces members in the country due to the deteriorating security situation.

headline: germanwings flight 9525
text: a germanwings flight crashes en route from barcelona, spain, to düsseldorf, germany, in a mountainous region of the alps near digne-les-bains in  southern france leaving 150 dead. rescue workers recover the damaged, but still usable, cockpit voice recorder. ,

headline: war in somalia
text: nine people have been killed in a bomb attack on a convoy carrying food supplies to a united nations compound in garowe in the somali region of puntland.

headline: 2014 pacific typhoon season
text: the death toll from typhoon rammasun rises to 26 in southern china and 11 in northern vietnam.

headline: war in donbass
text: ukrainian forces say they recapture control of mala ivanivka and andrianivka from pro-russian insurgents, effectively isolating the rebel controlled city of horlivka.
