text: the cost, so far, of battling the wildfire  on california's scenic big sur coast is $206.7 million —  the costliest in u.s. history, according to the national interagency fire center. the blaze, which was first reported on july 22, is currently 67 percent contained.

headline: amos-6
text: spacex believes that the september 1 florida launch pad malfunction and explosion of its falcon 9 rocket and the facebook payload during routine preparation was likely due to a large breach in its upper-stage oxygen tank's helium system.

headline: iraqi civil war
text: iraqi prime minister haider al-abadi rejects turkey's claim that turkish forces must be included in an operation to retake the militant-held city of mosul.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: the vice president of afghanistan, abdul rashid dostum, survives yet another assassination attempt.

headline: 2016 pacific typhoon season
text: floods in central vietnam, triggered by typhoon sarika's heavy rains, kill at least 24 people with 4 others missing. sarika has killed at least two people and displaced more than 150,000 in the philippines.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: ghor province governor's spokesman claims isil insurgents killed 26-42 civilians in his governed province, afghanistan.

headline: iraqi civil war
text: battle of mosul , hamam al-alil massacre
iraqi army discover at least 100 beheaded bodies as they retake hamam al-alil, the last major settlement south of mosul.

headline: 2016 kaikoura earthquake
text: a 7.8 magnitude earthquake strikes north of christchurch, new zealand, in the early hours monday, triggering tsunami warnings and causing widespread damage. at least two people are reported killed.

headline: syrian civil war
text: the syrian observatory for human rights reports a car bomb has killed at least ten people in the city of azaz, aleppo governorate.
at least 10 people were killed and dozens injured in air strikes and artillery shelling by government forces in ghouta in the damascus countryside, substantial damaging to residential areas.
the syrian government targeted an international relief agency and palestinian refugee camp in khan sheha, which has been under siege for two months.
media reports say a hospital in aleppo neighborhood is bombed on night by the syrian government.

headline: 2016 atlantic hurricane season
text: hurricane otto makes landfall in nicaragua, becoming the southernmost hurricane on record to hit central america.
costa rica declares a national emergency as hurricane otto prepares to make landfall after killing at least three people in panama.

headline: november 2016 israel wildfires
text: around 50,000 people are evacuated as fires rage throughout the israeli city of haifa. the minister of public security gilad erdan says at least half the fires are to due to arson.
four palestinians have been arrested in connection to the fires.

headline: 2016 berlin attack
text: german officials offer a reward of up to 100,000 euros  for 24-year-old tunisian asylum-seeker anis amri, whose identifying information was found in the truck used in the attack.

headline: syrian civil war
text: the bodies of over 100 syrian army pows are reportedly found in what was the last rebel held territory of east aleppo. syrian army officers claim they were executed by rebel forces.

headline: 2016 djebel jelloud train accident
text: a train and a bus collide in tunis, tunisia, killing 5 and injuring around 52.

headline: boko haram insurgency
text: a nigerian air force jet mistakenly bombs a refugee camp in borno state, near the border with cameroon, killing at least 90 people and injuring more than 100. the pilot reportedly believed he was attacking boko haram militants.

headline: syrian civil war
text: palmyra offensive

syrian troops advance into palmyra on multiple fronts with the help of russian airstrikes and take several neighbourhoods, according to the syrian observatory for human rights. however they were unable to encircle the city.

headline: pkk rebellion
text: a bombing kills at least five turkish soldiers and one special forces police officer in the southeastern city of nusaybin, near the syria–turkey border.

headline: military intervention against isil
text: turkish armed forces shell isil positions hours after projectiles hit turkey's kilis province.

headline: sinai insurgency
text: at least seven people are killed, including five egyptian army soldiers, a military officer and a civilian woman in two separate blasts in egypt's sinai peninsula. isil's sinai branch claimed responsibility for the attacks on several websites.

headline: kollam temple fire
text: a fire occurs at a hindu temple in the kollam district of the indian state of kerala. at least 102 people have been killed and hundreds injured.   ,

headline: moro conflict
text: philippine officials report four indonesian sailors were kidnapped last night off the philippines' southernmost town of sitangkai, tawi-tawi, near malaysia's sabah state. seven gunmen in a blue speedboat attacked two indonesian-flagged tugboats.  six other sailors, including one who was shot, were not taken by isil-linked abu sayyaf militants.

headline: 2016 kumamoto earthquakes
text: a second earthquake hits southern japan with a magnitude of 7.1 killing at least 32 people with the death toll from both earthquakes rising to 42. the new quake traps even more people. in kumamoto a landslide occurs as well as a bridge collapse.
a new aftershock with a magnitude of 5.4 hits southern kyushu island.  a japanese spokesman says 1,500 people have been injured, 80 seriously, since thursday.

japan's mount aso in the kumamoto prefecture erupts sending ash about 100 meters  into the air. the japan meteorological agency kept its alert level at 2 on a scale of 5 for aso following the eruption. it is unclear if the eruption is related to saturday’s kumamoto quake.
saturday's earthquake  forces sony to close its  plant in the kumamoto prefecture. toyota, honda, and nissan also stop work at several plants in the region.

headline: 2015–16 south pacific cyclone season
text: the samoan islands and wallis and futuna brace for the impact of cyclone amos as the fiji meteorological service upgrades the cyclone to a category three storm, with sustained winds as high as 140 km/h at its centre.

headline: iraqi civil war
text: two separate car bombs kill at least 12 people in iraq's capital, baghdad. the islamic state claims responsibility for the blast at the security checkpoint in a northern district that killed nine and injured 28 others. three people are killed and 11 injured at the  second bombing in southern baghdad that targeted an army convoy; no group has claimed responsibility.

headline: yemeni civil war
text: saudi-led air strikes kill at least ten al qaeda in the arabian peninsula fighters in southern yemen.
yemeni and united arab emirates troops capture the seaport of mukalla from al qaeda. the saudi arabia led coalition claims to have killed more than 800 militants,

headline: 2016 turøy helicopter crash
text: thirteen people were killed when a helicopter carrying offshore workers from gullfaks b crash landed off the western coast of norway.

headline: syrian civil war
text: the syrian observatory for human rights claims that twenty air strikes have hit the northern areas of aleppo. bombardments by both sides have killed nearly 250 people since april 22.

headline: iraqi civil war
text: two car bombs kill at least 32 people and wounded 75 others in samawa, iraq. islamic state of iraq and the levant claims responsibility for the attack.

headline: terrorism in saudi arabia
text: a policeman is killed in a shootout with militants in taif, saudi arabia.

headline: yemeni civil war
text: a suicide bombing kills at least 30 and injures 70 others in the southern city of mukalla, yemen. the islamic state of iraq and the levant claims responsibility for attack.

headline: list of earthquakes in australia
text: the united states geological survey  reports a magnitude 5.9 earthquake strikes the southern part of the northern territory in central australia. no damage or injuries are reported.

headline: hermalle-sous-huy train collision
text: a passenger train crashes into a goods train in the belgian town of hermalle-sous-huy in the municipality of saint-georges-sur-meuse, resulting in at least three deaths and more than 40 injuries.

headline: syrian civil war
text: the united states accuses russia of bombing u.s.-backed forces in southern syria near al-tanf close to the iraq and jordan borders.

dozens of american diplomats send  a memo, via the state department’s dissent channel, critical of u.s. policy in syria. the memo was signed by 51 mid- to high-level state department officers involved with advising on syrian policy, and calls for airstrikes against president bashar al-assad's government to stop its persistent violations of the united nations-sponsored february ceasefire.

headline: israeli–palestinian conflict
text: a 15-year-old palestinian teen is shot and killed by israel defense forces while  traveling in his family's car through an area where stones had been thrown that injured two tourists and an israeli. the  idf says  an official investigation has been opened.  preliminary results indicate mahmoud rafat baderan, the teen who was shot, was not involved in any stone throwing on the highway.

headline: 2016 istanbul airport attack
text: the death toll from the attack on the istanbul atatürk airport rises to 42.

headline: northern mali conflict
text: 2016 nampala attack: at least 12 soldiers are killed and 27 others injured after unidentified militants briefly overrun a government base in central mali, near the border with mauritania. the attackers also burn and loot the adjacent village of nampala.

headline: syrian civil war
text: a russian mil mi-8 military helicopter carrying humanitarian aid onboard is shot down by rebels in northern syria. all five members of the crew die in the crash.

headline: iraqi civil war
text: a suicide bombing kills at least 15 people at a wedding in the southern shiite city of kerbala.

headline: kashmir unrest
text: clashes in kashmir kill eight militants and a policeman.

headline: 2016 davao city bombing
text: the death toll of the september 2 bombing rises to 15.

headline: syrian civil war
text: hours after the syrian military declares the end of the ceasefire, an airstrike hits a convoy of united nations ocha aid trucks near the town of urum al-kubra, in the aleppo governorate, with the syrian observatory for human rights reporting that at least 12 people have been killed.

headline: saudi arabian-led intervention in yemen
text: the death toll from a saudi-led arab coalition airstrike which hit a house in a residential area in western yemen has risen to 26 people.

headline: syrian civil war
text: a suicide bombing at the opening of a local police station in the rebel-held town of inkhil, daraa governorate, in southern syria, kills at least 12 people, including an opposition minister.

headline: yemeni civil war
text: houthi forces launch rockets that hit and reportedly destroy hsv-2 swift, a military vessel belonging to the united arab emirates navy, off the coast of yemen, near the strategic red sea port of mokha. ,

headline: 2016 eséka train derailment
text: the death toll from the october 21 crash of a camrail train rises to at least 73 people with another 600 wounded. ,

headline: saudi arabian-led intervention in yemen
text: the saudi-led military coalition and the houthis  arrive at a ceasefire agreement effective as of 17 november 2016, as a result of talks  led by us secretary of state john kerry with the region's leaders.

headline: syrian civil war
text: six people are killed in a suspected chlorine gas attack in aleppo, syria.

headline: turkish military intervention in syria
text: three turkish army soldiers are killed and 10 others wounded in an attack in syria's al-bab district; however, there are conflicting reports on who carried out the attack. the turkish military says the soldiers were targeted in a airstrike by a syrian warplane, while the syrian observatory for human rights reports an isil suicide bomber was responsible.

headline: 2016 southeastern united states wildfires
text: the gatlinburg fire department orders the mandatory evacuation of downtown gatlinburg, tennessee, as several wildfires burn out of control in the great smoky mountains national park.

headline: kurdish–turkish conflict
text: security forces kill at least 10 pkk insurgents in şırnak.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: afghan security forces killed 16 militants from taliban group in ghazni.

headline: colombian peace process
text: the congress of colombia unanimously approves a peace deal between the government and rebel group farc to end the colombian conflict.

headline: syrian civil war
text: at least 21 people are killed in suspected russian airstrikes on idlib, syria. ,

headline: war in somalia
text: december 2016 mogadishu suicide bombing
a suicide bomber kills at least 29 people and injures 50 others in an attack on a police station near mogadishu's port.

headline: 2016 indonesian air force lockheed c-130 hercules crash
text: an indonesian military lockheed c-130 hercules transport plane crashes in papua province killing all 13 people on board.

headline: aleppo offensive
text: the international committee of the red cross claims that 25,000 residents of the rebel-held territories have been evacuated from aleppo as hezbollah warns remaining residents in the former rebel enclave to leave "as quickly as possible".

headline: war in afghanistan
text: five people are killed in a taliban attack on afghan member of parliament mir wali's home in helmand province. at least three security guards and two civilians were killed in the assault; wali and others  were injured. the gunmen are holding a number of occupants hostage.

headline: 2016 russian defence ministry tupolev tu-154 crash
text: a russian tu-154 military passenger airplane carrying 92 people including the alexandrov ensemble crashes into the black sea shortly after takeoff from sochi. the airplane was headed towards khmeimim, syria. the russian armed forces are actively involved in the syrian civil war.

headline: kurdish–turkish conflict
text: a shootout in izmir kills two gunmen while another one escapes. during the shootout a car bomb explodes, killing a police officer and court employee.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: at least 11 people are killed in a bombing in kandahar, including five uae diplomats.

headline: turkish airlines flight 6491
text: a turkish airlines cargo jet crashes near kyrgyzstan's manas international airport resulting in the deaths of at least 38 people.

headline: iraqi civil war
text: the world food programme cuts food aid to over 1.4 million displaced iraqis by 50%, citing payment delays from donor states.

headline: yemeni civil war
text: a suspected u.s. drone strike kills two al-qaida militants in  central shabwa province, according to yemeni security and tribal officials.
houthi forces attack a royal saudi navy frigate off the coast of yemen in the red sea, killing at least two sailors and wounding three others.

headline: war in donbass
text: a rebel commander is killed by a bomb in eastern ukraine while three ukrainian army soldiers are killed in fighting. at least 33 people have been killed in fighting over the past week.

headline: syrian civil war battle of al-bab
text: at least three soldiers of the turkish armed forces are accidentally killed by a russian airstrike near al-bab in northern syria.

headline: war in north-west pakistan
text: 2017 lahore suicide bombing

at least 13 people, including six police officers, are killed and 85 are injured after a bomb explodes at a protest rally in lahore, punjab. the pakistani taliban splinter group jamaat-ul-ahrar claims responsibility.

headline: syrian civil war idlib governorate clashes
text: rival fighters between tahrir al-sham and jund al-aqsa clash in syria's northern idlib governorate, killing "dozens" according to the syrian observatory for human rights.

headline: war in north-west pakistan
text: two separate bombings take place in pakistan, killing at least seven people. a suicide bomber kills five people at the administrative headquarters in the mohmand agency tribal district while the other kills two people at a hospital in peshawar. jamaat-ul-ahrar claims responsibility for the first attack.

headline: erasmus bus crash
text: thirteen are killed and 34 others injured after a bus carrying erasmus exchange students returning from the renowned falles fireworks festival in valencia, crashes near freginals, spain. the regional government of catalonia said in a statement  that, "... according to the latest data, the ill-fated bus had students from hungary, germany, sweden, norway, switzerland, czech republic, united kingdom, italy, peru, bulgaria, poland, ireland, japan, ukraine, holland, belgium, france, palestine, turkey,  greece."

headline: aftermath of the brussels bombings
text: belgian prosecutors release faycal c., a man charged in connection with last week's deadly brussels bombings. the prosecutor's office says the evidence which led to his arrest has not been backed up by the ongoing investigation.

headline: 2016 lahore suicide bombing
text: pakistan officials tell reuters its forces will launch a paramilitary crackdown on islamist militants in punjab. sunday's attack was taliban-affiliated jamaat-ul-ahrar's fifth bombing since december.

headline: naxalite–maoist insurgency
text: at least seven central reserve police force  personnel are killed in an ied attack on their vehicle in the indian state of chhattisgarh's dantewada district. naxalite insurgents are suspected to have been behind the attack.

headline: pkk rebellion
text: the turkish military say it carried out air strikes in northern iraq against targets belonging to the kurdistan workers' party, hitting weapon stores and shelters.

headline: 2016 ethiopia flood
text: deadly floods hit ethiopia, leaving at least 28 people dead as seasonal rains come early to the country. the majority of these deaths occurred in the city of jijiga while elsewhere, heavy downpours of rain were reported with more floods expected in the next few days.

headline: iraqi civil war
text: iraqi officials, following arrested is militants' directions, uncover two mass graves with bodies of about 40 people in ramadi.

headline: war in donbass
text: a ukrainian military spokesman says three of its soldiers were killed by a mortar attack in the country's east, the heaviest toll reported in the region in nearly two months.

headline: 2015–16 south pacific cyclone season
text: samoan authorities prepared for severe tropical cyclone amos which is forecast to make landfall later tonight.

headline: dissident irish republican campaign
text: mi5 raises the threat level for dissident northern ireland militants from "moderate" to "substantial", meaning there is a strong possibility of an attack on the british mainland.

headline: iraqi civil war
text: an australian security contractor is killed outside the australian embassy in baghdad. there are unconfirmed reports that he was shot.

three gunmen open fire on a real madrid supporters club meeting in a cafe in samarra northern iraq, killing at least 14 and wounding 25. islamic state of iraq and syria claims responsibility for attack.

headline: egyptair flight 804
text: egyptair flight 804 between paris and cairo disappears with 56 passengers and 10 crew onboard. the plane was at 37,000 feet when it disappeared ten minutes before entering egyptian airspace over the mediterranean sea. it is later reported to have crashed off the greek island of karpathos. locals reported seeing a fireball.

headline: 2016 atlantic hurricane season
text: the united states national hurricane center issues a tropical storm warning for parts of south carolina as the newly upgraded tropical storm bonnie, at 5 p.m. edt about 125 miles from charleston, south carolina,  moves northwest toward the atlantic coast.

headline: boko haram insurgency
text: niger security forces kill 12  boko haram militants in bosso.
an improvised explosive device kills four civilians and one soldier in biu, nigeria.

headline: war in somalia
text: at least 16 people are killed and 55 injured in an attack on a hotel in mogadishu, somalia. al-shabaab claims responsibility.   ,
the pentagon announces the death of abdullahi haji da’ud, a top al-shabaab commander, in an airstrike.

headline: war in somalia
text: in a raid by somali forces near kismayo, at least 16 al-shabaab militants are killed, including the mastermind of the garissa university college attack.

headline: kurdish–turkish conflict
text: turkish air force bombs kurdistan workers' party targets in northern iraq and southeastern turkey killing at least 27 militants.

headline: syrian civil war
text: syrian government airstrikes hit rebel-held areas in aleppo, killing at least 34 people.

headline: egyptair flight 804
text: the second flight recorder from the wreckage of ill-fated egyptair flight 804 is recovered from the crash site in the mediterranean sea.

headline: singapore airlines flight 368
text: a singapore airlines boeing 777-300er en-route to milan's malpensa airport makes an emergency landing at singapore's changi airport after the pilots received an engine oil warning message, whereafter the plane's right engine caught fire. singapore changi airport's aircraft rescue and firefighting services extinguished the fire and singapore airlines confirmed that all 222 passengers and 19 crew members evacuated safely.

headline: july 2016 baghdad bombings
text: the baghdad provincial council deputy head  reports  the death toll has passed 200, with at least 225 more injured. iraqi prime minister haider al-abadi, visiting the kerrada site, is jeered by onlookers who blame his government for not stopping isil-related bloodshed.

headline: european migrant crisis
text: a médecins sans frontières  ship rescues 209 people, including 50 children, from two dinghies in distress in the mediterranean sea but finds 22 dead bodies, 21 women and a child, lying in a pool of fuel in the bottom of one of the boats. the dinghies were 17 miles east of tripoli, libya. cause of death is unknown, though an msf official says it could be that fumes from mixed fuel and water rendered the people unconscious. the msf ship is expected to arrive in the sicilian port of trapani on friday.

headline: july 2016 north china cyclone
text: torrential precipitation and widespread flash floods from an extratropical cyclone resulted in at least 78 deaths over north china and nearby regions.

headline: kurdish–turkish conflict
text: the turkish military kills 35 kurdistan workers' party militants after they attempt to capture a base in turkey's hakkâri province.

headline: war in somalia
text: an al-shabaab attack on the central investigations department kills at least nine people.

headline: 2016 assam attacks
text: gunmen open fire in a market in assam, india, killing 13 people and injuring 18.

headline: syrian civil war
text: the syrian observatory for human rights claims that 10 people have been killed in an air strike on a hospital in the town of milis in syria's idlib province.

headline: 2016 pacific hurricane season
text: a hurricane watch is issued for the island of hawaii as hurricane madeline approaches.

headline: 2016 davao city bombing
text: in light of the attacks, the governments of australia, canada, singapore, the united kingdom, and the united states issue travel warnings against going to mindanao, philippines.

headline: syrian civil war israel–syria relations
text: syria reports its air defense shot down an israeli warplane that attacked a syrian army position in  al-quneitra, near the israeli-occupied golan heights. the israel defense forces say that missiles were fired at their aircraft but none hit.

headline: 2016 southeastern united states gasoline shortage
text: the u.s. states of north carolina and virginia declare a state of emergency over gas shortages as a result of the colonial pipeline leak in shelby county, alabama.

headline: iraqi civil war
text: iraqi armed forces recapture al-shirqat, southwest of al hujayl, from isil.

headline: syrian civil war
text: a video from besieged eastern aleppo's al-shaar neighborhood emerges showing the moment a young girl, identified as ghazal qasim, trapped beneath rubble of a five floor building blown to smithereens by a deadly assad government's bunker buster bomb attack on september 27, is rescued by the syrian civil defense, better known as the white helmets.

the un's children's charity unicef has called the effect of the war in aleppo on children as the worst seen since the conflict began, and says at least 96 children have been killed and 223 have been injured in eastern aleppo september 23.

headline: war in somalia
text: a car bomb at a mogadishu restaurant near the  jilaow detention center kills four people and injures another five. al-shabaab claims responsibility for the attack. ,
a somalian regional government demands an explanation from the united states after an airstrike kills 22 civilians and other soldiers instead of the targeted al-shabaab militants in galmudug.

headline: 2016 ethiopian protests
text: police allegedly attack oromo protestors at a religious festival in bishoftu, ethiopia causing a stampede which kills dozens of people.

headline: war in somalia
text: a militant from al-shabaab shoots dead an intelligence officer in mogadishu.

headline: battle of mosul
text: united nations human rights council spokeswoman ravina shamdasani says isil militants killed 40 former iraqi security forces members and threw their bodies  in the tigris river  near mosul on saturday.
iraqi special operations forces have fought their way into the outskirts of mosul.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: german consulate in mazar-i-sharif attack
at least two people have been killed and 90 injured in an attack on the german consulate in mazar-i-sharif. the taliban has claimed responsibility.

headline: syrian civil war
text: between four and 20 people are reported killed by government and russian airstrikes that hit rebel held areas, five hospitals, and a mobile clinic in aleppo,  says u.s. state department spokeswoman elizabeth trudeau. syria and russia deny targeting aleppo.

headline: 2016–17 north american winter
text: the death toll from "winter storm argos" in the u.s. state of new hampshire rises to five.

headline: 2016 fukushima earthquake
text: a 6.9 magnitude earthquake off japan's fukushima prefecture injures 15 people, and triggers a 1 meter tsunami that causes a temporary power disruption at fukushima daini nuclear power plant.

headline: sinai insurgency
text: eight egyptian army soldiers are killed by a suicide bomber at a checkpoint in northern sinai.

headline: semnan–damghan train collision
text: two passenger trains collide in iran's semnan province resulting in at least 44 deaths and 100 people injured.

headline: military intervention against isil
text: denmark's government announces it will be withdrawing its seven f-16 fighter jets from military operations against isil in iraq and syria from mid-december.

headline: somali civil war
text: seven insurgents are killed in clashes northern somalia.

headline: 2016 great smoky mountains wildfires
text: the death toll in the town of gatlinburg, tennessee rises to 14.

headline: yemeni civil war
text: december 2016 aden suicide bombing
a suicide bomber kills at least 50 soldiers and injures 70 more at a military barracks in aden, yemen.

headline: syrian civil war
text: a fuel truck explodes in the syrian town of azaz, near the border with turkey, killing at least 43 people, according to the syrian observatory for human rights.

headline: january 2017 european cold wave
text: dozens of people die in eastern europe and italy in recent days as a result of a cold snap with cancelled flights, frozen rivers, and traffic accidents.

headline: war in somalia
text: al-shabaab militants attack a remote amisom base in southern somalia, claiming to have killed dozens of kenyan troops.

headline: insurgency in the north caucasus
text: at least three suspected militants are killed by russian security forces during a firefight in khasavyurt, dagestan.

headline: syrian civil war
text: the syrian opposition agrees to surrender their remaining villages in the stretch between the  wadi barada area and the lebanon-syria border, as well as the rankous borderange for transportation of at least 250 rebel fighters to their stronghold in the idlib governorate.

headline: yemeni civil war
text: an air raid on a funeral in a village north of sana'a kills at least eight women and children. the houthis blames the saudi-led coalition for the attack.

headline: 2017 leuven derailment
text: one person is killed and 20 are injured when a passenger train derails near leuven, belgium.

headline: iraqi civil war battle of mosul
text: iraq prime minister haider al-abadi says u.s.-backed iraqi forces have launched an operation to regain control of western mosul from isil militants. the united nations says humanitarian agencies are setting up in these older sections of the city where, already, food and fuel supplies are dwindling, running water is scarce, and electricity in many neighborhoods is unreliable for the estimated 800,000 civilians.

headline: yemeni civil war  war on terror
text: at least 50 militants are reportedly killed in a u.s. air strike on an al-qaeda training camp in southern yemen.

headline: 2016 brussels bombings
text: six suspects are arrested in the brussels schaerbeek district.

belgian  officials confirm 24-year-old suicide bomber najim laachraoui,  who also used the pseudonym soufiane kayawas, was  suspected of being the bomb-maker who supplied suicide vests for the november 13, 2015, paris attacks.

headline: iraqi civil war
text: iskandariya suicide bombing
at least 30 people are killed in a suicide attack on a football stadium south of baghdad, iraq. the islamic state of iraq and the levant claims responsibility for attack.

headline: 2016 stavropol bombings
text: at least three suicide bombers attack a police station in stavropol, russia.

headline: war in north-west pakistan
text: a suicide bomber explodes his vest next to a government building in mardan, pakistan, killing one person and critically wounding three more.

headline: syrian civil war
text: according to russian ambassador to the united nations aleksi borodavkin, the syrian army is preparing to launch an offensive against the isil strongholds of al-raqqah and the countryside around deir ez-zor and that the russian air force will be providing the ground campaign with air support.
airstrikes hit the syrian city of aleppo, destroying another medical facility and killing two civilians, according to the syrian observatory for human rights.

headline: moro conflict
text: the abu sayyaf militant group threatens to behead a canadian hostage, a filipina hostage, and a norwegian hostage.

headline: insurgency in jammu and kashmir
text: jaish-e-mohammed operations chief is killed in a gun battle with police.

headline: syrian civil war
text: new satellite imagery from stratfor appears to reveal the destruction of four russian attack helicopters and 20 lorries at the tiyas military airbase after a reported attack which was conducted last week by the isil.
northern al-raqqa offensive

u.s.  backed syrian democratic forces, led by kurdish forces, launch an operation to capture al-raqqah, the de facto capital of islamic state of iraq and syria. the force is reported to be more than 50,000 strong.

headline: european migrant crisis
text: at least 20 people drown in the southern mediterranean sea when a repurposed fishing boat sinks 35 nautical miles north of zuwara, libya.

headline: syrian civil war
text: at least 23 people are killed in  overnight air strikes in idlib, syria.

headline: 2016 european floods
text: at least eleven people are killed in heavy flooding across europe.
the louvre will close briefly to move the artwork most at risk from flooding.

headline: 2016 atlantic hurricane season
text: tropical storm colin
tropical storm colin forms in the gulf of mexico and is likely to hit florida's gulf coast tomorrow.

headline: june 2016 istanbul bombing
text: seven police officers and four civilians are killed, and 36 people are wounded, three critically, by a car bomb explosion near the main tourism district in istanbul, turkey. the explosives, detonated by remote control, wrecked a passing police bus, reports cnn türk. there is no immediate claim of responsibility.
turkish police detain four people for interrogation.
united nations secretary-general ban ki-moon condemns today’s terrorist attack in istanbul. ban says, "the un stands in solidarity with the people and government of turkey at this difficult time."

headline: yemeni civil war
text: missiles, fired from a u.s. drone, strike a four-wheel drive vehicle in southern yemen, killing two and injuring another suspected militant.

headline: kurdish–turkish conflict
text: a car bomb injures at least nine people, three in serious condition,  in the mainly-kurdish southeast region in turkey's tunceli province. the explosion occurred close to housing for courthouse employees in the town of ovacik. there is  no immediate claim of responsibility  for the attack.

headline: yemeni civil war
text: three islamic state of iraq and the levant bombings in yemen's southern port city of al mukalla kill 38 government forces and injure 24 others.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: at least two people are killed and dozens more are wounded in a suicide bombing in jalalabad, nangarhar province.

headline: iraqi civil war
text: twin bombings in a pair of crowded commercial areas in baghdad kill at least 125 people. isil claims responsibility.

headline: terrorism in bangladesh
text: a group of radical islamists hurl homemade bombs at police officers in the kishoreganj district in central bangladesh killing at least one officer and injuring several others.

headline: 2016 pacific typhoon season
text: typhoon nepartak hits eastern taiwan causing three deaths so far, 124 injuries, thousands of people to be evacuated, disrupting transport and power supplies.

headline: south sudanese civil war
text: an estimated 272 people have been killed between rival sudan people's liberation army factions as clashes in the capital, juba, continue. according to a spokesman for rebel leader and vice president riek machar, south sudan is "back to war" despite a peace deal being reached last april.

headline: syrian civil war
text: russian war planes allegedly bomb a refugee camp near the border with jordan, killing at least eight people.
according to the syrian observatory for human rights, airstrikes in the towns of al-rastan and ariha kill at least 24 people, despite a temporary ceasefire being declared by the syrian government.

headline: 2016 nice attack
text: a truck plows into a mass of revelers during the bastille day fireworks on the promenade des anglais in nice, france, with a death toll as high as 80 and 100 people injured.

headline: 2016 turkish coup d'état attempt
text: general akın öztürk,  turkish air force chief until august 2015, confesses  to planning last week's attempted coup d'état, according to the state-run anadolu news agency.

headline: 2016 indian air force an-32 disappearance
text: the search intensifies for the indian air force antonov an-32 military transport with 29 people aboard  that went missing over the bay of bengal shortly after its friday morning takeoff from tambaram.

headline: 2016 california wildfires
text: a dead body is found in the area of the sand fire near santa clarita that has doubled in size to more than 22,000 acres. officials order mandatory evacuations for 1,500 homes in little tujunga, sand, and placerita canyons. the south coast air quality management district issues an alert for unhealthy air quality in affected areas.

headline: quetta bombing
text: at least 70 people are killed and about 120 others injured in a suicide bombing  at a hospital in quetta, pakistan.
the pakistani taliban, jamaat-ul-ahrar, claims responsibility for the attack.

headline: beni massacre
text: at least 64 to 100 people are killed in a massacre.

headline: 2016 california wildfires
text: the town of wrightwood, california, is evacuated due to threats from the blue cut fire burning in the cajon pass.
the governor of california declares a state of emergency in san bernardino county due to the bluecut fire.

headline: southeast asian haze
text: fires in indonesia burn and blow smoke into singapore, engulfing the city-state into darkness.

headline: european migrant crisis
text: the spanish-based proactiva open arms ngo rescues more than 700 migrants in the mediterranean sea about 17 miles north of sabratha, libya. the rescued, who are from nigeria, are transferred to the italian coast guard.

headline: 2016 gabonese protests
text: large explosions and gunfire are reported in the gabonese capital libreville as security forces clash with supporters of opposition presidential candidate jean ping protesting the election results indicating a narrow victory by president ali bongo ondimba.
military helicopters bomb the headquarters of union of forces for change, according to opposition leader jean ping, killing at least two people. internet is also cut in the capital, libreville.

headline: sectarianism in pakistan
text: islamic militants attack christian sections of khyber pakhtunkhwa, leaving 13 dead in the city of mardan.

headline: 2016 north korean floods
text: the united nations estimates that the death toll from severe flooding in north korea reaches 133 with another 395 missing and tens of thousands homeless.

headline: 2016 egypt migrant shipwreck
text: the death toll increases to at least 148 with another 240 believed to still be missing.

headline: aleppo offensive
text: the syrian army clashes with insurgents in the 1070 apartments district of aleppo.

headline: malaysia airlines flight 17 2014 pro-russian unrest in ukraine
text: dutch-led investigators say malaysia airlines flight mh17 was downed over eastern ukraine in 2014 by a buk missile that had come from russia.

headline: 2016 atlantic hurricane season hurricane matthew
text: the u.s. national hurricane center issues a tropical storm watch for aruba, bonaire, and curaçao islands in the caribbean sea,  and for the northwest south american coast. ,

headline: 2016 atlantic hurricane season
text: hurricane matthew becomes a category-5 hurricane with maximum sustained winds up to 160 mph, the strongest hurricane to form over the caribbean sea since hurricane felix in 2007. it is expected to impact parts of haiti, jamaica and eastern cuba. ,

headline: 2016 pacific typhoon season
text: typhoon chaba, now a super typhoon with winds of 145 knots , heads for japan's southern islands with storm warnings of torrential rain followed by mudslides and flooding. ,

headline: sectarianism in pakistan
text: an apparent sectarian attack by two motorcyclists who open fire on a bus traveling to hazara town, quetta, pakistan, kills four women from pakistan's shia hazara and injures two other people. , ,

headline: 2016 atlantic hurricane season
text: hurricane matthew kills at least 26 people on the island of hispaniola; 22 in haiti and four more in the dominican republic. the u.s. national hurricane center predicts the storm, currently a category 3 with  maximum sustained winds of  115 mph , will strengthen as it moves across the bahamas tonight and tomorrow, and be near the east coast of florida by tomorrow evening. , , ,
haiti's electoral council postpones the country's presidential election scheduled for october 9.

headline: war in somalia
text: an al-shabaab attack on a village near the kenyan town of mandera results in six deaths. ,

headline: malaysia airlines flight 370
text: authorities confirm that a wing part found in mauritius in may is part of the aircraft from malaysian airlines flight 370.

headline: yemeni crisis
text: the obama administration through the u.s. defense department says it will take appropriate action against those responsible for october 9 unsuccessful cruise missile attack, apparently fired from houthi-controlled territory in yemen, upon the uss mason.

headline: rohingya insurgency in western myanmar
text: the four-day death toll from fighting in rakhine state stands at 39, including 13 army and police personnel.

headline: syrian civil war
text: turkish-backed free syrian army rebels seize control of the symbolic town of dabiq, aleppo governorate, following clashes with isil militants.

headline: iraqi civil war
text: isil militants launch attacks on government buildings, police stations, and a power station in the city of kirkuk, iraqi kurdistan, killing dozens of people.

headline: iraqi civil war
text: isil recaptures the western iraqi town of ar-rutbah, which it previously withdrew from in may.

headline: october 2016 central italy earthquakes
text: a 6.6 magnitude earthquake occurs in central italy 68 kilometres east southeast of perugia. many buildings are reported as having been destroyed. ,
the 14th century basilica of st. benedict  in the town of norcia is destroyed.

headline: moro conflict
text: six vietnamese sailors are kidnapped by the abu sayyaf off the coast of the philippines.

headline: syrian civil war aleppo offensive
text: government forces have captured most of hanano, the largest rebel-controlled district in eastern aleppo, and have begun pushing into neighboring 'ard al-hamra and jabal badro districts.

headline: israel-iran proxy conflict
text: allegedly israeli fighter jets strike a suspected hezbollah weapons convoy near damascus, syria. ,

headline: lamia airlines flight 2933
text: the bbc reports that leaked audio recordings of air traffic tower tapes indicate that the lamia airlines flight was running out of fuel near the colombian city of medellin.

headline: 2016 oakland warehouse fire
text: the confirmed death toll in friday night's warehouse fire in oakland, california rises to 33 with several people still missing.

headline: pollution in china
text: sixty cities in the people's republic of china issued smog alerts between december 2 and 4.

headline: syrian civil war
text: battle of aleppo, aleppo offensive
russia and the united states will continue talks on aleppo after talks between the u.s. secretary of state john kerry and foreign minister sergey lavrov.

headline: december 2016 istanbul bombings
text: two bombs, one detonated by a suicide bomber, near the vodafone arena in istanbul, turkey, kill at least 29 people and injure more than 150 others. ten people have been arrested in relation to the bombings.

headline: december 2016 istanbul bombings
text: the death toll from yesterday's bombings rises to 38 with 155 injured. thirteen people have been arrested in connection with the bombings.
the kurdistan freedom falcons  claim responsibility for the bombings.

headline: 2016 naivasha oil tanker explosion
text: an oil tanker explodes on a main highway near naivasha, kenya, killing at least 42 people, according to the kenya national disaster operation centre.

headline: 2016 al-karak attack
text: unknown militants stage a number of attacks across the city of al-karak in jordan, killing five people and injuring at least 10 others.

headline: 2016 chiloé earthquake
text: a magnitude 7.7 earthquake in chile spurs tsunami warnings.

headline: yemeni civil war
text: government forces push to capture a houthi enclave in bayhan district, on the border between shabwa and marib provinces, resulting at least 28 houthi militants and 12 yemeni soldiers killed.

headline: war in donbass
text: international monitors from the osce report that fighting has intensified in eastern ukraine as a second year of a shaky truce begins. the worst of the fighting is located between government-controlled avdiivka and separatist-controlled yasynuvata.

headline: libyan civil war
text: two security guards are killed while repelling an isil attack on the bayda oil field, near the town of marada, libya.

headline: military intervention against isil iraq civil war
text: the united states military reports a drone attack killed isil rocket expert jasim khadijah. the unmanned airstrike also killed other is militants and destroyed at least one makeshift drone. khadijah, a former iraqi officer, is believed responsible for the march attack that killed a u.s. marine in northern iraq.
iraqi forces capture the northern part of the isil held town of hīt, west of baghdad.

headline: boko haram insurgency
text: nigeria's army says it has arrested khalid al-barnawi, a leader of the boko haram splinter group ansaru.

headline: syrian civil war
text: damascus offensive
isil militants reportedly execute 175 workers who were captured earlier this week at a cement factory situated to the east of damascus.

headline: internal conflict in peru
text: at least two people are killed in a remote part of peru in an attack by shining path guerillas.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: the taliban announces its annual spring offensive to be named "operation omari".

headline: russian military intervention in the syrian civil war
text: a russian air force mi-28 attack helicopter crashes near the syrian city of homs, killing two pilots.

headline: 2016 kumamoto earthquake
text: a magnitude 6.4 earthquake strikes near kumamoto, japan, collapsing several buildings killing at least four people and injuring 400. however, no tsunami warning was issued and local nuclear power plants reported no problems. , ,

headline: european migrant crisis
text: up to 500 people are feared to have drowned off the coast of libya in the mediterranean last week, in what would be the deadliest migrant shipwreck in months.

headline: hillsborough disaster
text: the jury in the second inquest for the victims of the hillsborough disaster reach their verdicts. these will be given at 11:00 bst tomorrow.

headline: attacks on secularists in bangladesh
text: ansar-al islam, the bangladeshi branch of al-qaeda in the indian subcontinent, claims responsibility for yesterday's murder of usaid employee and lgbt activist xulhaz mannan and his friend, actor tanay majumder.

headline: israeli–palestinian conflict
text: israeli forces kill two palestinian assailants at a checkpoint in the west bank.

headline: 2016 fort mcmurray wildfire
text: alberta premier rachel notley says the wildfire has destroyed about  1,600 structures in fort mcmurray,  which is  in canada's oil sands region. no major oil sands facilities are in the fire's path, though two royal dutch shell mines are closing, and a suncor energy facility is reducing crude production. the fire is  threatening the alberta highway 63 bridge across the athabasca river, the  sole route south. the canadian red cross is encouraging people to donate funds rather than clothing.

headline: syrian civil war
text: aleppo offensive
more than 72 are killed in clashes between al-nusra front and syrian government forces in khan tuman south of aleppo, syria.

headline: iraqi civil war
text: the pentagon announces the death of  islamic state of iraq and syria  leader abu waheeb and three other militants in an airstrike near the town of rutba, iraq.
an isil car bomb kills at least 50 and injures 54 people in the eastern iraq city of baquba.

headline: syrian civil war
text: turkey's anadolu agency reports that 45 islamic state of iraq and the levant militants have been killed by a combination  of turkish army shelling and a u.s. air strike north of aleppo.
u.s. officials believe the islamic state of iraq and the levant has declared a state of emergency in its self-declared capital, al-raqqah.

headline: war in donbass
text: seven ukrainian servicemen are killed in suspected attacks by pro-russian rebels.

headline: 2016 european floods
text: the flood waters for the seine river are expected to peak at six metres above its normal level. flooding in france and germany has so far claimed at least 11 lives.
a sixth body is recovered in bavaria near the austrian border.

headline: libyan civil war
text: libyan forces claim to have captured the port in the city of sirte after heavy fighting with isil.

headline: syrian civil war
text: according to the syrian observatory for human rights, two suicide bombings occur near the sayyidah zaynab shrine in a damascus suburb, killing at least 20 people.

headline: kurdish separatism in iran
text: 2016 west iran clashes

kurdish rebels and iranian revolutionary guards clash in oshnavieh, killing 12 rebels and three guards. there is dispute over who the rebels were. iranian authorities claim it was the party of free life of kurdistan movement while a member of the democratic party of iranian kurdistan claimed their group was responsible for the fighting.

headline: syrian civil war
text: airstrikes reportedly kill at least 82 people, including 58 civilians, in syria's eastern deir ez-zor governorate, according to the syrian observatory for human rights.

headline: cpp–npa–ndf rebellion philippine drug war
text: the communist party of the philippines agrees to fight drug lords after its legal wing bagong alyansang makabayan joins the government cabinet of rodrigo duterte.

headline: terrorism in indonesia
text: a suicide bomber attacks a police station in solo, indonesia, killing himself and injuring a  police officer. solo is the birthplace of president joko widodo.

headline: syrian civil war isil involvement
text: a suicide bomb explosion in  kurdish-controlled al-hasakah in northeastern syria  kills at least 16 people, including three children and two women.  isil claims responsibility.

headline: cpp-npa-ndf rebellion
text: twenty philippine army soldiers are under investigation after they are suspected of mutilating the body of a new people's army member. the communist militant's eyes were gouged, his tongue was cut off and his throat was slit.

headline: ukrainian crisis
text: prominent ukrainian-based journalist pavel sheremet of the ukrayinska pravda is killed in a car bombing in kiev.

headline: syrian civil war
text: syrian opposition activists report government airstrikes on aleppo province kill at least five people and hit at least five medical facilities.

headline: syrian civil war
text: at least 44 people are killed in a twin bombing in the kurdish-controlled city of al-qamishli on the syria–turkey border. isil claims responsibility for the attack.

headline: typhoon nida
text: hong kong braces for the storm.

headline: libyan civil war
text: a car bombing in the al-quwarsha area on the outskirts of benghazi claims at least 23 lives. the shura council of benghazi revolutionaries says it is responsible.

headline: syrian civil war
text: at least 40 government air strikes hit rebel-held areas of aleppo city  and nearby towns, including on a camp for displaced people in atareb, south-west of aleppo, killing at least two people.
jan egeland, an adviser to the un’s special envoy to syria, says that there were 44 attacks on hospitals, clinics and health posts around syria in july alone.

headline: 2016 atlantic hurricane season
text: hurricane earl makes landfall in belize near belize city early today.

headline: 2016 central italy earthquake
text: a state of emergency is declared in italy following several strong earthquakes.
the official death toll rises to 278.

headline: war in somalia
text: a car bomb explodes outside the president of somalia's compound in mogadishu claiming at least ten people's lives. al shabaab has claimed responsibility for the attack.

headline: kurdish–turkish conflict
text: turkish armed forces claims that it has killed three kurdistan workers' party fighters in air strikes in southeastern turkey near the borders with iraq.

headline: syrian civil war
text: syrian government forces advance around and encircle aleppo in order to try and impose a siege.

headline: september 2016 afghanistan road crash
text: at least 35 people die and 25 are injured after a bus crashes into a fuel tanker in afghanistan's zabul province.

headline: 2016 davao city bombing
text: philippine president rodrigo duterte declares a state of emergency in the whole country. in a warning to abu sayyaf, duterte says "i will eat you alive." ,

headline: 2016 pacific typhoon season
text: the china meteorological administration forecasts that typhoon meranti will make landfall in south fujian province.

headline: iraqi civil war
text: the u.s. military investigates yesterday's islamic state rocket strike near the qayyarah airfield west to ascertain if a chemical agent was used.

headline: colombian conflict
text: the revolutionary armed forces of colombia , the country's largest rebel group, gives its approval to a peace deal agreement with the government. president juan manuel santos and farc leader timoleón jiménez, known as timochenko, will sign the agreement on september 26. to complete the approval process, a referendum will be held on october 2.

headline: 2016 atlantic hurricane season
text: heavy rains from hurricane matthew's outer bands drench haiti and jamaica, killing a haitian fisherman. the category 4 storm, with 140 mph  maximum sustained winds), is heading towards western haiti, eastern cuba, and the southeastern and central bahamas. ,

headline: 2016 atlantic hurricane season hurricane matthew
text: the death toll in the united states from hurricane matthew rises to 27 with at least five people still missing in north carolina. governor pat mccrory warns that the state's swollen rivers are still rising with flooding continuing to pose threats to life and property this week. the storm, downgraded to a post-tropical cyclone yesterday, moves away from the u.s. coastline on an east-northeast track. , ,

matthew's death toll in haiti rises to at least one thousand, with victims being buried in mass graves. an unknown number of people remain missing and authorities report that cholera is spreading in the hardest hit-areas in the country's southwest.

headline: 2016 atlantic hurricane season
text: hurricane nicole impacts bermuda at category 3 strength, making it the strongest hurricane to effect the british overseas territory since hurricane fabian in 2003. ,

headline: yemeni civil war
text: an explosion that targeted a funeral in ma'rib for a  top yemeni army commander, kills five people, including the deceased's brother, and injures 15 more. ,

headline: war in somalia
text: somali police say at least seven are dead after clashes as somali and african union troops pushed back al-shabab extremists from afgooye, a town near mogadishu.

headline: moro conflict
text: muslim rebel group moro national liberation front leader nur misuari meets with philippines president rodrigo duterte in malacañang palace after receiving a reprieve from previous crimes of rebellion.

headline: 2016 croydon tram derailment
text: at least seven people have been killed and 51 hospitalised after a tramlink light rail vehicle derailed and overturned close to sandilands tram stop in the london borough of croydon early on wednesday. it is believed to be the first tram accident involving fatalities in the united kingdom since 1959.

headline: libyan civil war
text: a car bomb in benghazi kills three children and injures 20 others.

headline: spillover of the syrian civil war
text: an israeli army patrol kills four isil-affiliated militants after they open fire from positions in syria near the golan heights.

headline: tornadoes of 2016
text: three people are dead after a tornado hits in jackson county in the u.s. state of alabama. four other people are injured in neighboring de kalb county. ,

headline: 2016 oakland warehouse fire
text: at least nine people are killed and 40 are missing in a warehouse fire in oakland, california. ,

headline: syrian civil war
text: the syrian observatory for human rights declares that "the battle for aleppo has reached its end" with a major victory for the syrian government.

russia's foreign minister sergey lavrov says he is hoping he is wrong stating that the united states "orchestrated, coordinated" the islamic state's recent capture of palmyra in order to "give a break to those bandits that are in eastern aleppo."

the syrian observatory for human rights reports that suspected syrian government or russian warplanes conduct a series of air raids on oqayrabat and other nearby villages in the hama governorate at dawn, killing at least 34 civilians, including 11 children.
ban ki-moon, the secretary-general of the united nations, warns that "atrocities" have occurred in recent hours in the battle for aleppo. ,
russian airstrikes against isis in palmyra kill 5 people.

headline: assassination of andrei karlov
text: the russian ambassador to turkey andrei karlov is killed in a gun attack at an art gallery in ankara. russia calls the assassin, 22-year old police officer, mevlüt mert altıntaş, a "terrorist". turkish foreign minister mevlüt çavuşoğlu goes to moscow for a planned trilateral meeting on syria, saying "the incident will not impact relations between turkey and russia".

headline: philippine drug war
text: a news publisher is allegedly killed in the philippine province of catanduanes after publishing a story about the controversial drug purge campaign.

headline: syrian civil war
text: northern raqqa offensive
u.s.-backed syrian democratic forces advance to eight kilometers  from the largest prison held by isil near the tabqa dam.

headline: colombian conflict
text: as part of an ongoing peace process, the congress of colombia approves an amnesty law for thousands of demobilizing farc rebels. the amnesty does not apply to farc rebels who have committed war crimes or human rights violations.

headline: 2017 istanbul nightclub attack
text: a gunman opens fire in a nightclub in istanbul, on the european coast of the bosphorus, killing at least 39 people with an additional 69 wounded. , ,

headline: malaysia airlines flight 370
text: the underwater search for missing malaysia airlines flight 370 has been suspended.

headline: syrian civil war
text: isil militants execute 12 people in palmyra, according to the syrian observatory for human rights.

headline: libyan civil war
text: forces of the libyan national army claim to have captured one of the last remaining strongholds of benghazi from ansar al-sharia.

headline: february 2017 north american blizzard
text: a major blizzard hits the northeastern united states, cancelling more than 2,400 flights.

headline: erasmus bus crash
text: a catalan official says the 13 exchange students killed in sunday's accident were 19-to-25-year-old women,  seven from italy, two germans, an austrian, a woman from france, a romanian and an uzbek. twenty-four people are  being treated in hospital with one student in critical condition, and six people, including the driver, in serious condition. reports from officials indicate the driver lost control of the coach and crashed to the other side before running into an oncoming car. the bus driver, who passed alcohol and drug tests, is being investigated for possible negligent homicide as police seek to determine the cause of the crash.

headline: alaska nelson lagoon volcanic ash mount pavlof
text: alaska airlines cancels 41 flights to and from six cities across the state, barrow, bethel, fairbanks, kotzebue, nome, and prudhoe bay, due to pavlof's "massive ash cloud." the carrier announces flights will remain grounded pending tuesday's assessment of flying conditions.

headline: 2016 brussels bombings
text: belgium officials lower the official death toll from 35 to 32, with nearly 100 still hospitalized.

brussels zaventem international airport ceo arnaud feist says the airport will reopen at less than a quarter capacity wednesday, as ongoing tests determine which flights can resume. it could take months for the airport to return to full capacity, feist added.

headline: libyan civil war
text: blasts and gunfire are reported in tripoli.

headline: european migrant crisis
text: five migrants drown off the island of samos close to turkey.

headline: war in somalia
text: at least five people are killed and seven are wounded following a car bomb attack near a government building in somalia's capital, mogadishu. al-shabaab claims responsibility for the attack.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: heavy fighting continues in the north of afghanistan as taliban fighters intensify their attacks in several districts around kunduz in their bid to retake the city. according to a police chief, militants overnight attacked several police checkpoints in the southwest outskirts of the city while government forces repelled a major attack to the east of kunduz.

headline: ethnic violence in south sudan sudanese nomadic conflicts
text: according to the government of ethiopia, the death toll from a raid carried out by attackers from south sudan has risen to 208 from a figure of 140 a day earlier, with 108 children being kidnapped in the process. ethiopian forces killed 60 of the attackers and says it would cross the border into south sudan to pursue the assailants if necessary.

headline: war in north-west pakistan
text: pakistani taliban militants, in two attacks, kill seven police officers who were guarding medical workers administering polio vaccinations in karachi.

headline: syrian civil war
text: rockets fired by isil from northern syria hit a poor neighborhood and a mosque in the turkish city of kilis, killing one person and injuring 26 others. turkish security forces responded by returning fire into syria.

headline: 2016 armenian–azerbaijani clashes
text: according to officials from the breakaway region of nagorno-karabakh, one of their soldiers was killed overnight by azerbaijani troops.

headline: kurdish–turkish conflict
text: three turkish soldiers are killed and 14 others wounded in an armed attack by kurdish militants during a military operation in the town of nusaybin, turkey.

headline: moro conflict
text: abu sayyaf militants release 10 indonesians the group had kidnapped from their tugboat and barge on march 28.

headline: syrian civil war
text: dozens of people have died in heavy fighting between syrian government and opposition forces in the western aleppo governorate.

headline: syrian civil war
text: reuters reports nearly 150 people are killed and  at least 200 wounded in a series of car bomb and suicide attacks in the syrian cities of jableh and tartus in government-controlled territory that hosts russian military bases. the islamic state of iraq and the levant group claims responsibility.

headline: yemeni civil war
text: at least 41 army recruits are killed and 60 others injured in a suicide car bomb attack in aden, yemen. the islamic state of iraq and the levant group claims responsibility.
at least 13 suspected al-qaeda militants and two soldiers are killed in a raid in aden, yemen.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: the afghan taliban announces that haibatullah akhundzada will be its new leader replacing akhtar mansour who died recently in a drone strike. sirajuddin haqqani and mullah yaqoob are named as deputy leaders.
a suicide bomb attack kills at least 10 people and injures four people travelling on a bus for appeals court staff travelling west of kabul.

headline: syrian civil war
text: united states-backed syrian democratic forces begin an offensive to regain control of the city of manbij in the aleppo governorate from isil.

headline: australian east coast low
text: three bodies have been discovered in flood waters: two in the state of new south wales and one in the australian capital territory. two people are missing in tasmania.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: a blast occurs at a mosque in a small village in the nangarhar province, killing four people and injuring nearly 40 more.

headline: afghanistan–pakistan skirmishes
text: afghan and pakistani soldiers clash at the torkham border crossing between the two countries, leaving one afghan soldier and a pakistani major killed. at least 22 other people were also injured. tensions between afghanistan and pakistan have grown since the latter's attempts to build a gate at the crossing.

headline: spillover of the syrian civil war
text: the syrian observatory for human rights reports at least eight people, including four children, are shot and killed, and another eight wounded by turkish border guards. the group was trying to cross from northwestern syria into turkey's hatay province.

headline: 2016 west virginia flood
text: the kanawha county sheriff's office reports the death toll is now 26—three more victims  were found overnight. it is the third-deadliest flood in west virginia history.

headline: atatürk airport attack turkey–isil conflict
text: suspected isil militants attack  turkey's istanbul atatürk airport. turkish prime minister binali yıldırım says 36 people were killed, as were the three suicide bombers. justice minister bekir bozdağ says 147 were wounded.   ,

headline: kurdish–turkish conflict
text: turkish armed forces state two soldiers are killed and three wounded  in a pair of attacks by kurdistan workers' party fighters in diyarbakır province in the country's southeast.

headline: south sudanese civil war
text: five soldiers between the two rival sudan people's liberation army factions are killed in clashes in the capital juba, with reports of heavy gunfire continuing, despite president salva kiir mayardit and rebel leader riek machar having reached a peace deal back in april.

headline: war in somalia
text: al-shabaab claim responsibility for a double suicide car bombing attack in mogadishu near an african union base at the city's airport. at least 13 people are killed, including seven un guards.

headline: 2016 macedonian floods
text: floods in macedonia's capital, skopje, kill at least 21 people with  six others missing and dozens injured following torrential rain and strong winds late saturday.

headline: 2016 ethiopian protests
text: more than fifty protesters are killed by ethiopian security forces over the last few days. the government restricted internet and journalist access to the country.

headline: yemeni civil war
text: at least 10 children are killed and 28 injured in an air attack on a school in northern yemen. the houthi group claims that the saudi arabia led coalition is responsible.

headline: 2016 central italy earthquake
text: a 6.2 magnitude earthquake occurs in central italy near the city of perugia. the mayor of the town of amatrice reports that residents are buried under rubble.
at least 159 people have been reported dead. ,

headline: colombian conflict
text: the president of colombia juan manuel santos announces that he will sign the peace deal with the revolutionary armed forces of colombia or farc on september 26.

headline: syrian civil war
text: the obama administration claims that russia was responsible for the bombing of a united nations aid convoy near aleppo on september 19. russia denies its involvement. in the aftermath of the attack, the united nations suspends all aid convoys in syria.
an airstrike yesterday on a medical facility near aleppo kills five french medical charity workers.
the united states secretary of state john kerry calls for a no-fly zone over northern syria, in response to the recent airstrikes on an aid convoy and medical facility in the aleppo governorate.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: a u.s. drone strike in nangarhar province kills at least 21 people.

headline: syrian civil war
text: a suspected female suicide bomber kills at least 20 people at a kurdish wedding in the syrian city of al-hasakah.
a united states air force drone strike kills a senior leader in the syrian militant group jabhat fateh al-sham, egyptian-born abu al-faraj al-masri, in jisr al-shughur, idlib governorate.

headline: european migrant crisis
text: the italian coast guard rescues more than 5,600 migrants, in one of the biggest operations in a single day.

headline: 2016 pacific typhoon season
text: typhoon chaba heads for western japan with the islands of shikoku and kyushu experiencing heavy rainfall.
chaba leaves at least four people dead, and three others missing in south korea.

headline: saudi arabian-led intervention in yemen
text: saudi-led coalition jets launch airstrikes on civilians at the funeral of the father of the houthi government's interior minister in sana'a, killing at least 140 people, and injuring over 500 more. one of the dead is the mayor of sana'a, abdul-qader hilal. , ,

headline: boko haram
text: negotiations between the nigerian president's administration and islamist militants free 21 of the 270 schoolgirls kidnapped in 2014 by boko haram in chibok, nigeria .

headline: war in donbass
text: a bomb placed in an elevator shaft kills pro-russian, high-ranking officer of the donetsk people's republic's special forces, arseny pavlov, also known as "motorola", in donetsk. ,

headline: sectarianism in pakistan 2016 khuzdar bombing
text: at least 52 people, including women and children, have been killed and more than 100 injured by a bomb explosion in the crowded shah noorani shrine in hub town, lasbela district, balochistan, pakistan. isil has claimed responsibility.   ,

headline: terrorism in indonesia
text: a child is killed and three other children are wounded in an attack in samarinda.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: four members of the afghan national security forces are killed and 11 people are injured during a suicide bomber attack near the afghan defense ministry headquarters in kabul.

headline: terrorism in pakistan
text: at least four are killed in an attack in quetta, pakistan. islamic state of iraq and the levant claims responsibility.

headline: pukhrayan train derailment
text: at least 142 people are killed and over 200 injured as the indore–patna express derails near pukhrayan in the indian state of uttar pradesh.
minister of railways suresh prabhu orders an inquiry.
rescue efforts continue as dozens of people are still trapped in carriages.

headline: boko haram insurgency
text: a militant attack on a base in lake chad leaves six cameroonian soldiers dead.

headline: iraqi civil war
text: november 2016 hillah suicide truck bombing
at least 80 shia pilgrims are killed in a truck bomb attack in iraq. islamic state of iraq and the levant claims responsibility.

headline: war in somalia
text: fighting between militia and al-shabaab militants has left at least 26 people dead.

headline: syrian civil war
text: aleppo offensive
at least ten people are killed and others were injured during air strikes on aleppo's bab al-nairab neighborhood.
government forces and their allies announce plans to capture the remainder of aleppo before american president-elect donald trump takes office in january.

the u.s. releases a report on the coalition's september 2016 deir ez-zor air raid on the syrian army, blaming the syrian troops for their misidentification as islamic state troops due to them allegedly "not wearing recognizable military uniforms or carrying identifying flags."

headline: 2016–17 uk and ireland windstorm season
text: the met office issues warnings for parts of scotland, northern england and northern ireland as storm barbara prepares to make landfall.

headline: northern mali conflict
text: a suicide bomber detonates a vehicle full of explosives at a military camp in gao, mali, killing at least 76 people and wounding scores more in mali's deadliest terrorist attack in history.

headline: kuneru train derailment
text: the hirakhand express 18448, a scheduled passenger train from jagdalpur to bhubaneswar, derails near kuneru in the indian state of andhra pradesh. at least 25 are killed and around 200 others are injured.

headline: quebec city mosque shooting
text: french-canadian student alexandre bissonnette is charged with six counts of murder and five counts of attempted murder in relation to an attack on a mosque in quebec city.

headline: syrian civil war
text: the isil-affiliated syrian opposition group jaysh khaled bin waleed overwhelms tahrir al-sham and southern front militants, capturing the towns of tasil and saham al-jawlan, along with two other villages and a hill in daraa governorate.

headline: war in north-west pakistan
text: multiple suicide bombers kill at least six people near a district court in charsadda. jamaat-ul-ahrar claimed responsibility for the attack.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: an explosion in kabul leads to several casualties. afghan police report that the attack was aimed at a member of the national assembly, fakori behishti.

headline: mid-january 2017 north american ice storm
text: a winter storm pours ice rain on the great plains and american midwest, causes power outages, school closures, and a traffic fatality in missouri.

headline: january 2017 central italy earthquakes
text: four earthquakes of magnitude 5.1 or higher strike near amatrice, italy, forcing evacuation of some schools and the rome metro. no deaths are reported from the quakes.

headline: war in somalia
text: unknown gunmen storm a hotel in bosaso, leaving at least four guards and two militants dead. it is unclear who carried out the attack. an official blames al-shabaab, though the group denies having any involvement.

headline: syrian civil war battle of al-bab
text: syrian rebels and turkish troops enter al-bab, with syrian troops also approaching the town, prompting heavy clashes with isil militants.

headline: war in north-west pakistan
text: an overnight pakistani counter-terrorism raid kills five members of the banned jamaat-ul-ahrar, which has claimed responsibility for recent deadly terrorist attacks. four militants escaped.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: at least 11 people, all belonging to the same family, are killed in a grenade attack on their home in laghman province, according to provincial officials.

headline: israeli–palestinian conflict
text: israeli security forces arrest 16 palestinian suspects on the west bank.

headline: armenian–azerbaijani border conflict
text: 2016 armenian–azerbaijani clashes
armenia and azerbaijan exchange gunfire for the third successive day after an escalation of a dispute over the boundaries between azerbaijan and the disputed nagorno-karabakh republic.

headline: syrian civil war
text: the syrian observatory for human rights claims that the al-nusra front as well as other insurgents have captured the village of tel el-ais in a strategic position overlooking the highway between aleppo and damascus.

the official syrian arab news agency  reports a mass grave, containing the bodies of beheaded women and children, has been found in the former isil-controlled city of palmyra, recently retaken by the syrian government.

headline: iraqi civil war
text: hīt offensive

iraqi security forces free a large number of prisoners from an underground isil-operated jail in the city of hīt. malallah al-obeidi, a local official in the al anbar governorate, put the number of freed prisoners at around 1,500, saying most of them were civilians.

headline: 2016 ecuador earthquake
text: a magnitude 7.8 earthquake strikes off the coast of ecuador, near the town of muisne. the pacific tsunami warning center issues a tsunami alert for coastal areas of ecuador and colombia. at least 42 people are reported dead with deaths reported in the cities of manta, guayaquil and portoviejo.
a state of emergency is declared in six provinces.

later, the pacific tsunami warning center announces the threat has largely passed. the  united states geological survey reports  the  7.8 magnitude quake was preceded, 11 minutes earlier, by a 4.8 earthquake. production at the  110,000 barrel-per-day esmeraldas refinery is suspended  as a precautionary measure.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: april 2016 kabul attack
the death toll from yesterday's taliban attack on the national directorate of security in kabul rises to 64, with 347 others wounded, according to the afghan interior ministry.

headline: war in north-west pakistan
text: the pakistani taliban claims the killing of a sikh lawmaker, soran singh.

headline: iraqi civil war
text: at least 14 people have been killed in suicide bombing attacks in baghdad.

headline: kurdish–turkish conflict
text: two turkish soldiers are killed and four are wounded in an attack by kurdish militants in southeastern turkey.
the kurdistan workers' party  warns turkey it is preparing to intensify its fight.

headline: attacks on secularists in bangladesh
text: xulhaz mannan, a bangladeshi employee of a u.s. charity , who is also an editor for the country's only lgbt magazine, and a friend are hacked to death in dhaka, bangladesh, by suspected islamist militants. guards at the building were also injured.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: resolute support mission
two romanian soldiers are killed along with assailants in an insider attack in afghanistan.

headline: sinai insurgency
text: gunmen kill eight policemen in an ambush outside cairo. the attack is claimed by islamic state.

headline: iraqi civil war
text: operation breaking terrorism, siege of fallujah
iraqi prime minister haider al-abadi announces the start of a military operation to recapture falluja from islamic state of iraq and syria.

headline: northern mali conflict
text: four un peacekeepers are killed in a suspected al-qaeda attack in northern mali.

headline: 2016 fort mcmurray wildfire
text: residents return to fort mcmurray for the first time  since may 1. a couple thousand firefighters, from as far away as  south africa, continue to battle the 5,800 square kilometer  canadian blaze that has crossed the alberta border into saskatchewan.

headline: 2016 aktobe shootings
text: kazakhstan police report the death toll from sunday's attack in aktobe is now 19 — three civilians, three national guard servicemen, and 13 attackers.

headline: 2016 aktobe shootings
text: kazakh police kill five additional suspected militants in aktobe as part of a "counterterrorism operation".

headline: war in afghanistan
text: fighting breaks out between isil militants and afghan police in the haska mina district, nangarhar province, leaving six police officers and 15 militants dead, according to officials.

headline: 2016 orlando nightclub shooting
text: city officials in orlando, florida, continue to identify the bodies of the victims in yesterday's attack. so far, 33 of the reported 49 victims have been identified and their families notified.

headline: 2016 jiangsu tornado
text: a tornado, accompanied by heavy rainfall and hailstones, kills at least 98 people and injures 800 in the eastern chinese province of jiangsu . one-hour rainfall reached 102 millimeters  in lianshui county.

headline: iraqi civil war
text: at least 12 people are killed and 32 more are injured in a suicide bombing in baghdad.

headline: egyptair flight 804
text: data from one of the flight recorders from egyptair flight 804 shows that there was smoke on board when the airbus a320 crashed into the water. soot has also been found on the wreckage.

headline: allied democratic forces insurgency
text: suspected allied democratic forces rebels hack nine people to death in the village of oicha, democratic republic of the congo.

headline: iraqi civil war military intervention against isil
text: the united states announces it will be sending 560 more united states armed forces soldiers to iraq to help fight against isil.

headline: iraqi civil war
