text: a suicide bomber detonates a pick-up truck full of explosives at a busy street in northern baghdad, killing at least nine people.

headline: yemeni civil war
text: 2016 aden car bombing
at least 22 people are killed following three suicide bombings in the yemeni port city of aden. the islamic state of iraq and the levant claims responsibility for the bombings.

headline: 2016 kolkata overpass collapse
text: at least 21 people are killed, 70 injured and up to 150 people are feared trapped after a half-built overpass collapses in the indian city of kolkata.

headline: iraqi civil war
text: more than 20 people have been killed in attacks targeting shiite militias and government forces.

headline: military intervention against isil
text: the united states air force deploys b-52 bombers to al udeid air base in qatar to join operations against isil in syria and iraq. this is the first time they have been stationed in the middle east since the end of the gulf war in 1991.

headline: israeli–palestinian conflict
text: 2016 jerusalem bus bombing

a bomb explosion in jerusalem set two buses on fire and injured 21 people with ball bearing and nails. israeli police say they believe the incident was a suicide bombing but no group has claimed responsibility.

headline: european migrant crisis
text: more than 400 migrants, mostly from somalia, drown in the mediterranean sea while traveling from egypt to italy.

headline: 2016 houston floods
text: heavy rain of more than 1 foot  causes major flooding in houston, texas, affecting 1,000 homes, causing five deaths and causing power outages for over 100,000 residents. , ,
texas governor greg abbott declares nine counties in the southeastern part of the state disaster areas.

headline: syrian civil war
text: the syrian observatory for human rights reports that airstrikes have killed at least seven people in aleppo.

headline: burundian unrest
text: a senior burundian army general, athanase kararuza, an ethnic tutsi and security advisor to burundi vice-president gaston sindimwo, is shot dead by heavily armed men  in the capital bujumbura.

the office of the united nations high commissioner for human rights announces that  the international criminal court will conduct a preliminary examination of the violence in burundi over the past year that has killed hundreds, and forced hundreds of thousands to flee abroad.

headline: syrian civil war
text: a wave of airstrikes on aleppo, syria, kill at least 61 people, including children.
médecins sans frontières claims that victims of a strike on a hospital include 14 patients and doctors.
according to sources from the turkish military, they returned fire into syria, killing 11 isil militants, after its artillery near the border town of karkamış was hit by mortars.

headline: cyclone roanu
text: more than 150 people are feared dead by two landslides triggered by more than three days of heavy rain in central sri lanka.

headline: iraqi civil war
text: operation breaking terrorism
iraqi security forces and shiite popular mobilization forces recapture al-karmah, about 16 kilometers  northeast of fallujah.

headline: european migrant crisis
text: bodies of 117 people, including  75 women, 36 men and six children, are recovered from a beach near zuwarah, libya, possibly from yesterday's capsize  in the mediterranean sea.
greek authorities rescue 340 people from a boat carrying around 700 migrants that capsized 75 nautical miles off the greek island of crete. so far nine bodies have been recovered.

headline: insurgency in the north caucasus
text: four russian security officers and six militants are killed in an anti-terrorism operation in dagestan.

headline: moro conflict
text: the islamic state of iraq and the levant declares war on the philippines.

headline: egyptair flight 804
text: one of the flight recorders of egyptair flight 804 has been fully repaired in paris after being found in the mediterranean sea and will now be sent to egypt to be analyzed.

headline: war in somalia
text: kenyan army forces kill five suspected al-shabaab militants, four during a clash at a military camp in lamu county, and another in malindi.

headline: 2016 gulshan attack
text: gunmen storm a restaurant, exchange fire with security, and take at least twenty hostages in the  gulshan neighborhood of dhaka, bangladesh. two policemen are killed. the islamic state claims responsibility.

headline: iraqi civil war
text: at least 35 people are killed and 60 others injured in an attack on a shiite mausoleum located in north of baghdad. islamic state in iraq and the levant have claimed responsibility. ,

headline: iraqi civil war
text: a car bomb explodes at a checkpoint north of baghdad, killing at least seven people.

headline: 2016 würzburg train attack
text: four people have been injured after a man with an axe attacks people on board a train near würzburg in germany. the axeman has reportedly been shot by police and is reportedly a 17-year-old afghan man who pledged allegiance to isil before the attack. , ,

headline: boko haram insurgency
text: niger, following  attacks by boko haram on bosso and yebi in the lake chad region,  extends for three months a state of emergency in diffa.

headline: 2016 lockhart hot air balloon crash
text: at least 16 people are killed after a hot air balloon catches fire and crashes near lockhart, texas.

headline: 2016 california wildfires
text: the deadly, nine-day old soberanes fire, blazing south of carmel-by-the-sea, has destroyed 57 homes and is expected to grow to 170,000 acres  before it's done. it is 15 percent contained. six major big sur state parks remain closed through august 6.

headline: saudi arabian-led intervention in yemen
text: at least 14 people are killed after saudi-led coalition airstrikes hit a food factory in yemen's capital sana'a. the airstrikes come just days after the suspension of inconclusive peace talks in kuwait.

headline: 2016 louisiana floods
text: louisiana governor john bel edwards declares a state of emergency as over 17 inches of rain  causes unprecedented flooding across the region and takes at least three lives in his state, with more rain expected through sunday.  ,

headline: syrian civil war
text: syrian government warplanes bomb kurdish-held areas of al-hasakah for the first time in the country's five-year civil war, killing at least 13 people.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: a u.s. service member becomes the first u.s. military combat casualty in afghanistan since january 2016 when he is killed by an improvised explosive device  while on patrol near the city of lashkar gah in afghanistan's southern helmand province. another american service member and six afghan soldiers were also injured in the blast.

headline: august 2016 thailand bombings
text: two bombs explode at the southern hotel in pattani killing one person and injuring 30.

headline: moro conflict
text: islamic state of iraq and the levant militants break free supporters from a marawi jail in the philippines.

headline: boko haram insurgency
text: clashes near the village of toumour in niger's southeast diffa region kill at least 30 boko haram militants and five niger armed forces soldiers.

headline: syrian civil war
text: amaq news agency claims isil is responsible for shooting down a syrian air force fighter jet over deir ez-zor. the london-based sohr says the mig pilot was killed.

australia's department of defence acknowledges its participation "among a number of international aircraft" in the deir ez-zor air raid. it says it would "never intentionally target a known syrian military unit or actively support daesh " and offers its condolences.

headline: 2016 pacific typhoon season
text: typhoon malakas makes landfall on the southern japanese island of kyushu dumping heavy rain and causing flight cancellations.

headline: iraqi civil war
text: three bombings kill at least 17 people in baghdad.

headline: aleppo offensive
text: ten thousand pro-government troops, mostly iranian-led shiite militants, amass near aleppo in preparation of a final assault on rebel-held parts of the city.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: the taliban launches an offensive entering the city of kunduz which they briefly captured last year.
a bomb kills one person and leaves two injured in kabul.

headline: battle of aleppo
text: a short ceasefire ends as residents of aleppo prepare for a resumption of bombing.

headline: 2009–16 oklahoma earthquake swarms
text: buildings in cushing, oklahoma, u.s., sustain damage from a moderate 5.0-magnitude earthquake.

headline: internal conflict in myanmar
text: rohingya insurgency in western myanmar
eight people are killed and 36 are arrested in clashes between the myanmar army and what are believed to be rohingya insurgents in rakhine state.

headline: iraqi civil war
text: human rights watch says that kurdish regional government forces have destroyed arab homes and villages in northern iraq in what may amount to a war crime.
battle of mosul
the ancient assyrian city of nimrud, south of mosul, is recaptured by the iraqi army after heavy fighting with isil militants.

headline: 2016–17 uk and ireland windstorm season
text: storm angus brings strong winds and heavy rain to southern england and the channel islands.

headline: fengcheng power station scaffold collapse
text: at least 74 people are dead and many others injured and trapped after a construction platform at a power plant in the chinese city of fengcheng in jiangxi province collapses.

headline: 2016 aceh earthquake
text: international aid organisations arrive in the indonesian province of aceh as the death toll for the earthquake passes 100.

headline: boko haram insurgency
text: madagali suicide bombings
at least 56 are killed and 70 wounded in a twin suicide attack in northeastern nigeria. , , , ,

headline: 2016–17 north american winter
text: two people are killed and at least 15 are hospitalized following a 55-vehicle accident, involving a gas tanker explosion, on interstate 95 in baltimore, maryland, as cold air causes rain and wet roads to freeze across the eastern u.s.  three other deaths are reported from other accidents in the baltimore-washington, d.c. area. at least six people have been killed in total on icy roads.   ,

headline: 2017 oroville dam crisis
text: thousands of people are urged to evacuate in and around the vicinity of yuba city due to the impending failure of an emergency spillway at oroville dam in northern california.   188,000 people were reported to be evacuated.

headline: saudi arabian-led intervention in yemen
text: airstrikes near the yemeni port city of al mukalla, hadhramaut governorate, reportedly kill at least 30 al-qaeda militants.

headline: 2015–16 north american winter
text: late march 2016 north american blizzard

a powerful blizzard sweeping denver, colorado, forces authorities to close denver international airport, interstate 70, interstate 25 and leaves more than 100,000 people without power. the colorado army national guard has been deployed to help rescue those stranded by the storm.

denver international airport reopens at 7 pm .  over 1,300 flights were canceled.  just a few flights are expected to arrive or depart through the night. the national weather service estimates that parts of denver received 19.5 inches of snow as of  3:59 pm .

headline: malaysia airlines flight 370
text: australian infrastructure and transport minister darren chester says in a statement that debris recovered this month in mozambique was highly likely to be from the missing malaysia airlines flight.

headline: military intervention against isil
text: the pentagon announces the death of islamic state of iraq and the levant finance minister and deputy leader, abu ala al-afri.

headline: 2015–16 uk and ireland windstorm season
text: the united kingdom's met office warns of major travel disruption due to heavy rain, flooding and "damaging" high winds as storm katie moves in from the atlantic ocean bringing winds of up to 75mph.

headline: syrian civil war
text: the syrian observatory for human rights reports airstrikes on the village of deir al-asafir, rif dimashq governorate, have killed at least 30 people and left dozens more injured.

headline: nagorno-karabakh conflict
text: 2016 armenian–azerbaijani clashes

azerbaijan calls a unilateral ceasefire in its fight with ethnic armenians one day after 30 soldiers died. the associated press reports rebel forces reject azerbaijan's claims, saying they see no sign the government has stopped fighting. ,

headline: syrian civil war
text: aleppo offensive
the syrian army and its allies launch an offensive south of aleppo.

headline: 2016 afghanistan earthquake
text: a 6.6 magnitude earthquake occurs in northern afghanistan near the pakistan border with tremors felt in north india.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: taliban militants kill eight people, including a police commander, in an ambush in northern afghanistan.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: a battle rages in the kunduz province of afghanistan as the taliban launches its spring offensive to capture the city of kunduz. according to a taliban spokesperson, several outposts already fell to them but this could not be verified immediately while a police chief says that the security forces were keeping "the situation under control".

headline: 2016 ecuador earthquake
text: the death toll from saturday's earthquake has risen to at least 480 with  1,700 missing. another 2,500 have been injured. president rafael correa states it is the worst disaster in ecuador in seven decades, and the reconstruction will have a "huge economic impact" on the country.

headline: 2016 ecuador earthquake
text: a magnitude-6.1 aftershock has struck off the coast of ecuador at 3:33 a.m. local time, the us geological survey says, in the same area as the massive earthquake on saturday. ,
people in ecuador start burying their dead as the death toll from the earthquake passes 500.
president rafael correa announces a sales tax increase, and a one-time levy on millionaires as the country deals with the enormous damage from this disaster.
the death toll rises to 570 with 163 people listed as missing. those made homeless climbs to over 23,500.

headline: syrian civil war
text: at least eight people are reportedly killed as a car bomb explodes at a checkpoint south of damascus.

headline: attacks on secularists in bangladesh
text: a hindu man is hacked to death in tangail district. he is alleged to have made comments against prophet muhammad. islamic state of iraq and the levant claims responsibility for the attack.

headline: turkey–isil conflict spillover of the syrian civil war
text: 2016 gaziantep bombing
a blast hits a police station in the southern turkish city of gaziantep leaving one officer dead and 13 injured.
islamic state of iraq and the levant is suspected to be behind attack.

headline: iraqi civil war american-led intervention in iraq
text: according to the united states department of defense, isil fighters killed a navy seal near erbil. the sailor was assisting kurdish peshmerga forces in repelling an attack on the area. the seal was later identified as arizona native charles keating iv, the son of charles keating iii, and the grandson of the convicted noted late financier charles keating jr., who was embroiled in the 1980s savings and loan scandal.

headline: allied democratic forces insurgency
text: assailants from the allied democratic forces  armed with machetes hacked at least 16 civilians to death in the eastern democratic republic of the congo.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: the taliban leadership council  reportedly meets to determine a successor to mullah akhtar mansour,  killed this weekend during an american drone strike in pakistan.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: suspect taliban militants kill nine and kidnap 170 in an attack on three passenger buses in kunduz, afghanistan.

headline: may 2016 united states storm complex
text: the four missing fort hood soldiers from the overturned light medium tactical vehicle are found dead, bringing the death toll from the accident to nine.

headline: syrian civil war
text: syrian government forces enter raqqa province, the joint capital of islamic state in iraq and the levant. it is one of three simultaneous attacks in iraq and syria.

headline: 2016 atlantic hurricane season
text: florida governor rick scott declares a state of emergency as tropical storm colin's rain and gusty winds pelt the state's west coast. maximum sustained winds at 1:00 p.m. edt are 50 mph . between three and five inches of rain are forecast for northern florida, with some areas getting up to eight inches.
the national hurricane center says this is the earliest a third named storm has ever formed in the atlantic basin.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: the taliban kills 12 members of afghanistan's security forces who were captured in recent ambushes in the ghazni province on june 3 and 5.

headline: israeli–palestinian conflict
text: june 2016 tel aviv shooting
two palestinian gunmen open fire in the israeli city of tel aviv killing at least four people and injuring at least 18 others. the two gunmen are arrested.

headline: moro conflict
text: canadian prime minister justin trudeau says his government has "compelling reason to believe" that robert hall, who was held hostage in the philippines, has been killed by his captors, presumably the same abu sayyaf militants who beheaded another canadian, john ridsdel, on 25 april 2016.

headline: sectarianism in pakistan
text: gunmen kill sufi devotional singer amjad sabri in pakistan with a faction of the pakistani taliban claiming responsibility.

headline: syrian civil war manbij offensive
text: the britain-based syrian observatory for human rights reports isil militants have kidnapped about 900 syrian kurdish civilians from aleppo over the past three weeks in retaliation for the kurdish and us-backed syrian democratic forces attack on manbij. the captives are being forced to build fortifications for the extremists. at least 26 of those abducted reportedly have been killed for refusing to follow isil orders.

headline: war in somalia
text: a suspected al-shabab suicide bomber blows open the gate of mogadishu's nasa-hablod hotel in somalia, before militant fighters storm the building. officials said at least 15 were killed, 25 injured, and an unknown number of guests were taken hostage.  ,

headline: 2016 west virginia flood
text: two men initially thought to have died when a camper was swept away in greenbrier county are found alive, lowering the death toll from the disaster to 20 confirmed fatalities and three others missing and presumed dead.

headline: syrian civil war israel–syria relations
text: israel's military attacks two syrian army targets in syrian territory from the golan heights after a fire from the fighting damages a security fence on the border.

headline: south sudanese civil war
text: after five days of fighting that left 272 people dead and thousands more displaced in the capital, juba, president salva kiir mayardit and rebel leader and vice-president riek machar declare a ceasefire.

headline: south sudanese civil war
text: the united states deploys more than three dozen soldiers to juba, south sudan, to protect the u.s. embassy and help evacuate non-essential embassy staff due to local clashes.

headline: 2016 turkish coup d'état attempt 2016 turkish purges
text: thousands gather in istanbul's taksim square in a show of support for the new powers that president recep tayyip erdoğan has received in order to crackdown on dissent following the attempted coup.

headline: 2016 atlantic hurricane season
text: tropical storm earl makes its final landfall near veracruz in eastern mexico, producing flooding rains that kill at least six. ,

headline: 2016 atlantic hurricane season
text: the death toll from mudslides in eastern mexico triggered by hurricane earl rises to 38, with 28 people killed in puebla, and 10 others in veracruz.

headline: 2016 portugal wildfires
text: a raging wildfire destroys dozens of homes and prompts the evacuation of more than 400 people from portugal's madeira island as flames spread near the island's capital, funchal. regional president miguel albuquerque says one person had suffered serious burns and scores of others had needed treatment for the effects of smoke. flights have also been disrupted at madeira airport due to smoke.

headline: yemeni civil war
text: an air strike by the saudi-led coalition which hit a hospital in northern yemen run by médecins sans frontières  kills at least 11 people.

headline: 2016 pacific typhoon season
text: typhoon mindulle is forecast to make landfall near the japanese capital tokyo with flights and train services being cancelled. it arrives one day after typhoon kompasu. ,

headline: paraguayan people's army insurgency
text: at least eight paraguayan army soldiers are killed in an ambush by suspected paraguayan people's army  insurgents, near the village of arroyito, in northern paraguay.

headline: moro conflict
text: at least 12 philippine army soldiers die in clashes with the abu sayyaf.

headline: 2016 kashmir unrest
text: a curfew has ended in the indian state of jammu and kashmir after 52 days of protest allowing for an all-party delegation to visit the state on sunday.

headline: syrian civil war
text: the islamic state of iraq and the levant says its official spokesman, abu mohammad al-adnani, has been killed in syria's aleppo governorate. the group's statement, distributed by amaq news agency, did not say how al-adnani was killed.

headline: 2016 pacific typhoon season typhoon lionrock
text: at least two rivers break embankments,  causing floods on the northern japanese island of hokkaido. operations are underway to rescue 400 stranded people. on honshu island, at least 11 people, including nine elderly from a nursing home,  have died.

headline: 2016 atlantic hurricane season tropical storm hermine
text: the national hurricane center declares a hurricane watch and tropical storm warning from the anclote river, north of tampa, to destin, florida, near the georgia border.  hermine, now at 45 mph , is expected to reach hurricane strength when it makes landfall thursday afternoon. florida governor rick scott, with life-threatening flooding forecast, declares a state of emergency.

headline: syrian civil war
text: a chlorine attack in aleppo on tuesday injures more than 100 people. the blast from barrel bombs dropped kills one person.

headline: mexican drug war
text: a gang shoots down a police helicopter near apatzingán, michoacán, killing four people. the police had been conducting an operation against criminal groups and drug cartels.

headline: moro conflict
text: abu sayyaf of the philippines allegedly kidnap three filipino fishermen from their trawler off the malaysian state of sabah on borneo island.

headline: 2016 gyeongju earthquake
text: a 5.8-magnitude earthquake occurs in south korea, 9km south of gyeongju, injuring at least two people and causing nationwide panic. it is the strongest earthquake ever recorded in south korea.

headline: war in north-west pakistan
text: two gunmen kill three pakistani army soldiers near the city of peshawar.

headline: yemeni civil war
text: saudi arabian-led air raids on the yemeni capital sana'a resume after a truce ends.

headline: 2016 french fairchild metroliner crash
text: a twin-prop fairchild metroliner mark iii light aircraft crashes shortly after takeoff from malta international airport, killing all five french nationals on board. malta officials say that the aircraft was part of a french customs surveillance operation tracing routes of illicit trafficking, of humans and drugs on libyan coasts, and that the flight was heading for the libyan city of misrata. ,

headline: gadani ship-breaking yard
text: at least 14 people are killed and 59 burned when a gas cylinder explosion aboard an oil tanker causes a major fire at the ship-breaking yard in gadani in pakistan's balochistan province. dozens other workers remain missing as many injured are transferred to hospitals in nearby karachi.

headline: iraqi civil war
text: a suicide bomber kills six people near karbala.
at least eight people are killed and 20 others are injured in car bomb attacks in fallujah.

headline: moro conflict
text: at least 14 are killed in clashes with suspected abu sayyaf militants in sulu, philippines.

headline: libyan civil war
text: at least 16 people are killed and 50 others are wounded in clashes between rival tribes in sabha, libya after a monkey attacks a girl and pulls off her headscarf. ,

headline: war in somalia
text: a car bomb kills at least 20 in mogadishu.

headline: war in donbass
text: as of december 1, the total death toll for the war stands at an estimated 9,758 people according to a united nations report released today.

headline: uyo church collapse
text: at least 60 are killed in a collapse of a church in uyo, nigeria.

headline: uyo church collapse
text: the death toll from yesterday's church collapse in uyo, nigeria, rises to 160 with the death toll expected to rise further.

headline: syrian civil war
text: battle of aleppo, aleppo offensive

the warring parties reach agreement on a ceasefire, now that the fighting has ended,  to allow civilians and the remaining rebel fighters trapped in the besieged syrian city to evacuate. five buses will start  moving to pick up passengers at 5:00 a.m. eet wednesday .

headline: syrian civil war aleppo offensive
text: rebels attack and burn several buses en route to evacuate ill and injured people from the besieged syrian villages of al-fu'ah and kafriya.

headline: afriqiyah airways flight 209
text: an afriqiyah airways flight originating from sabha, libya, is hijacked and forced to make an emergency landing in malta. hijackers threaten to blow up the aircraft with grenades, but the standoff ends peacefully with all hostages released and both hijackers surrendering.

headline: 2016 russian defence ministry tupolev tu-154 crash
text: eleven bodies have so far been recovered from the black sea from yesterday's military aircraft crash. all 92 people on board died.

headline: syrian civil war
text: palmyra offensive
the syrian army and allies make major advances near palmyra against isil as the group start pulling out its equipment from the town.

headline: callaway train crash
text: the evacuation order for the 200-person town of callaway, minnesota, which was emptied after a  canadian pacific train crashed with a propane truck, is lifted. none of the train cars were carrying hazardous materials.

headline: syrian civil war
text: battle of al-qaryatayn
the syrian army retakes control of al-qaryatayn, homs governorate, after driving out isil militants.

the syrian observatory for human rights reports the al-nusra front's spokesperson abu firas al-suri was among 20 militants killed in a suspected russian airstrike on a village near the city of idlib in northwestern syria.

headline: moro attacks on sabah moro conflict
text: four sarawakian malaysians are kidnapped off the coast of sabah by suspected members of the abu sayyaf, a group linked to the islamic state of iraq and the levant.

headline: moro conflict
text: 2016 battle of basilan
at least 18 soldiers are killed and 52 injured in clashes with abu sayyaf militants and allied gunmen in basilan island, philippines.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: the taliban, in a statement claiming responsibility for yesterday's rocket attacks into kabul, afghanistan, says the intended target was u.s. secretary of state john kerry, who was in the capital to help defuse a crisis within the unity government.  kerry had departed less than an hour earlier. no casualties have been reported.

headline: pkk rebellion
text: a car bomb attack on a turkish gendarmerie in the town of hani kills at least two people and injures 50.

headline: april 2016 myanmar earthquake
text: a magnitude 6.9 earthquake strikes myanmar 396 kilometers  north of the capital, naypyidaw, according to the u.s. geological survey.

headline: syrian civil war
text: a syrian government airstrike near aleppo kills at least five members of the syrian civil defense rescue organisation. dozens of people have been killed in aleppo over the past few days from government airstrikes and opposition bombardment.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: the u.s. military warns that the kabul attack network,  comprised of fighters from various jihadist groups such as  the  taliban and haqqani networks, is planning attacks on people in the parwan, khost, kabul, and logar provinces, afghanistan, and asks for information from the afghan public.

headline: 2016 fort mcmurray wildfire
text: alberta authorities update information about the fire.  about 2,400 homes and buildings were destroyed, but firefighters saved 25,000 others in the city, including the hospital, municipal buildings, and every functioning school. they expect most of the 88,000 evacuees will return to their homes within two weeks. the fire, which has merged with another blaze, is about 884 square miles  in size. the majority of canada's oil sands industry, and a third of the country's total oil output, is offline, though shell canada has restarted its albian sands mining operations.

headline: iraqi civil war
text: ar-rutbah offensive

iraqi army forces helped by u.s. airstrikes recapture the southwestern city of ar-rutbah from the islamic state of iraq and the levant group. the victory will allow for the re-opening of the baghdad-amman highway.

headline: cyclone roanu
text: sri lanka's disaster management centre reports 92 people are confirmed dead with 109 people still missing from landslides and floods resulting from roanu. more than 500,000 have been driven from their homes.

bangladesh reports at least 26 deaths caused by drowning or homes collapsing with 500,000 evacuated during the storm. maheshkhali island officials are monitoring a badly damaged 17-mile stretch of mud embankment in danger of collapsing, allowing seawater to flood the communities.

headline: war in somalia
text: al-shabaab says it has killed at least 60 ethiopian soldiers in an attack on a amisom base in central somalia.

headline: iraqi civil war  military intervention against isil third battle of fallujah
text: the iraqi government recaptures the main government compound in fallujah.

headline: syrian civil war
text: at least three people are killed and three more injured as hundreds of syrian kurds flee aleppo province villages controlled by the islamic state of iraq and the levant, which continues to abduct and enslave kurds.  yesterday, the syrian observatory for human rights reported isil militants have kidnapped about 900 civilians over the past three weeks.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: an afghan national security forces convoy outside kabul is attacked in a coordinated ambush including suicide bombers and heavy machine guns resulting in over 40 deaths.

headline: boko haram insurgency
text: at least 15 people are killed and 50 are wounded following two suicide bombings in cameroon's far north region.

headline: 2016 istanbul airport attack
text: a turkish official reports the three suspected islamic state suicide bombers who killed 44 people and wounded 238 others were russian, uzbek, and kyrgyz nationals.

headline: 2016 pacific typhoon season
text: taiwan and china brace for the impact of typhoon nepartak, the first major typhoon of 2016. thousands of people have been evacuated in taiwan while over 35,000 military personnel have been placed on standby to help with relief efforts.

typhoon nepartak is expected to make landfall on mainland china on friday and will make flooding worse. nearly 200 people have died in flood waters in china in the past week with 41 people missing, 1.6 million relocated and almost 50,000 houses collapsed.

headline: insurgency in jammu and kashmir
text: 2016 kashmir unrest

at least three people are killed and dozens more are wounded when protesters clash with indian army soldiers. the protesters defied an army curfew and took part in the funeral of a top rebel commander of hizbul mujahideen.

headline: typhoon nepartak
text: taiwan is recovering after typhoon nepartak hit yesterday killing two people and injuring 72.

headline: war in somalia
text: a suspected militant of al-shabaab shoots and kills four kenyan police officers at a police station in kapenguria, kenya, where he was being held. the militant was later killed following a shootout with police.

headline: july 2016 north china cyclone
text: floods kill at least 154 in china and 300,000 people are being evacuated in hebei province. villagers have accused local officials of covering up the extent of the damage.

headline: 2016 ansbach bombing
text: fifteen people are injured following a suicide bombing in ansbach, germany.

headline: iraqi civil war
text: islamic state militants attack two gas facilities northwest of kirkuk in northern iraq, killing at least five people and wounding six policemen. three assailants detonated their explosive vests and a fourth was killed in clash with security forces.

headline: 2016 pacific typhoon season
text: typhoon nida makes landfall near hong kong with  category 1 hurricane strength.

headline: 2016 rouen fire
text: a fire kills at least 13 people in a bar in the french city of rouen.

headline: syrian civil war
text: the syrian observatory for human rights says that at least 51 people have been killed in the syrian city of aleppo.

headline: boko haram insurgency
text: in a raid on boko haram islamists' northeast heartland, nigeria’s air force kills senior militants and possibly fatally wounds their leader, abubakar shekau.

headline: philippine drug war
text: the death toll in rodrigo duterte's war on drugs reaches 1,900 people killed.

headline: syrian civil war
text: several bombings kill at least 40 people in government and kurdish held territory across syria, including tartus, homs, al-hasakah and damascus. the islamic state of iraq and the levant claims responsibility.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: united states navy seals, by high altitude parachuting, fail in a rescue attempt after the team does not find the american and australian hostages who were kidnapped in kabul last month.

headline: st. cloud, minnesota mall stabbing
text: a mass stabbing at crossroads center in st. cloud, minnesota, u.s., leaves nine injured. an off-duty police officer shoots dead the perpetrator, dahir adan.
isil-affiliated media wing amaq news agency claims responsibility for the act.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: afghan officials say yesterday's u.s. airstrikes killed up to eight afghan policemen in lashkar gah, uruzgan.

headline: iraqi civil war
text: a triple suicide bomb attack north of tikrit kills at least 11 and injures another 34 members of iraqi security forces.

headline: syrian civil war
text: russian and syrian government attacks on rebel-held east aleppo kill two people and injure 13 others. the syrian american medical society reports the city's main trauma hospital closes. ,

headline: terrorism in bangladesh
text: raids by security forces on jamaat-ul-mujahideen bangladesh in gazipur leave 11 militants dead. , ,

headline: 2016 atlantic hurricane season
text: hurricane matthew, responsible for killing 13 people and knocking out power to 2.2 million households and businesses in the southeastern united states, is now a category 1 hurricane  approaching the north carolina coast. , ,

headline: war in afghanistan
text: a suicide bombing kills at least 14 people, mostly police officers, in lashkargah, helmand province, as taliban insurgents advance upon the afghan city.
a gunman kills 14 people at a shi'ite shrine in kabul on a holy day.

headline: iraqi civil war  2016 october baghdad attacks
text: attacks targeting a shi'ite muslim gathering, a police check-point, and the family of an anti-islamic state sunni paramilitary leader, kill at least 55 people in iraq.
isil claims responsibility as a response to take back launching of its stronghold mosul by the iraqi forces.

headline: yemeni crisis
text: the united states navy's uss mason is fired on for the third time in a week from territory controlled by houthi forces in yemen, while in international waters of the red sea. the ship deployed countermeasures and was not struck, according to u.s. officials.

headline: european migration crisis
text: november 2016 libya migrant shipwrecks
the united nations believes that at least 239 migrants drowned in shipwrecks near the coast of libya. ,

headline: kurdish–turkish conflict
text: a car bomb kills at least eight people and injures up to 100 in diyarbakır, turkey.

headline: american-led intervention in syria syrian civil war
text: centcom reports a u.s. service member has been killed in a ied blast near the town of ayn issa, al-raqqah governorate, becoming the first u.s. military casualty in the conflict.

headline: insurgency in the north caucasus ingushetia insurgency
text: two russian special forces and two suspected militants are killed in a gunfight in nazran, ingushetia.

headline: turkey–isil conflict
text: turkish armed forces  claim that an islamic state of iraq and the levant rocket attack on turkish-backed syrian rebel forces caused symptoms of chemical weapons in 22 soldiers.

headline: kurdish–turkish conflict
text: a military operation leaves three turkish soldiers dead and another three wounded in hakkâri province, turkey.

headline: libyan civil war
text: at least eight are killed in clashes in tripoli, libya. ,

headline: 2016 southeastern united states wildfires
text: the death toll from the wildfire that hit the u.s. town of gatlinburg, tennessee, rises to 13.

headline: 2016 aceh earthquake
text: at least 96 people are killed following a 6.4 magnitude earthquake in indonesia's aceh region. hundreds of people are injured and several buildings have collapsed.  , ,

headline: hitrino train derailment
text: at least seven people have been killed and 25 others are injured after an explosion caused by the derailment of a train carrying propane and butane in the bulgarian village of hitrino, near shumen.

headline: 2016 berlin attack
text: the islamic state of iraq and the levant claims responsibility via amaq news agency for the truck attack in berlin, germany, which left at least 12 people dead and 49 injured.

headline: january 2017 baghdad bombings
text: a series of attacks kill at least 70 people and injure more than 100 others in mostly shiite neighborhoods of baghdad, iraq.

headline: january 2017 jerusalem vehicular attack
text: a truck rams into a group of israeli soldiers in a deliberate attack in east jerusalem, killing four and wounding 21. the perpetrator was previously convicted of terrorism and was jailed for 10 years.

headline: january 2017 jerusalem vehicular attack
text: israeli prime minister benjamin netanyahu blames the islamic state for the attack that killed four soldiers and injured 15 others in east jerusalem.

headline: 2017 rigopiano avalanche
text: an italian rescue official says a number of people have been killed by an avalanche, possibly connected to wednesday's earthquakes, that buried a ski resort on a slope of the  gran sasso mountain in italy's abruzzo region. about 30 guests and staff  were at the hotel.  the only survivors are two men who had been outside when the disaster struck.

headline: syrian civil war russian military intervention
text: the russian defence ministry says six russian bombers  hit isil positions in syria's deir ez-zor governorate.

headline: syrian civil war
text: the organisation for the prohibition of chemical weapons says, for the first time, that they suspect syrian president bashar al-assad and other senior officials of the syrian government are responsible for the use of chemical weapons in the conflict.

headline: battle of mosul
text: iraqi forces capture parts of mosul university and several areas along the tigris river from islamic state militants. ,

headline: war in north-west pakistan
text: 2017 parachinar bombing
at least 22 people are killed and around 90 injured after a bomb explodes at a vegetable market in parachinar in the federally administered tribal areas of pakistan. , , ,
lashkar-i-jhangvi al-alami and tehreek-i-taliban pakistan released joint statements claiming responsibility through text messages sent to journalists. ,

headline: rigopiano avalanche
text: the death toll from the avalanche which buried the four-star luxury resort hotel rigopiano on 18 january rises to seventeen, with twelve others still missing.

headline: 2016–17 rohingya persecution in myanmar
text: the united nations human rights council releases a report detailing mass atrocities by the military and police forces against myanmar's rohingya minority, including gang-rapes, mass killings, and possible ethnic cleansing, which could amount to crimes against humanity.

headline: boko haram insurgency
text: up to seven suicide bombers blow themselves up after failing in an attempt to attack a camp for displaced people near maiduguri, nigeria.

headline: war in somalia
text: a car bomb explodes in the wadajir district of mogadishu, killing at least 20 people and injuring 50 more.

headline: 2017 afghanistan avalanches
text: at least 25 people are killed by snowstorms and avalanches in northern afghanistan as heavy snow continues to hit the country.

headline: libyan civil war
text: a motorcade carrying prime minister fayez al-sarraj of the internationally recognized government of national accord, is attacked by unidentified gunmen in tripoli. there were no injuries reported.

headline: 2016–17 uk and ireland windstorm season
text: the met office issues travel warnings for parts of wales, scotland and england as storm doris, described as a “weather bomb”, brings gales, heavy rain and snow to the united kingdom. at least one person is killed.

headline: syrian civil war raqqa offensive
text: u.s.-backed sdf forces on two fronts meet up northeast of raqqa, encircling a pocket of villages still held by isis.

headline: 2017 essendon airport beechcraft king air crash
text: a charter plane crashes into a direct factory outlets shopping centre in melbourne, australia, shortly after taking off from essendon airport, killing the five people on board.

headline: syrian civil war battle of al-bab
text: the turkish-backed free syrian army captures al-bab from isil after months of fighting.
a car bomb explodes in the syrian village of sousian, north of al-bab, killing at least 60 people. , ,

headline: moro conflict
text: the abu sayyaf militant group beheads their german hostage jurgen kantner in indanan, philippines.

headline: syrian civil war
text: the syrian observatory for human rights reports that militants attacked two syrian armed forces bases in homs, killing at least 42 people, including a senior intelligence officer. ,

headline: yemeni civil war
text: at least eight yemeni soldiers are killed in a suicide bombing at a military camp in zinjibar.

headline: iraqi civil war
text: shifa gardi, a prominent female reporter for rudaw media network, is killed by a roadside bomb while reporting on the battle for mosul.

headline: nagorno-karabakh conflict
text: clashes erupt between nagorno-karabakh separatists and azerbaijani forces in the disputed nagorno-karabakh region. the azerbaijan ministry of defense confirmed casualties on its side while the separatist forces claim to have no causalities. both sides blame each other for the flareup in fighting.

headline: battle of mosul
text: iraqi police forces enter the mosul international airport and capture the runway from islamic state of iraq and the levant.

headline: war in north-west pakistan
text: at least six people are killed in a bomb blast in the pakistani city of lahore.

headline: syrian civil war
text: the syrian army recaptures the strategic town of tadef from isil, south of al-bab, securing key transportation routes in eastern aleppo governorate.

headline: foreign involvement in the syrian civil war
text: the iraqi air force strikes isil targets inside syria for the first time in response to recent bombings in baghdad.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: according to officials, at least 11 people, mostly police officers, are killed outside a mosque in jowzjan province in an ambush by militants. the taliban claimed responsibility for the attack.

headline: yemeni civil war
text: a houthi missile attack on a yemeni military camp near the port city of mocha  kills major general ahmed saif al-yafei, yemen's deputy chief of staff, and several others.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: according to provincial officials, at least eight people are killed and another 22 are injured by a roadside bomb in farah province. however, according to locals, the attack was actually an airstrike.

headline: 2016–17 south-west indian ocean cyclone season
text: intense, category 4 cyclone enawo is intensifying, as it closes in on the northern tip of madagascar.

headline: 2016–17 south-west indian ocean cyclone season
text: cyclone enawo makes landfall in madagascar as a powerful category 4 storm, making it the most powerful storm to strike the african nation in 13 years.

headline: 2017 guatemala orphanage fire
text: the death toll at the fire at an orphanage in san josé pinula, guatemala, rises to at least 35 children.

headline: naxalite–maoist insurgency
text: at least 11 central reserve police force troops are killed after their convoy is attacked by suspected communist party of india militants in chhattisgarh.

headline: boko haram insurgency
text: four suicide bombers kill at least two people and wound 16 others in maiduguri, nigeria.

headline: syrian civil war
text: raqqa offensive
a u.s.-led coalition airstrike on a school west of raqqa, kills at least 33 people.
syrian rebels, led by tahrir al-sham, launch an offensive in the hama governorate, capturing the towns of suran, khitab and al-majdal.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: according to a local police chief, at least seven militants are killed by afghan security forces in logar province.

headline: south sudanese civil war
text: government-aligned militias kill 16 people during a raid in wau, south sudan.

headline: borussia dortmund team bus bombing
text: three explosions occur near the borussia dortmund football team bus as it slowed down to turn a corner. spanish player marc bartra was injured and has been taken to hospital. dortmund's uefa champions league fixture against as monaco fc is subsequently postponed.

headline: 2017 jerusalem light rail stabbing
text: a british student is stabbed and killed during an attack on a light-rail train in jerusalem, israel. two other passengers are injured. a palestinian man with a history of mental problems and other issues is taken into custody by israeli authorities. israeli finance minister moshe kahlon linked the attack to terrorism.

headline: south thailand insurgency
text: joint bomb and gun attacks kill at least two in narathiwat, pattani, and songkhla provinces of thailand, the latest in a long string of such attacks.

headline: asian dust
text: a severe dust storm impacts north china, causing flight cancellations at beijing capital international airport.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: pope francis criticizes naming the u.s. military's biggest non-nuclear explosive as the mother of all bombs, saying that the word "mother" should not be used in reference to a deadly weapon.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: a roadside bomb kills at least 11 people, all from the same family, in logar province.

headline: 2017 manchester arena bombing
text: campaigning in the united kingdom general election is suspended after the bombing at the manchester arena. the death toll is 22 with 59 injured. isil claims responsibility. singer and actress ariana grande suspends her dangerous woman tour. , ,
the man suspected of carrying out the manchester attack is identified as 22-year-old salman abedi, who died at the scene. abedi was born in manchester to libyan parents.
prime minister theresa may says the government has raised its terrorism threat level to critical, the highest level, which indicates another attack may be imminent.

headline: battle of mosul
text: the united states military reports that their investigation found 105 civilians were killed and 36 people are still missing from the bombing of a mosul building on march 17.

headline: syrian civil war
text: the u.s.-backed syrian democratic forces  says they will counter iraq’s mostly iran-backed popular mobilization forces  militants if the latter enters areas under sdf control, insisting that sdf will never accept the presence of iran and sdf will never under any circumstances act as a bridge between pmu and the syria's assad regime.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: june 2017 kabul attack
according to the interior ministry, three blasts at a funeral attended by mps and government figures in kabul kill at least seven people and wound 119 more.

headline: 2017 tehran attacks
text: iranian intelligence ministry releases the names and other information about the five attackers of the day before.

headline: american-led intervention in syria
text: in its third strike near the town of al-tanf in recent weeks, the united states bombs syrian government and allied troops, striking two out of three technical vehicles about 24 miles from the u.s. coalition's at-tanf base in southern syria.

shortly after bombing syrian government and allied troops near al-tanf, the united states shoots down a iranian-made syrian government drone that was flying toward u.s.-led coalition forces in southern syria. there are no injuries or damage. an american official says this is first time forces supporting damascus have attacked coalition troops.

headline: 2017 portugal wildfires
text: the death toll from forest fires in pedrógão grande, central portugal, rises to at least 62. many victims were trapped on the road between the towns of figueiró dos vinhos and castanheira de pera. , , .

headline: war in afghanistan
text: 2017 lashkargah bombing
a car bomb outside a new kabul bank branch in lashkargah, helmand province, kills at least 20 people. the taliban claims responsibility.

headline: 2017 sichuan landslide
text: an early-morning landslide buries 40 homes and leaves 15 people dead and 114 others missing in aba prefecture, sichuan province, china. at least 500 rescue workers are on scene, and a 2-km stretch of the river in mao county is blocked.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: officials announce that afghan security forces have retaken nawa district from the taliban.

headline: earthquakes in 2017
text: a 7.7 magnitude earthquake strikes off russia's kamchatka peninsula, west of the alaskan aleutian island of attu, in the north pacific ocean. no immediate reports of casualties or damage; a tsunami warning was cancelled.

headline: 2017 amman incident
text: a shooting at the israeli embassy in amman, jordan, leaves one person, a jordanian, dead, and an israeli and a jordanian wounded. there is speculation the attack may be linked to recent events at jerusalem's  al-aqsa mosque. another jordanian man was killed inadvertently.

headline: florida manatee
text: snooty, formerly the world's oldest west indian manatee, dies at age 69 after being trapped in the plumbing of the south florida museum.

headline: 2017 sierra leone mudslides
text: a mass burial of victims of the landslide is held in freetown to free up space in mortuaries. nearly 400 people are confirmed dead with at least 600 missing.

headline: iraqi civil war
text: battle of tal afar

iraqi security forces, along with shi'ite volunteers and kurdish peshmerga fighters,  launch a ground offensive to take the city of tal afar back from islamic state of iraq and the levant militants. the city has been isolated from the rest of the isil-held territory since the recent mosul liberation.

headline: 2017 pacific typhoon season
text: tropical storm pakhar hits hong kong and macau with sustained winds of 100 km/h  and heavy rain, four days after deadly typhoon hato passed through the area.

headline: haze east sussex
text: police issued a warning and evacuation orders after a unknown chemical "haze" leaves over 200 people on britain's south coast, between the towns of eastbourne and birling gap, suffering irritation to their eyes and throats.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: a suicide bomber kills five people at the entrance of a kabul bank subsidiary near the embassy of the united states in kabul. the taliban claims their attack targeted soldiers and police withdrawing their salaries.

headline: hurricane harvey
text: 2017 arkema plant explosion

a series of small explosions occur at the arkema chemical plant in crosby, texas, and according to the company more are expected, after floodwaters shut down the cooling systems that kept the chemicals stable. houston methodist san jacinto hospital in baytown, texas treated 21 first responders for chemical exposure. residents living within a 1.5-mile  radius of the plant are evacuated.

a harris county flood control district official says at the height of the flooding, 70 percent of the county’s 1,800 square miles, which includes the city of houston, was covered with at least 1.5 feet of water, an area larger than the state of rhode island.

headline: 2017 atlantic hurricane season
text: hurricane irma

hurricane irma makes first landfall on barbuda, saint martin, and anguilla in the northeastern leeward islands. irma has maintained 185 miles per hour  winds for 24 hours, setting another record for atlantic and eastern pacific storms. , ,
at least seven people are killed on the islands of barbuda, st. barts and st. martin. heavy rain and category 5 winds hit the virgin islands and puerto rico’s northeast coast.

the prime minister of antigua and barbuda gaston browne says the island of barbuda has been almost entirely wiped out by hurricane irma and is "barely habitable", with "90 percent" of all structures destroyed.
hurricane katia
hurricane watches are issued for the state of  veracruz on mexico's gulf coast. category 1 katia  is about 185 miles  off the mexican coast, slowly moving at 3 miles per hour .

headline: syrian civil war
text: russian aircraft carry out air strikes on the christian-majority qaina and yaqobia villages, in the western countryside of idlib, killing a child and injuring 5 others.

five russian warplanes bombard the city of al-tamane’a with rockets, bombs, and bunker-buster missiles, wounding several civilians and causing a significant damage to the area, and causing large number of civilians to flee.

headline: syrian civil war
text: ISIL releases video footage of two alleged Russian soldiers it captured. However, Russia denies the claims.

headline: october 2017 northern california wildfires
text: More than a dozen wildfires around Mendocino, Napa, Sonoma, and Yuba counties in California, kill at least ten people, destroy at least 1500 homes and businesses, and force 20 thousand people to evacuate. The Governor of California, Jerry Brown, declares a state of emergency. , ,

headline: mount kirishima
text: Shinmoedake volcano erupts for the first time in six years.

headline: tropical depression 23w
text: Floods and landslides in Yên Bái and Hòa Bình provinces in Vietnam kill at least 54 people with 39 more missing. ,

headline: 2017 atlantic hurricane season
text: Hurricane Ophelia
Schools and hospitals are closed in Ireland and Northern Ireland as the extratropical cyclone Ophelia is forecasted to make landfall on the island.
At least three people are killed in Ireland as over 360,000 homes lose power due to the remnants of Hurricane Ophelia.

headline: insurgency in egypt
text: Sixteen members of the Egyptian Police have died in a clash with Islamic militants from the Hasm Movement. More than fifteen militants have been killed.

headline: 28 october 2017 mogadishu bombings
text: Two car bombs kill at least 25 people, mostly police officers, near the national theater area in Mogadishu, Somalia, two weeks after a similar attack killed hundreds. Islamist group Al-Shabaab claims responsibility.

headline: saudi arabian-led intervention in yemen
text: A Saudi-led coalition airstrike on a market in Sahar District in Yemen's northern Saada Governorate, which is under Houthi control, kills at least 26 people, according to medics and local officials.

headline: war in somalia
text: The United States launches airstrikes against Islamic State in Somalia for the first time. The United States Africa Command says "several terrorists" were killed in the strikes, which took place in coordination with Somalia's government.

headline: border incidents involving north korea
text: A Korean People's Army soldier defects to South Korea via the Korean Demilitarized Zone . He was shot and injured by fellow North Korean soldiers as he crossed to the South Korean side at Panmunjom, and has been taken to hospital.

headline: south sudanese civil war
text: Rival factions within the ruling Sudan People's Liberation Movement sign the "Declaration of Unification" in Cairo, Egypt.

headline: disappearance of ara san juan
text: The Argentine Navy continues searching in the South Atlantic for the ARA San Juan submarine, which went missing on 15 November 2017.

headline: human stampedes in 2017
text: At least 15 people are killed in a human stampede over food in the village of Sidi Boualem, Morocco.

headline: internal armed conflict in colombia paramilitarism in colombia illegal drug trade in colombia
text: Colombia's biggest narcotics gang, Clan del Golfo , declares a cease-fire in effect since December 13. They say the gesture is meant "to contribute to a full, total and lasting peace." The Colombian government says that it welcomes the move but also that it will continue their pressure on the organization.

headline: 2017 washington train derailment
text: An NTSB spokesperson says that preliminary indications are that the train was travelling at 80 miles per hour  on a 30 miles per hour  track. The Positive train control  safety system was not operational on the train, says Amtrak.

headline: border incidents involving north and south korea
text: A Korean People's Army soldier defects to South Korea after crossing the Korean Demilitarized Zone . South Korean border guards fired warning shots at North Korean troops who approached the Military Demarcation Line, in search of the missing soldier. He is the fourth North Korean soldier to defect this year.

headline: protests on u.s. recognition of jerusalem as israeli capital
text: Two Palestinians are shot dead and about 60 others are wounded by Israeli troops gunfire as thousands protest along the Gaza border fence, in all seven West Bank cities and in East Jerusalem, against the U.S. declaration.

headline: 2017 bronx apartment fire
text: Twelve people are dead in an apartment fire in The Bronx area of New York City.

headline: dalfsen train crash
text: a train derails near the dutch town of dalfsen with reports of at least one death and several injured. ,

headline: syrian civil war american-led intervention in syria
text: according to the syrian observatory for human rights, multiple suspected u.s.-led coalition air raids kill at least 23 civilians in the village of al-matab in northern syria.

headline: basque conflict
text: in spain, the basque separatist group eta announces that it will fully disarm by april 8, 2017.

headline: syrian civil war
text: around 1,500–2,000 people leave al-waer district of homs today for their preferred destination of either northern homs governorate, idlib governorate or turkish army positions in northern aleppo governorate. up to 15,000 to 20,000 people including armed militants, their families and supporters will leave the besieged district in the coming weeks with the rest of the population reconciling and receiving aid. ,

headline: war in afghanistan
text: russian special envoy to afghanistan zamir kabulov denies allegations by nato commander gen. curtis scaparrotti that russia was "perhaps" supplying the taliban.

headline: war in north-west pakistan
text: a bomb targets a mosque in the city of parachinar near the border with afghanistan killing at least 22 people and wounding dozens more.

headline: interstate 85 bridge collapse
text: officials state that repairs will take months following a fire that collapsed a bridge on interstate 85 in atlanta, georgia. police arrest three individuals in connection with the disaster, charging two with criminal trespass and one with first degree criminal damage.

headline: war in north-west pakistan
text: a suicide bomber kills at least six people and wounds 18  near a pakistan army vehicle taking part in the census in the city of lahore.

headline: 2016–17 south pacific cyclone season
text: category 3 cyclone cook hits grand terre, the main island of new caledonia.

headline: battle of mosul
text: the iraqi army's chief of staff, lt gen othman al-ghanmi, states that his security forces are only days away from completing the operation to recapture mosul from isil.

headline: chibok schoolgirls kidnapping
text: 82 of the female students recently released by boko haram reunite with their families in abuja.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: a taliban raid kills at least 20 afghan police officers in southern afghanistan.

headline: syrian civil war
text: united nations high commissioner for human rights zeid bin ra'ad calls on all air forces in syria to better distinguish between military targets and civilians.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: an afghan soldier kills 3 u.s. troops and injures 1 other in achin, nangarhar province. the taliban claims responsibility, saying the afghan soldier was one of several taliban infiltrators in the afghan armed forces.

headline: uss fitzgerald and mv acx crystal collision
text: the uss fitzgerald, a united states navy destroyer, collides with a merchant ship mv acx crystal off the coast of japan at around 2:30 a.m. local time, with seven american sailors reported missing. the ship was taking on water and able to operate at limited propulsion.

headline: climate of chile
text: four people are killed as intense rains and snowstorms hit central and southern chile. about 3,000 people are homeless, and hundreds of thousands have lost power.

headline: israeli–syrian ceasefire line incidents during the syrian civil war
text: israel and syria exchange weapons fire in the disputed golan heights, with israel destroying several targets, including two syrian tanks. although there were deaths on the ground in syria, the number of casualties among syrian forces is unknown. no israeli troops were injured.

headline: colombian peace process
text: the united nations confirms that the farc has completed its disarmament process, with former rebels due to make the transition to civilian life and the group to transform into a legal political party in the country.

headline: charra pani cable car accident
text: at least twelve people die and two others are injured after a cable car falls nearly 500 feet into a ditch in charra pani, galyat, pakistan.

headline: 2017 pacific typhoon season
text: severe flooding on the japanese island of kyushu has caused seven deaths with twenty people unaccounted for.

headline: wildfires in europe
text: wildfires devastate the italian provinces of messina, naples, enna and rome. the vesuvius national park is reportedly completely destroyed by flames and ash. italian police claim the fires are the work of arsonists.

headline: 2017 california wildfires
text: thousands of residents are evacuated from mariposa and several other communities in mariposa county, california, following the rapid spread of the detwiler fire near yosemite national park.

headline: syrian civil war
text: the russian air force bombards the city of madan and zor shamr camp, south and east of raqqa, syria, with cluster bombs, killing six civilians and wounding 19 others. nearby alburamadan town  was also struck; there are no reports of casualties.

headline: 2017 jiuzhaigou earthquake
text: a magnitude 7.0 earthquake strikes sichuan in southwest china, killing at least thirteen people and injuring more than 175. ,

headline: road incidents in china
text: at least 36 people die in a bus crash in china's shaanxi province. the bus was travelling between chengdu and luoyang.

headline: migrant crisis
text: at least 56 african migrants drown in the red sea while traveling from the horn of africa to yemen. human traffickers had forced 300 people aboard two boats into the sea.

headline: boko haram insurgency
text: three suicide bombers kill 27 people and wound 83 near maiduguri, nigeria.

headline: 2017 barcelona attacks
text: catalan police in the coastal town of cambrils kill five suspected terrorists in a counter-terror operation to stop a second van attack. the police reported the attackers were wearing explosive vests, however they were later discovered to be fakes.

headline: israeli involvement in the syrian civil war
text: it is suspected that israeli jets bomb a military research facility near the city of masyaf, hama governorate, killing at least two syrian army soldiers. the facility was rumoured to contain chemical weapons.

headline: northern rakhine state clashes
text: a few hundred pro-government protesters gather in myanmar's commercial capital yangon, condemning rohingya militants as well as perceived foreign interference in the rakhine conflict.

headline: earthquakes in 2017
text: a magnitude 6.2 earthquake strikes the central mexican state of oaxaca killing at least five people and damaging housing and infrastructure already damaged by tuesday's 2017 central mexico earthquake. , ,

headline: 2017 atlantic hurricane season
text: hurricane maria
puerto rican officials request aid from the united states federal government for welfare in the aftermath of the hurricane-induced humanitarian crisis on the island.

headline: 2017 har adar shooting
text: three israelis are killed and one other is wounded after a palestinian gunman opens fire in an entrance to the israeli settlement of har adar in the west bank.

headline: 2017 edmonton attack
text: in edmonton, alberta, canada, near commonwealth stadium, a man drives into a police officer and then stabs the officer. the suspect fled the scene and was later arrested that night following a police pursuit, where four pedestrians were hit by the suspect in a rental truck. police are investigating the incident as an act of terrorism. ,

headline: marseille stabbing
text: A knife-wielding man at Saint Charles train station in Marseille, France, kills two women. Police kill the suspect and are treating the attack as a terrorist incident. ISIL claims responsibility. ,

headline: hurricane maria
text: Puerto Rico Governor Ricardo Rosselló's office reports that the number of deaths related to Hurricane Maria has risen to 34.

headline: syrian civil war
text: Three suicide bombers attack a police command center in Damascus, killing two people and injuring six others.

The Sun reports that the CIA informed UK intelligence agencies that British-born ISIL activist and recruiter Sally Jones was killed in a U.S. drone strike in June along with her 12-year-old son while they were fleeing Raqqa in Syria.

headline: battle of raqqa
text: The Syrian Democratic Forces carry out a deal to evacuate dozens of ISIL militants from Raqqa to Deir ez-Zor.

headline: helicopter accidents and incidents
text: A helicopter carrying five people crashes into Kenya's Lake Nakuru.

headline: syrian civil war
text: Siege of Deir ez-Zor
The Syrian Army  and allies announce the complete liberation of Deir ez-Zor from ISIL.
At least nine people are killed and another 23 are injured in Hader, Quneitra Governorate, after a Tahrir al-Sham-operated car bomb detonates inside the town.

headline: 2017 pacific typhoon season
text: Typhoon Damrey kills at least 19 people in Vietnam, a week before the country is set to host APEC Vietnam 2017.

headline: earthquakes in 2017
text: A 7.0 magnitude undersea earthquake strikes east of New Caledonia's Loyalty Islands in the South Pacific Ocean. Tsunami warnings for New Caledonia and Vanuatu are cancelled. There are no immediate reports of damage.

headline: uss ronald reagan
text: A U.S. Navy C-2A Greyhound, operating off the aircraft carrier USS Ronald Reagan, crashes in the Philippine Sea. Eight sailors are rescued, while three remain missing from the 11-person crew.

headline: israeli intervention in the syrian civil war
text: For the second time in three days, Israel carries out a missile strike on military facilities near Damascus.

headline: meerbusch train crash
text: A passenger train runs into the rear of a freight train at Meerbusch, Germany. Forty-seven people are injured, three seriously.

headline: december 2017 melbourne car attack
text: Nineteen people are injured after a car crashes into pedestrians at the corner of Flinders Street and Elizabeth Street in Melbourne, Australia. The driver is arrested. Victoria Police believe that the incident was a "deliberate act" but not terrorism-related.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: at least one person is killed and another eight are wounded after a suicide bomber attacks a bus carrying government employees in kabul.

headline: march 2017 israel–syria incident israeli–syrian ceasefire line incidents during the syrian civil war
text: the israeli air force launches several airstrikes on targets inside syria, and for the first time, publicly claims responsibility. syrian air defenses responded by launching missiles at the aircraft, and thereupon israeli arrow 3 missiles were launched in response to the counter-offensive. israel stated that it was targeting suspected weapons shipments to hezbollah in lebanon, adding that the israeli military will keep intervening until they believe such shipments have ceased. according to the syrian army, four israeli jets entered its airspace and struck targets near palmyra. ,

headline: 2017 iran's north west floods
text: flash flooding caused by torrential rain leaves at least 17 people dead and 20 others missing in northwestern iran, according to state television.

headline: kamwina nsapu rebellion
text: at least 17 new mass graves are discovered  by united nations investigators in kasaï-central, democratic republic of the congo, mostly around the town of tshimbulu.

headline: 2017 venezuelan protests
text: a student is killed amid gunfire in el tigre, raising the death toll in protests against nicolás maduro's government to at least 37 in the past month.

headline: 2017 venezuelan protests
text: a young man is shot dead in valencia, carabobo, amid ongoing protests against the government of nicolás maduro. protesters tear down a statue of former president hugo chávez in rosario de perijá.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: four militants attack a state television building in jalalabad, killing at least six people. the militants are also killed after engaging with afghan police. isil claimed responsibility for the attack.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: 2017 herat bombing
an explosion occurs near police offices and a mosque in herat, killing at least ten people.

headline: wildfires in south africa
text: up to 10,000 people have been evacuated from knysna local municipality on garden route in south africa after wildfire destroyed 150 homes. the wildfire is connected to the worst windstorm in 30 years, which already killed at least 8 people in cape town. , , , ,

headline: syrian civil war
text: after yesterday's downing of a syrian su-22 jet, russia shuts down a deconfliction channel and says it will follow any aircraft west of the euphrates as a target.

headline: 2017 brussels attack
text: a man is shot in brussels central station amid reports of an attempted bombing attack.

headline: 2017 atlantic hurricane season
text: a ten-year-old boy dies from injuries sustained during tropical storm cindy in fort morgan, alabama. wreg

headline: tropical storm nanmadol
text: the death toll from flooding on the southern japanese island of kyushu rises to 15, with six others missing.

headline: syrian civil war
text: syrian rebels, who have benefited from the "covert" cia military aid program, say they have not been officially informed of the u.s. decision to stop this aid, and add that its full impact depends on whether u.s. allies jordan, saudi arabia, qatar, and turkey continue to support their fight. a free syrian army commander warns this decision risks triggering the collapse of the moderate opposition.

headline: south african premier division
text: two people die and 17 others are injured in a stampede  at the first national bank stadium in soweto, near johannesburg, south africa, during a soccer match between orlando pirates and kaizer chiefs.

headline: 2017 v-22 osprey crash
text: searches are underway for three members of the united states marine corps missing after a mv-22 osprey crashed off the coast of the australian state of queensland. twenty three of the twenty six people on board have been rescued. ,

headline: terrorism in russia
text: a 23-year-old stabs and injures eight people in the russian city of surgut, before being killed by police. isil claims responsibility for the attack.

headline: earthquakes in 2017
text: a magnitude 6.4 earthquake strikes west of the pacific island of tonga. there are no immediate reports of casualties or damage.

headline: 2017 pacific typhoon season
text: at least 12 people die in the southern chinese city of macau as a result of flooding caused by typhoon hato. four more people die in neighbouring guangdong province.

headline: 2017 south asian floods
text: 2017 mumbai flood

at least 14 people are killed in the indian city of mumbai as nearly a month's average rainfall fell yesterday during the worst monsoon in years. more than 1,200 people have been killed across india, nepal and bangladesh.

headline: 2017 california wildfires
text: the la tuna fire continues to burn in los angeles, california, becoming the largest fire in the city's history at around 5,800 acres. mayor eric garcetti declares a state of emergency.

headline: 2017 chiapas earthquake
text: a magnitude 8.1 earthquake is recorded 96 kilometers  south of pijijiapan, chiapas, mexico. this is mexico's strongest quake since the 8.0 earthquake that hit the greater mexico city area in 1985. at least 26 deaths have been recorded.,

headline: russia and weapons of mass destruction
text: russia announces it has completed the destruction of all of its chemical weapons under the terms of the chemical weapons convention.

headline: 2017 central mexico earthquake
text: a mexico city borough president says previous officials ignored warnings that unauthorized construction work had damaged the structural integrity of several buildings in the city. the overall death toll from the magnitude 7.1 quake which hit sept. 19 now stands at at least 358 people.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: A suicide attack on a police compound in Gardez, Paktia Province, kills at least 20 people, while a separate gun attack at a training facility in neighboring Ghazni Province leaves another 15 people dead.

headline: 2017 tongo tongo ambush
text: The United States Africa Command sends a team to Niger to investigate an October 4 ambush which killed four U.S. soldiers.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: A suicide bomber kills at least 15 people in Kabul.

headline: 2017 in the central african republic
text: A grenade attack at a peace concert in Bangui, Central African Republic, kills seven and injures 20.

headline: united states recognition of jerusalem as israeli capital
text: Hundreds of people protest on the West Bank and in Gaza for the third day in a row.

headline: west wind aviation flight 280
text: A plane crash in Fond-du-Lac, Saskatchewan, causes 24 injuries and 1 death.

headline: yemeni civil war
text: After 1,000 days of civil war in Yemen, eight million people are at risk of starvation.

headline: 2016–17 zimbabwe floods
text: since december, flooding in zimbabwe has killed 246 people and nearly 2,000 more have been left homeless, according to officials.

headline: libyan civil war
text: the benghazi defense brigades, an ally of the shura council of benghazi revolutionaries, claims to have captured five cities and two oil-production areas from forces loyal to khalifa haftar in the east of libya.

headline: syrian civil war
text: according to syrian state media, two suicide bombers attack in damascus, killing at least 31 people.
a second explosion occurs in the rabwah area of damascus.
suspected russian warplanes carry out airstrikes on the city of idlib at dawn, killing 21 people including at least 14 children.

headline: war in somalia
text: a car bomb explodes at a checkpoint near the villa somalia, the president of somalia mohamed abdullahi mohamed's official residence in mogadishu, killing at least five people.

headline: 2017 westminster attack
text: authorities arrest at least eight people in connection with yesterday's attack.
london's metropolitan police service announces that the attacker is british-born khalid masood, previously questioned by british authorities for connections to terrorism.
the islamic state of iraq and the levant claims responsibility.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: taliban insurgents seize control of the strategic town of sangin in the southern helmand province after a year-long battle with afghan security forces.

headline: 2017 congolese police decapitation attacks
text: authorities find the remains of two missing u.n. investigators—former swedish politician zaida catalán and u.s. national michael sharp—in a shallow grave in the province of kasaï-central, democratic republic of the congo. , ,

headline: 2017 orlando shooting
text: a discharged 45-year-old former employee shoots and kills five people at a manufacturing business in orlando, florida, united states. the shooter took his own life afterwards. eight others inside the workplace survived.

headline: 2017 myanmar air force shaanxi y-8 crash
text: a military aircraft with 120 people onboard crashes into the andaman sea off the coast of myanmar.

headline: 2017 congressional baseball shooting
text: a gunman opens fire at a congressional baseball practice, injuring five people, including united states congressman steve scalise  who is in critical condition. the suspected gunman later died from injuries after exchanging gunfire with capitol police.

headline: population displacement
text: the number of people displaced globally totals 65.6 million after an addition of 10.3 million people displaced in 2016. syria, colombia, afghanistan, iraq and south sudan are the countries in the top five.

headline: bear attacks
text: two people are attacked and killed by black bears, in separate incidents in alaska, following a rise in bear attacks in that state.

headline: 2017 portugal wildfires
text: a canadair firefighting plane reportedly crashes in pedrógão grande, central portugal, while tackling raging wildfires. however, this claim has been denied by portuguese authorities.

headline: 2017 united kingdom heat wave
text: the united kingdom experiences its first early summer heat wave in over 20 years, and the highest recorded june temperatures in over 40 years with a reading of 34.5c  recorded at heathrow airport.

headline: grenfell tower fire
