text: The White Helmets reports that Syrian government and Russian warplanes, using rockets and internationally-banned weapons - including vacuum bombs, repeatedly strike residential areas in the town of Al-Lataminah and six villages in Idlib province, killing 22 people.

text: Nine people are killed in two coordinated attacks targeting Coptic Christians in Egypt. Two of the victims are killed by a gunman in a Coptic-owned appliance store in the Helwan area of Cairo. headline: kamala mills fire
text: At least 15 people are killed in a rooftop restaurant fire in Mumbai, India.

headline: communist rebellion in the philippines
text: a total of 21 combatants die in a three-week offensive by the government against the communist party of the philippines.

headline: internal conflict in myanmar
text: according to the government of myanmar, at least 30 people are killed in an attack on various police, military, and government installations by the myanmar national democratic alliance army in laukkai. four police officers were also taken hostage.

an unknown perpetrator carries out an airstrike on a mosque in the rebel-held village of al-jineh near aleppo, killing at least 42 people.

police search for four missing people in southeast queensland as the logan river reaches record levels.

headline: war in somalia
text: a united states navy seal is killed, becoming the first u.s. service member killed in somalia since 1993, and three others are injured in a gunfight with al-shabaab militants, west of mogadishu.

dozens of displaced civilians from al-khafse and nearby villages in the countryside of manbij gather in the village of arbaa al-kabir to protest against the bashar al-assad government, demanding the removal of pro-assad forces from their villages and calling for the intervention of the syrian democratic forces after accusing regime forces of looting houses and threatening residents.

headline: 2017 times square car crash
text: an automobile crashes into pedestrians in new york city's times square, killing one person and injuring several others. police are investigating the incident as an accident. , ,

headline: marawi crisis
text: citizens remain trapped in marawi, philippines, after a ceasefire organised by the moro islamic liberation front  is broken. up to 2,000 people remain in need of help after nearly two weeks without food.

headline: 2017 resorts world manila attack
text: the philippine police identifies the lone gunman as jessie javier carlos, a local citizen, who was a debt-riddled former employee of the department of finance.

the united states-backed syrian democratic forces launch an operation to capture raqqa, isil's de facto syrian capital.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: a coordinated suicide bombing attack on a police station in the town of gardez in paktia province results in dozens of people killed and injured.

text: all 800 homes in the five tower blocks of the chalcots estate, in camden, london, are evacuated after the cladding was declared to have failed fire safety tests.

headline: ramsi
text: a farewell ceremony in honiara ends the 14 year ramsi mission in the solomon islands.

headline: battle of mosul
text: three female isil  suicide bombers kill 15 people and injure five in three separate incidents over the last two days as the fight for mosul winds down.

headline: 2017 amarnath yatra attack
text: at least 7 people are killed and 15 injured after gunmen fire upon a pilgrimage bus and a police vehicle, on the 11th day of the amarnath yatra pilgrimage in the indian city of anantnag. the attack is believed to be terror-related.

text: the death toll from recent torrential rain and flooding in kyushu in southern japan  rises to 25.

headline: insurgency in egypt
text: gunmen shoot dead five police officers near giza.
2017 hurghada attack
two female tourists are killed and four others are wounded in a mass stabbing attack at a hotel in hurghada, red sea governorate. the attacker is detained.

headline: moro conflict
text: a new set of kidnappings and a jail break plague sulu province in the southern region of mindanao in the philippines.

headline: glaciers in switzerland
text: a shrinking glacier in switzerland has revealed two frozen bodies believed to be of a couple who went missing in 1942 and had never been found, despite extensive searches. swiss authorities said that a dna test will be conducted in several days' time.

headline: heat wave
text: firefighters battle wildfires across southern france, including one in corsica.
pope francis halts the fountains of the vatican amidst a drought in italy.

headline: 2017 gujarat flood
text: flooding in gujarat, western india, kills at least 213 people with the death toll expected to rise as receding flood waters reveal additional victims. chief minister of gujarat vijay rupani says heavy rain had triggered "the worst flood of the century" in the state.

headline: minnehaha academy gas explosion
text: a natural gas explosion at college prep school minnehaha academy in minneapolis, minnesota, kills two staff members. another nine people were injured, seven of whom are hospitalized, three in critical and four in serious condition.

text: central syria campaign
a syrian army commando unit backed by russian warplanes and helicopters kills 25 isil militants in central syria, in the northeast of the homs governorate.

headline: earthquakes in 2017

monsoon floods and landslides have killed a total of 74 people in india and nepal.

headline: accidents and incidents involving helicopters

headline: american involvement somali civil war
text: united states-supported somali forces shoot and kill 10 somalis, including three children, in lower shebelle's bariire village near mogadishu. while the somalia government reports the other dead were members of the al shabaab militia, lower shabelle deputy governor ali nur mohamed says the victims were all civilians, farm owners, workers and their children. the u.s. africa command says they are investigating these civilian casualties reports.

headline: hurricane harvey
text: in anticipation of hurricane harvey, residents from corpus christi to galveston, texas, and workers from gulf of mexico oil platforms are evacuating the region. the storm makes landfall between port aransas and port o'connor as a category 4 hurricane around 11 p.m. edt  as the strongest storm to hit the united states mainland since 2004. the national hurricane center predicts harvey will linger over texas for days, dumping 15–25 inches , and as much as 35 inches  of rain on some parts of the state.
oil prices rise in anticipation of harvey's impact on production in the gulf of mexico.

headline: hurricane harvey
text: the death toll from hurricane harvey reaches 30 as sylvester turner,  the mayor of houston, texas, introduces a curfew to deter looters.

text: syrian state television reports the syrian army reaches a point 3 kilometers from deir ez-zor, a city besieged by the islamic state of iraq and the levant since 2014.
two russian soldiers, escorting the military staff ceasefire monitoring convoy, are killed in deir ez-zor province by isil shelling.

text: russian airstrikes on several ferries attempting to cross the euphrates near deir ez-zor kill at least 34 civilians, including 9 children, according to the syrian observatory for human rights.

text: A magnitude 6.5 earthquake strikes the island of Java causing massive damage along with two confirmed deaths.

headline: syrian civil war
text: tahrir al-sham, al-qaeda's branch in syria, claims responsibility for yesterday's twin bomb attacks in damascus which left dozens dead.

headline: piracy off the coast of somalia
text: the somali pirates that hijacked the aris 13, a united arab emirates-owned oil tanker, release it without condition.

headline: yemeni civil war
text: an unknown perpetrator using an apache helicopter fires upon a boat carrying somali refugees off the coast of yemen, killing at least 40 of them, injuring 35 more. ,

headline: cyclone debbie
text: a mother and two children drown after their car plunges into the flooded tweed river, raising the death toll to eight people. a ten-year-old girl escapes and alerts authorities.

headline: tornadoes of 2017
text: robert bentley, the governor of alabama, declares a state of emergency due to forecasts of storms with the threat of tornadoes during the day. the neighboring state of georgia also faces the threat of severe weather.

headline: kamwina nsapu rebellion
text: the united nations monusco reports that 20 chowe-pende community members have been killed in clashes with the lulua-luba community in kasaï-central, democratic republic of congo.

headline: wannacry ransomware attack
text: shortly after the attack began a researcher found an effective kill switch, which prevented many new infections, and allowed time to patch systems. this greatly slowed the spread. cyber security authorities discover new versions that lack the kill switch. , ,

headline: wannacry ransomware attack
text: the cybersecurity firms kaspersky lab and symantec report that technical evidence connects the wannacry ransomware attack to the north korean-backed lazarus group. north korea is also believed to be responsible for previous cyberattacks on the swift banking system and against sony pictures. ,

headline: 2017 manchester arena bombing
text: greater manchester police  report deadly explosions at manchester arena in manchester, england, at the end of ariana grande’s performance on her dangerous woman tour.
the gmp  confirms at least 19 people have been killed and 50 others injured and is treating the incident as a terrorist attack. nobody immediately claimed responsibility.

headline: syrian civil war
text: damascus's governor says the last group of rebels and civilians have left the city's besieged barzeh district.

headline: earthquakes in guatemala
text: at least six people are killed and seven injured by a 6.9 magnitude earthquake in western guatemala.

headline: russian military intervention in the syrian civil war
text: the russian ministry of defence says its forces may have killed isil's leader abu bakr al-baghdadi in an airstrike, south of raqqa on 28 may, and currently is seeking confirmation.

headline: colombian conflict
text: a suspected terrorist bomb explosion in an andino shopping mall's ladies room in bogotá, colombia, kills three women and injures at least 11.

headline: maritime incidents in 2017
text: at least nine people are killed and about 30 others are missing after their multi-story tourist boat, carrying about 170 people, sinks in a reservoir in northwest colombia near medellín.

headline: 2017 créteil mosque incident
text: a man attempts to run over pedestrians outside a mosque in créteil, france.

headline: sinai insurgency
text: masked militants attack an egyptian army checkpoint in a village south of rafah, north sinai governorate, killing at least 23 soldiers, including a high-ranking special forces colonel. the islamic state of iraq and syria later claims responsibility. the attack included vbied and signal jamming.

headline: syrian civil war
text: the syrian army seizes oil wells in south-west raqqa governorate from isil.

headline: 2016–17 rohingya persecution in myanmar
text: more than 123,000 rohingya refugees have fled myanmar and crossed into bangladesh due to escalating violence by the myanmar army.
burmese state counselor aung san suu kyi receives international criticism and pressure urging her to help the rohingya.

headline: accidents involving helicopters
text: a duke university medical helicopter crashes near belvidere, north carolina, killing four people.
a helicopter crashes in medford, new jersey, leaving two people dead, including singer troy gentry of montgomery gentry.

headline: 2017 atlantic hurricane season
text: tens of thousands of people in northern puerto rico are ordered to evacuate after floodwaters from hurricane maria damage the guajataca dam.

headline: 2017 north korea crisis
text: north korea says that the recent flight of u.s. aircraft off the coast of north korea amounts to a declaration of war.

headline: syrian civil war
text: Two suicide bombers attack a police station in the Al-Midan neighbourhood of Damascus, killing at least 15 people.

headline: iraqi civil war
text: Battle of Hawija

The Iraqi Army fully retakes the city of Hawija in the Kirkuk Governorate from ISIL. Fighting continues to the north and east of the city as Iraqi troops continue anti-ISIL operations in the Hawija District.

headline: 2017 atlantic hurricane season
text: Tropical Storm Nate
Tropical Storm Nate heads for the Gulf Coast of the United States after causing dozens of deaths in Central America and severe flooding in the Nicaraguan town of Rivas.

headline: 2017–18 uk and ireland windstorm season
text: Storm Brian, the third windstorm of the season, causes severe flash flooding in Ireland and coastal flooding in parts of England and Wales, although disruption is not as severe as initially expected.

headline: landslides in malaysia
text: At least two people are dead and twelve missing after a landslide on the Malaysian tourist island of Penang.

headline: northern rakhine state clashes
text: More than 2,000 people march in Yangon to show support for the military, urging the military to secure the country's sovereignty, protect national security and stop illegal intruders .

headline: war in afghanistan
text: Two fuel tankers are bombed in the Afghan town of Charikar, killing at least 15 people and injuring at least 27.

headline: iraqi civil war
text: The Iraqi Army captures the town of Rawa from the Islamic State in Iraq and the Levant . It was the last town held by ISIL in Iraq.

headline: boko haram insurgency
text: An estimated 50 people are killed when a suicide bomber attacks a mosque during morning prayers in Mubi, Nigeria.

headline: syrian civil war
text: Russian jets carry out airstrikes in a village in the northwestern Idlib Governorate, where a de-escalation zone exists, killing at least five civilians.

headline: russian military intervention in the syrian civil war
text: During a visit to Syria, his first, President Vladimir Putin announces that a significant part of Russian forces will withdraw from Syria now that ISIL has been defeated in the country.

headline: 2017 quetta church attack
text: A suicide bomb and gun attack on a Methodist church in Pakistan kills nine people.

headline: saudi arabian-led intervention in yemen
text: Houthis say that they launched a Volcano H-2 missile targeting at the Al-Yamamah Palace in the Saudi capital city of Riyadh. According to the Saudis, the missile was intercepted south of Riyadh and caused no casualties.

The Secretary-General of the OIC, Yousef Al-Othaimeen, says the repeated launch of ballistic missiles at Saudi Arabia served to confirm the Houthis' "hostility and criminality" and further claimed "The Houthis are trying to destabilize Saudi Arabia and the entire region."

headline: 2017 guatemala orphanage fire
text: the death toll at the fire at an orphanage in san josé pinula, guatemala, rises to at least 38 children.

headline: 2017 irish coast guard s-92 crash
text: an irish coast guard helicopter crashes off the coast of county mayo, killing one person and leaving three others missing.

headline: war in north-west pakistan
text: gunmen raid a pakistani military post near the border with afghanistan, killing at least eight people. jamaat-ul-ahrar, a faction of tehrik-i-taliban pakistan, claim responsibility.

headline: turkish constitutional referendum, 2017
text: several people are wounded in clashes outside the turkish consulate in brussels.

headline: cyclone debbie
text: authorities of new south wales issue a state emergency service for the towns of murwillumbah and lismore, and at least 12 flood rescues are underway as former cyclone debbie moves south from north queensland. ,
authorities shut down the city of brisbane and south east queensland as remnants of cyclone debbie move south.

headline: iraqi civil war
text: according to security sources, dozens of people are killed in an overnight attack in tikrit by suspected isil militants. 31 bodies were taken to a hospital, according to a local doctor, while more continued to be found by morning.

headline: war in somalia
text: a car bomb explodes outside the ministry of defence in mogadishu, killing at least 15 people. al-shabaab claims responsibility for the attack.

headline: european migrant crisis
text: a boat carrying migrants sinks off the coast of libya, with 97 people reported missing. 23 others were rescued by the libyan coast guard.

headline: central african republic civil war
text: according to the international committee of the red cross, at least 115 human bodies are discovered in the border town of bangassou, more than previously thought. a few days prior, militias attacked the town, with the united nations reporting that at least 26 people were killed.

headline: al-qaeda insurgency in yemen
text: the u.s. navy seal team six's raid on an al qaeda in yemen compound in the ma'rib governorate kills at least seven militants. seal team six also suffered unspecified injuries that were treated at the site.

headline: 2017 manchester arena bombing
text: as part of an ongoing investigation, british police arrest six people in connection with monday's deadly explosion, including a 23-year-old man who was taken into custody tuesday.
the father, ramadan abedi, and younger brother, hashem abedi, of suspected bomber salman abedi are arrested in tripoli by the libyan counter-terrorism forces.

headline: marawi crisis
text: philippine forces continue to battle maute militants for the city of marawi.

headline: 2017 brighton siege
text: in brighton, a suburb of melbourne, australia, a gunman kills one man and holds one woman hostage before he is shot dead by victoria police. the incident is being treated as an act of terrorism. islamic state in iraq and the levant has claimed responsibility for the attack but victoria police claim that there is little evidence to suggest a connection. ,

headline: iraqi civil war
text: a suicide bomber at a market in musayyib kills 31 and wounds 35. isil claims responsibility.

headline: earthquakes in 2017
text: an earthquake of 6.3 magnitude shakes the aegean sea, causing one death. many houses were damaged in plomari, greece, and some collapsed.

headline: grenfell tower fire
text: a large fire consumes the 24-storey grenfell tower apartment block in north kensington, west london, with the entire building evacuated and over 40 fire engines and 200 firefighters battling the blaze. at least 17 people are dead and more people are treated for injuries, with more people possibly being trapped inside. , , , ,

headline: june 2017 champs-élysées car ramming attack
text: a car carrying firearms and gas bottles deliberately rammed a police vehicle on the champs-élysées in paris, france, subsequently bursting into flames. the driver, who was on a security watchlist, was shot dead.

headline: akyazı electrocution incident
text: five people are killed after being electrocuted at a water park in akyazı, turkey.

headline: camden market fire
text: a large fire breaks out at the camden markets in north west london, with over 70 firefighters and 10 firetrucks attending the scene. no casualties have been reported.

headline: kurdish–turkish conflict
text: according to the turkish army, its overnight air strike in dargeçit killed eleven militants from the kurdistan workers' party.

headline: 2017 barcelona train crash
text: a passenger train crashes into a buffer stop at barcelona frança railway station, injuring 54 people, five seriously.

headline: floods in india
text: following heavy rain in july 2017, the gujarat state of india was affected by a severe flood resulting in more than 200 deaths.
northeast india was also affected by flood due to heavy rain resulting in more than 85 deaths.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: a suicide bomber kills two american troops near the kandahar international airport in afghanistan. the taliban insurgency claims responsibility.

headline: levallois-perret attack
text: in a suspected terror attack, six french soldiers are injured, three seriously, when a man drives a car into them at a barracks in the paris suburb of levallois-perret.

headline: iraqi civil war
text: during combat operations in northern iraq, two u.s. service members are killed and five injured.

headline: 2017 barcelona attacks
text: spanish police hunting the chief suspect in last thursday's van attack in barcelona shoot dead a man to the west of the city who appeared to be wearing an explosive belt.

headline: earthquakes in 2017
text: a magnitude 4.0 earthquake strikes the italian island of ischia, leaving one person dead and 25 others injured. italian media report 10 others are unaccounted for after several buildings collapsed in casamicciola terme.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: new zealand announces the stationing of three more non-combat military personnel in afghanistan, boosting its military commitment to 13.
four gunmen attack a shiite mosque in kabul, afghanistan, killing at least 20 people.

headline: rohingya insurgency in western myanmar
text: 2016–17 northern rakhine state clashes, 2016–17 rohingya persecution in myanmar

dozens of rohingya muslims fleeing renewed violence in rakhine state are detained by bangladeshi and burmese authorities after they attempt to cross the border from myanmar to bangladesh. many were en route to kutupalong refugee camp, a refugee camp in ukhia, bangladesh, mostly inhabited by rohingya refugees.

headline: hurricane harvey
text: the death toll from hurricane harvey in the american city of houston, texas, rises to three with several more days of heavy rain causing "catastrophic" floods to come.

the entire texas national guard is activated by texas governor greg abbott for search and rescue operations, as weather forecasters stated that harvey would move back over the gulf of mexico and restrengthen.

headline: building collapses in 2017
text: a rickety multi-story apartment building collapses in the indian city of mumbai resulting in at least 24 deaths with at least 12 people missing.

headline: crocodile attack
text: a journalist for the british newspaper financial times is killed by a crocodile in sri lanka.

headline: 2017 atlantic hurricane season
text: hurricane maria

hurricane maria makes landfall on dominica as a category 5 hurricane with maximum sustained winds of 160 mph . maria is the second category 5 hurricane to make landfall at that intensity in the 2017 season, making this and 2007 the only seasons on record to feature this occurrence.

headline: human stampede
text: a crowd surge collapses a barrier during a soccer match at stade de la licorne in amiens, france, injuring twenty-nine people, five of them seriously.

headline: syrian civil war
text: The Islamic State group seizes the Al-Qaryatain town in the central province of Homs in a surprise attack against Syrian government forces.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: At least 43 Afghan soldiers are killed in a Taliban attack on an army base in Kandahar Province. Around 10 Taliban fighters also died in the attack.

headline: helicopter accidents and incidents
text: A helicopter crashes near Saudi Arabia's border with Yemen, killing Prince Mansour bin Muqrin, and seven other Saudi officials. The cause of the crash is unknown.

headline: disappearance of ara san juan
text: The Navy of Argentina begins a search for one of its submarines, the San Juan, which has been out of contact for two days.

headline: 2017 eruption of mount agung
text: Mount Agung in Bali erupts for the first time in 50 years, leading to thousands of people fleeing their homes.

headline: december 2017 southern california wildfires
text: Donald Trump approves California's request for an emergency declaration, allowing the Federal Emergency Management Agency to coordinate disaster relief efforts across five Southern California counties.

headline: 2017 new york city attempted bombing
text: An attempted terrorist attack occurs when a homemade pipe bomb worn by a man exploded near New York City's Port Authority Bus Terminal. Three people, as well as the attacker, are injured. The suspect, identified as Akayed Ullah, is in custody.

headline: 2017 pacific typhoon season
text: Tropical Storm Tembin
More than 200 people are dead in the southern Philippines as a result of floods and mudslides caused by Severe Tropical Storm Vinta.

headline: rajasthan bus crash
text: Thirty-three people are killed and 15 injured as a bus falls 65 feet into the river in Rajasthan, Western India.

headline: sudanese conflict in south kordofan and blue nile
text: the sudan people's liberation movement-north releases 127 prisoners from captivity, mostly troops of the sudanese military.

headline: syrian civil war
text: american-led intervention in syria
the united states marine corps' 11th marine expeditionary unit arrives in syria ahead of a syrian democratic forces operation to take control of isil's de facto capital of raqqa.

headline: 2017 guatemala orphanage fire
text: a fire breaks out at an orphanage in san josé pinula, guatemala after students protesting  conditions including alleged sexual and physical abuse set fire to their bedding, killing at least 19 children.

headline: war in somalia
text: a vehicle filled with explosives detonates near a hotel in mogadishu, killing at least six people and wounding four others.

headline: boko haram insurgency
text: 2017 maiduguri attack
multiple suicide blasts occur at a refugee camp near maiduguri, nigeria, leaving eight people dead and wounding 18 others. ,

headline: 2017 antwerp attack
text: a man drives into a crowd of pedestrians in antwerp, belgium, injuring several people. police arrest the man, who is believed to be north african born and living in france.

headline: insurgency in the north caucasus
text: six chechen soldiers, along with six militants, are killed in a nighttime attack on a russian national guard base in chechnya.

headline: march 2017 israel–syria incident
text: in response to several israeli airstrikes against suspected hezbollah-related targets inside syria, syrian president bashar al-assad has threatened wider war with the state of israel, stating its intention to fire scud missiles, and specifically target the israeli city of haifa. israel responded by stating that any such actions by the assad regime, or attacks on its aircraft, will cause israel to "annihilate" syrian air defense systems.

headline: 2016–17 australian region cyclone season
text: more than 25,000 people are evacuated from the city of mackay, queensland, ahead of cyclone debbie which is expected to make landfall in northern queensland tomorrow. the australian bureau of meteorology warns that cyclone debbie will be the worst storm to hit queensland since cyclone yasi in 2011.

headline: iraqi civil war
text: a car bomb attack on a police checkpoint in baghdad kills at least 15 people and injures 40 others.

headline: cyclone debbie
text: the death toll from cyclone debbie and the associated flooding in the australian states of new south wales and queensland rises to five people.

headline: 2017 westminster attack
text: the death toll rises to five after a woman who fell into the river thames dies in hospital.

headline: 2017 batangas earthquakes
text: two earthquakes, with magnitudes of 5.6 and 6.0 and related to the april 4 magnitude 5.5 earthquake, hits batangas, and are felt as far as metro manila

headline: 2016–17 south pacific cyclone season
text: dozens of people in vanuatu are in shelters as cyclone cook hits the island. it is due to pass through new caledonia tomorrow.

headline: syrian civil war russian military intervention in syria
text: according to the russian defence ministry, two of its soldiers have been killed by a mortar attack in syria while another was wounded. the ministry did not specify when or where the attack occurred.
a us-led airstrike intended to kill isis soldiers mistakenly kills 18 members of the syrian democratic forces.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: the afghan ministry of defense reports as many as 36 suspected isil militants were killed while no civilians were harmed in yesterday's bombing in nangarhar province using the so-called "mother of all bombs" . the ministry spokesman added these deaths have not been independently verified.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: two u.s. service members are killed and a third is injured during a raid against isil militants in afghanistan's nangarhar province.

headline: syrian civil war
text: according to the syrian observatory for human rights, at least 38 people are killed, including civilians and syrian democratic forces fighters, after isil militants attack a camp for displaced syrian and iraqi refugees near al-shaddadah, al-hasakah governorate.

headline: syrian civil war
text: russia, iran  and turkey reach an agreement, effective this midnight, to establish four "safe zones" in syria over which all military aircraft, including turkish, russian, and american aircraft, will be barred from flying.
the united nations welcomed the long discussed safe zones, although they have been rejected by syrian rebels and the kurdish pyd.

headline: insurgency in balochistan
text: gunmen open fire on construction workers at gwadar port, pakistan, killing at least 10 people. the balochistan liberation army claimed responsibility for the attack.

headline: 2017 adendro train derailment
text: a trainose passenger train derails near the greek village of adendro, leaving at least four people dead and five seriously injured.

headline: libyan civil war
text: the death toll from an attack on a libyan national army-controlled airbase in southern libya reportedly rises to 140 people.

headline: marawi crisis
text: philippine defense secretary delfin lorenzana announces the deaths of ten soldiers in marawi as a result of a "friendly fire" airstrike.

headline: 2017 north korean missile tests
text: north korea test fires several missiles, believed to be anti-ship weapons. the test comes immediately after south korea suspends further deployment of the thaad anti-missile system.

headline: war in somalia
text: a suicide bomber explodes a car bomb near a hotel, al-shabaab militants then storm the hotel and a pizza restaurant, killing least 20 people and taking others hostage, in somalia's capital mogadishu. all five attackers are later killed.

headline: june 2017 jerusalem attack
text: in two simultaneous attacks near the damascus gate in jerusalem, an israeli policewoman is fatally stabbed; the three palestinian assailants are shot dead. isil claims were questioned by israeli authorities. as well, the pflp and hamas claim it was their members who did it.

headline: saudi arabian-led intervention in yemen
text: an air raid kills at least 24 civilians at a market in houthi-held saada governorate, yemen.

headline: 2017 atlantic hurricane season
text: tropical storm cindy makes its way towards the eastern coasts of the southern united states.

headline: 2017 venezuelan protests
text: 2017 venezuelan constitutional crisis

armed civilian groups attack the national assembly building, after a clash between lawmakers and the bolivarian national guard , leaving various legislators and journalists injured. opposition legislator and president of the assembly julio borges blames president nicolás maduro for the attack.
2017 caracas helicopter incident
a police helicopter strafes the supreme court and the interior ministry in what president nicolás maduro calls "an attack by terrorists seeking a coup". there are no reports of injuries.

headline: hillsborough disaster
text: six people are charged with various offences including manslaughter by gross negligence following the hillsborough disaster in 1989.

headline: syrian civil war spillover in lebanon
text: lebanese armed forces are attacked by five suicide bombers and other militants during a raid of two syrian refugee camps in  arsal  near the syrian border. the army reports a girl was killed in one of the suicide attacks, seven soldiers were also wounded, and 350 people, including several isil officials,  were detained during the sweep.

headline: 2017 temple mount shooting
text: two druze israeli police officers are killed in an attack at temple mount in jerusalem.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: an explosion kills at least 29 people and injures dozens more at a shia mosque in herat, afghanistan.

headline: 2017 v-22 osprey crash
text: the search for three members of the united states marines corps lost in a mv-22 osprey crash in shoalwater bay in the australian state of queensland is called off.

headline: 2017 turku stabbing
text: at least two people are reportedly killed, and several others wounded in a stabbing in turku, finland. police said they arrested one person after a shootout and had launched a manhunt for other possible attackers. ,

headline: unexploded ordnance germany
text: large portions of frankfurt, germany, are evacuated as local authorities work to defuse a bomb left over from a royal air force raid during world war ii. the evacuation is the largest to occur in europe since world war ii.
bomb disposal experts successfully defuse the bomb.

headline: sinai insurgency
text: militants ambush a police convoy in egypt's sinai peninsula killing 18 police and wounding seven others.

headline: 2017 disasters in malaysia
text: a fire at an islamic boarding school for boys kills 24 people, most of them students, in kuala lumpur, malaysia.

headline: 2017 atlantic hurricane season
text: hurricane maria

hurricane maria makes landfall on puerto rico as a category 4 hurricane. effects are disastrous and the entire island loses power. seven deaths are reported on puerto rico, along with two on guadeloupe. puerto rican governor ricardo rosselló declares a 6:00 p.m. to 6:00 a.m. curfew through saturday.

now a category 2 hurricane with maximum sustained winds of 110 mph , maria is moving toward the northeastern coast of the dominican republic, and is forecast to affect the turks and caicos islands and the southeastern bahamas thursday night and northern haiti friday.

the national hurricane center predicts puerto rico's total rainfall through saturday will be 20–30 inches  inches with 35 inches  in isolated areas. the virgin islands will receive an additional 3 to 5 inches .

headline: 2017 atlantic hurricane season
text: hurricane maria
maria strengthens into a hurricane and causes flooding in the outer banks of north carolina.
the united states department of homeland security says it will not waive the merchant marine act of 1920  in response to the ongoing disaster in puerto rico.

headline: ring of fire
text: more than 134,000 people on the island of bali, indonesia, have been taken to shelters as the mount agung volcano  continues to release smoke. the alert level for an eruption has been raised to the second highest level, 4. in addition, the entire population of vanuatu's aoba island, also at alert level 4, is being moved from the path of the increasingly active lombenben volcano.

headline: 2017 las vegas shooting
text: A gunman opens fire in Paradise, Nevada, at the Mandalay Bay Resort and Casino from the upper floors down upon a Jason Aldean outdoor concert, with at least 59 people dead and 527 others injured. Authorities believe the lone gunman is dead.

headline: syrian civil war
text: A Russian Air Force Sukhoi Su-24 crashes at the Khmeimim air base in Latakia province in northwestern Syria, killing the two crewmen.

headline: insurgency in the sahel
text: Gunmen coming from Mali kill 13 gendarmes and injure five on a base in western Niger.

headline: battle of marawi
text: The Philippines Armed Forces declares an end to military operations in the southern city of Marawi after 5 months of fighting.

headline: october 2017 northern california wildfires
text: Archives from Hewlett-Packard founders William Hewlett and David Packard are among those destroyed by fires in a Santa Rosa neighborhood.

headline: yemeni civil war saudi arabian-led intervention in yemen
text: A senior UN official warns that Yemen faces the world's largest famine in decades "with millions of victims" if aid deliveries do not resume.

headline: 2017 iran–iraq earthquake
text: The death toll from the earthquake in Iraq and Iran exceeds 400 with over 7,000 injured. The death toll is expected to rise further in coming days.

headline: northern rakhine state clashes
text: Chinese delegates visiting the Burmese capital of Naypyidaw propose a three-phase plan to resolve the conflict in Myanmar's Rakhine State. The governments of Myanmar and Bangladesh expressed support for the plan, which included repatriating refugees that have fled from violence in Rakhine State.

headline: london zoo fire
text: A fire breaks out at a café and shop at the London Zoo. An aardvark is killed and four meerkats are missing.

headline: saudi arabian-led intervention in yemen
text: According to emergency services and the Houthi-owned Al Masirah, Saudi Arabian coalition air strikes kill 15 people and wound 60 at al-Shahra souq, a popular market in Taiz Governorate.

headline: iraqi civil war
text: battle of mosul
the iraqi army retakes mosul museum as well as the main government building in mosul.

headline: 2017 nangarhar airstrike
text: the death toll according to a nangarhar official source now stands at 94 militants, including 4 commanders. former president hamid karzai says the strike was in violation of national sovereignty.

headline: fatah–hamas conflict
text: the gaza strip's sole power plant is shut down due to running out of fuel, amid unpaid bills and a dispute over tax bills on fuel imports to the blockaded palestinian territory.

headline: april 2017 turkish airstrikes in syria and iraq
text: turkish air strikes kill 18 kurdish ypg fighters and media officials in northeastern syria. also five peshmerga fighters are killed during a turkish attack on sinjar in iraq. turkey also claims to have destroyed "terror hubs". iraq denounces the strike as a violation of its sovereignty.

headline: syrian civil war
text: the syrian observatory for human rights reports a large explosion near damascus international airport followed by a fire. the syrian government says israel struck the military site with several missiles. israeli intelligence minister yisrael katz states that the strike "corresponds completely with israel's policy".
the israeli air defense command shoots down a syrian air force drone using a mim-104 patriot missile.

headline: international workers' day
text: workers' party of belgium representative raoul hedebouw gets stabbed in the thigh, moments before holding a speech in liège, belgium. the presumed assailant is arrested.
turkish police fire tear gas and rubber bullets at demonstrators marching to taksim square. over 200 people are arrested at protests around the city of istanbul.
marches in paris are disrupted as french riot police fire tear gas at violent protesters ahead of the second round of the presidential election.

headline: 2017 north indian ocean cyclone season
text: more than 300,000 people are evacuated in bangladesh as cyclone mora approaches.

headline: war in north-west pakistan
text: chinese authorities report "grave concern" over reports that two kidnapped chinese teachers in quetta, pakistan, were killed by members of the islamic state of iraq and the levant.

headline: 2017 china floods
text: floods in south china kill at least 15 people over the last few days with tens of thousands more being relocated. more rain is forecast in future days.

headline: crime in london
text: five men in london are attacked with acid in five linked attacks. two teenaged suspects are taken into custody.

headline: syrian civil war
text: violent clashes break out between the syrian rebels and syrian democratic forces on the outskirts of al-muhsenli village, in the northeastern countryside of aleppo, but no casualties are reported.
syrian army forces shell, using heavy artillery, the residential neighborhoods in zaitan village, in the countryside of aleppo, destroying civilian property.

headline: cpp–npa–ndf rebellion
text: president of the philippines rodrigo duterte indefinitely freezes the peace talks with the communist party of the philippines after numerous attacks by the communist rebels on government forces. the president also vowed to re-orient anew the offensive against the party's armed wing the new people's army.

headline: war in somalia
text: a car bomb explodes near a police station in mogadishu, killing at least six people and wounding thirteen others.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: a suicide bomber attacks a convoy in afghanistan's kabul province, killing a georgian soldier and three civilians and wounding 13 others, including six resolute support personnel.

headline: 2017 venezuelan constitutional crisis
text: armed men dressed as soldiers, apparently led by former national guard captain juan carlos caguaripano, attack a venezuelan army base near valencia, carabobo, declaring themselves in rebellion against the national constituent assembly and president nicolás maduro. at least two people are killed.

headline: alexandria train collision
text: two trains collide in alexandria, egypt, killing at least 41 people and injuring at least 179.

headline: uss fitzgerald and mv acx crystal collision
text: the us navy has announced that about a dozen sailors of the uss fitzgerald are to be disciplined in the aftermath of the collision with a container ship last june, where 7 crew members died.

headline: auraiya train derailment
text: a passenger train collided with a dump truck on the line at auraiya, india, and was derailed. twenty-five people were injured.

headline: 2017 atlantic hurricane season
text: hurricane and storm surge watches are issued for texas and louisiana as the tropical system harvey strengthens into a tropical depression and is predicted to bring both heavy rainfall and storm surge.

headline: maritime incidents in 2017
text: a dry cargo vessel broke in two in the black sea off turkey’s northwest coast, television images showed early on sunday, while the 11-man crew was rescued. leonardo, a 114 meters -long dry cargo ship flagged from mongolia, started buckling and broke in two while on anchor off istanbul’s kilyos coast.

headline: 2016–17 northern rakhine state clashes
text: the arakan rohingya salvation army declares a unilateral ceasefire to allow humanitarian groups to facilitate aid for rohingya refugees.

headline: 2017 central mexico earthquake
text: a magnitude 7.1 earthquake strikes mexico, killing at least 220 people and collapsing several buildings in mexico city and widespread evacuations, hours after a yearly earthquake drill in commemoration of the 1985 mexico city earthquake.

headline: anglophone problem
text: Soldiers in Buea and Bamenda, Cameroon, shoot dead a total of at least eight people during various protests by Anglophone separatists.

headline: 2017 madagascar plague outbreak
text: Since August 1, another round of pneumonic, bubonic, and septicemic plague spreads in Madagascar, killing at least 45 people. ,

headline: israeli involvement in the syrian civil war
text: Israel launches surface-to-surface missiles at a military installation outside the Syrian capital Damascus overnight, Syrian state TV reports.

headline: russian military intervention in the syrian civil war
text: President Vladimir Putin declares victory over the Islamic State terror group across both banks of the river Euphrates.
The Syrian Observatory for Human Rights says that Russian air strikes kill 21 people in a village on the eastern side of the Euphrates river in Deir al-Zor province.

headline: war in afghanistan
text: A suicide blast near the National Directorate of Security headquarters in Kabul kills 10. Amaq News Agency claims ISIL is responsible for the attack.

headline: north caucasus clashes
text: a group of nine human rights activists and journalists, heading to grozny, chechnya, in a small bus, are attacked on the kavkaz federal highway near the ordzhonikidzovskaya settlement at the ingushetia border. about 20 masked men assaulted  the group, confiscated some mobile phones, and set their vehicle on fire.  two of the journalists, the ngo lawyer, and the bus driver were hospitalized. a committee to prevent torture representative said this is the first press tour that was not organized by the chechen government.
